jobs.title: Mechanical Designer
jobs.description:
We're looking for a Mechanical Designer with 10+ years of experience who can lead design work from concept to execution to meet project specifications, elevate visual and interaction quality, and partner closely with cross-functional teams to deliver thoughtful, high-impact outcomes. You'll operate with strong craft, sound judgment, and the ability to mentor others while driving projects forward.

Aufgaben:
• Produce high-quality deliverables such as equipment models and manufacturing drawings using Autodesk Inventor.

• Generate sales drawings using Inventor and AutoCAD.

• Ensure technical compliance and proper fit and function.

• Present work clearly - sharing rationale, incorporating feedback, and driving toward decisions.

• Manage workload priorities to adhere to budget constraints and project timelines.

• Resolve discrepancies that occur during the design and manufacture of Buhler equipment.

• Perform inspections of components, work-in-process, and finished equipment.

• Organize information on project specific SharePoint sites.

• Actively participate in project meetings with cross-functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers.

• Complete design related tasks resulting from equipment installation issues at customer site.

• Provide mentorship and design direction to other designers through critique, coaching, and collaborative problem-solving.

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications
 (Required education and experience)

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• 10+ years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED SKILLS

• Proficient in engineering drafting/drawings and engineering principles.

• Working knowledge of manufacturing and assembly practices, e.g. welding, sheet metal forming, press operations, etc.

• Awareness of machine safety codes and designing equipment for the food industry.

• Proficient in GD&T

• Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD

• PTC Windchill

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Descrizione Stiamo cercando un progettista meccanico con oltre 10 anni di esperienza che possa portare il lavoro di progettazione dal concetto all'esecuzione per soddisfare le specifiche del progetto, la qualità di 142 immagini e interazioni, e collaborare strettamente con team cross-funzionali per fornire risultati riflessivi e di impatto elevato. Opererete con un mestiere forte, giudizio sano e la capacità di guidare gli altri mentre si guidano i progetti in avanti.

Aufgaben - Produce prodotti di alta qualità come modelli di apparecchiature e disegni di produzione utilizzando Autodesk Inventor. - Genera disegni di vendita utilizzando Inventor e AutoCAD. - Garantire la conformità tecnica e la corretta vestibilità e funzione. - Presente lavoro chiaramente - ragionare di condivisione, incorporando feedback, e guida verso decisioni. - Gestire le priorità di carico di lavoro per aderire ai vincoli di budget e tempi di progetto. - Risolvere le discrepanze che si verificano durante la progettazione e la produzione di attrezzature Buhler. - Eseguire ispezioni di componenti, processo di lavoro e attrezzature finite.

- Organizzare informazioni su specifici siti SharePoint. - Partecipare attivamente a riunioni di progetto con membri del team cross-funzionali, fornitori e/o clienti. - Completare le attività di progettazione correlate derivanti da problemi di installazione di apparecchiature sul sito del cliente. - Fornire mento e direzione di progettazione ad altri progettisti attraverso la critica, coaching, e la collaborazione problem-solving.

Anfonderungen Job Specifications (Istruzione ed esperienza richieste) - Laurea in Ingegneria Meccanica o equivalente - 10+ anni di esperienza lavorativa pertinente

SKILLS PREFERITI - Abilita nella redazione/disegno di ingegneria e principi di ingegneria. - Conoscenza di lavoro delle pratiche di fabbricazione e assemblaggio, ad esempio saldatura, formatura di lamiere, operazioni di pressa, ecc. - Conoscenza dei codici di sicurezza delle macchine e progettazione delle apparecchiature per l'industria alimentare. - Abilita' in GD&T - Autodesk Inventor e AutoCAD - PTC Windchill

Circa Bühler Ogni giorno due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto con le attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli i cui pezzi sono stati fabbricati con le nostre macchine. Bühler punta a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sblocchino opportunità di business sostenibili nell'industria alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

jobs.description:
2007年，布勒（无锡）商业有限公司成立于江苏无锡市。凭借先进的技术优势，公司在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造及研磨与分散等领域引领市场。公司拥有制粉，面条，色选，消费食品，研磨分散等多个独立应用中心及客户服务中心，提供多产业链集成解决方案。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案。

Aufgaben:
根据布勒统一的研发流程与规范，负责自动化编程工具的研发、产品自动化软件的开发、电气选型和设计、整机项目支持、现有设备升级、技术转让项目落地、及其全生命周期管理等工作，具体如下：
• 新产品自动化研发：

• 完成自动化编程工具的研发。

• 完成产品自动化软件的组态、编程、仿真及界面设计等自动化程序的开发。

• 完成电气元件选型与电气方案设计。

• 根据产品开发任务书/需求输入，完成市场与应用调研；与机械、工艺、制造、质量等团队协作，制定自动化整体方案与控制架构，确保功能实现、交付质量与可维护性。

• 配合样机联调与测试验证，发现问题并持续改进。

• 跟踪新产品市场推广与客户反馈，持续优化设计文档、使用手册、程序块封装等标准化成果。

• 现有设备电气与控制升级改造：

• 对现有设备进行自动化控制升级方案设计、实施支持与验证。

• 输出改造方案、风险评估、验证计划及升级文档，支持现场验收与持续改进。

• 国外技术转让/国产化项目：

• 负责技术转让设备项目的电气图纸国产化、电气元件替代选型、软件更新与版本跟踪。

• 协调跨区域技术对齐，确保功能一致、规范一致并按期交付。

• 供应链/制造过程支持与质量改进：

• 对新选型电气设备，协助供应链与外协/外购供应商进行技术沟通、首样验收确认。

• 跟踪设备电气系统的制造与装配质量，及时发现硬件接线及软件控制问题并推动改进。

• 需求对接与技术支持：

• 学习并掌握布勒上位机控制系统的操作与应用，提出并反馈必要的开发需求。

• 负责与客户或产品开发部门的需求澄清与技术对接，形成可执行的功能规格与验收标准。

• 支持其他团队，对销售项目提供技术支持。

Anforderungen:
• 本科/硕士及以上学历，计算机软件、软件工程、电气自动化、自动化、机电一体化等相关专业。

• 3 年以上工控自动化编程类软件研发、产品自动化软件研发及电气设计相关工作经验。有食品加工行业设备自动化开发经验者优先。

• 具备开发PLC自动化编程工具的能力，包括：

• 精通Visual Basic/C#编程语言，精通工控脚本或宏编程技术。

• 精通面向对象编程（OOP）编程技术。

• 熟练使用 Git 等版本管理工具，了解常见协作流程（分支管理、合并、PR 等）。

• 熟练使用 Visual Studio Code（或 Visual Studio）工具进行开发与调试。

• 精通西门子TIA Portal SCL编程语言 和 STL编程语言。

• 熟悉西门子TIA Portal Openness开发接口。

• 熟悉微软Azure DevOps平台。

• 熟悉TypeScript/JavaScript语言和Node.js开发环境者优先。

• 具备程序标准化与版本控制意识，具备敏捷开发经验者优先。

• 具备电气专用设计工具EPlan或 Engineering Base的应用能力者优先。

• 具备常用伺服控制应用经验者优先。

• 具备扎实的电气设计基础与工程化思维，具备创新意识与解决问题的能力。

• 能够在样机测试与现场调试中独立定位问题，推动跨团队协作解决。

• 具备团队精神，开诚布公，良好的人际沟通与协作能力。

• 良好的英语读写能力及口语沟通能力。

20亿人每天食用布勒设备生产的食品。10亿人驾驶的车辆中包含本公司设备制造的部件。
布勒力求在每项决策中平衡兼顾人类、自然和经济，在全球食品、饲料和交通运输行业开发解决方案，拓展可持续业务解决方案。我们努力以创新驱动未来，特别专注于健康、安全、可持续的解决方案。因此，我们与客户、创业公司、跨国企业和学界携手
合作，共同加速实现影响。

根据布勒统一的研发流程与规范，负责自动化编程工具的研发、产品自动化软件的开发、电气选型和设计、整机项目支持、现有设备升级、技术转让项目落地、及其全生命周期管理等工作，具体如下：

• 完成产品自动化软件的组态、编程、仿真及界面设计等自动化程序的开发。

• 完成电气元件选型与电气方案设计。

• 配合样机联调与测试验证，发现问题并持续改进。

•跟踪新产品市场推广与客户反馈，持续优化设计文档、使用手册、程序块封装等标准化成果。

• 对现有设备进行自动化控制升级方案设计、实施支持与验证。

• 输出改造方案、风险评估、验证计划及升级文档，支持现场验收与持续改进。

• 负责技术转让设备项目的电气图纸国产化、电气元件替代选型、软件更新与版本跟踪。

• 协调跨区域技术对齐，确保功能一致、规范一致并按期交付。

• 供应链/制造过程支持与质量改进：

• 对新选型电气设备，协助供应链与外协/外购供应商进行技术沟通、首样验收确认。

• 跟踪设备电气系统的制造与装配质量，及时发现硬件接线及软件控制问题并推动改进。

• 需求对接与技术支持：

• 学习并掌握布勒上位机控制系统的操作与应用，提出并反馈必要的开发需求。

• 负责与客户或产品开发部门的需求澄清与技术对接，形成可执行的功能规格与验收标准.

• 支持其他团队，对销售项目提供技术支持。

Requirements:
•本科/硕士及以上学历，计算机软件、软件工程、电气自动化、自动化、机电一体化等相关专业。

• 3年以上工控自动化编程类软件研发、产品自动化软件研发及电气设计相关工作经验。有食品加工行业设备自动化开发经验者优先。

• 具备开发PLC自动化编程工具的能力，包括：

• 精通Visual Basic/C#编程语言，精通工控脚本或宏编程技术。

• 精通面向对象编程（OOP）编程技术。

• 熟练使用 Git 等版本管理工具，了解常见协作流程（分支管理、合并、PR 等）。

• 熟练使用 Visual Studio Code（或 Visual Studio）工具进行开发与调试。

• 精通西门子TIA Portal SCL编程语言 和 STL编程语言。

• 熟悉西门子TIA Portal Openness开发接口。

• 熟悉微软Azure DevOps平台。

• 熟悉TypeScript/JavaScript语言和Node.js开发环境者优先。

• 具备程序标准化与版本控制意识，具备敏捷开发经验者优先。

• 具备电气专用设计工具EPlan或 Engineering Base的应用能力者优先。

• 具备常用伺服控制应用经验者优先。

• 具备扎实的电气设计基础与工程化思维，具备创新意识与解决问题的能力。

• 能够在样机测试与现场调试中独立定位问题，推动跨团队协作解决。

• 具备团队精神，开诚布公，良好的人际沟通与协作能力。

• 良好的英语读写能力及口语沟通能力。

jobs.title: R&D Engineer (m/f/d) Ion Beam Sputtering

titleByLocale.fr: Ingénieur R&D (m/f/d) Pulvérisation par Faisceau Ionique

jobs.description:
As an R&D Engineer (m/f/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, you will contribute to the further development of our LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS ion beam sputtering platforms. In this role, you will develop advanced thin-film coating processes and support the realization of innovative vacuum coating systems for demanding optical applications. If you enjoy working in an innovative technical environment, combining scientific understanding with hands-on engineering, we look forward to receiving your application.

Creating impact together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together. Aufgaben: • You develop and optimize ion beam sputtering processes for the deposition of optical thin-film systems • You are actively involved in the development, testing, and qualification of new components, process solutions, and system features • You coordinate and execute R&D projects in close collaboration with internal departments and external partners • You write development and application reports as well as scientific publications • You attend international conferences and technical events to follow the latest developments, present results, and build professional networks • You commission novel vacuum coating systems • You support our sales team and customers with technical expertise Anforderungen: • You have successfully completed a university degree e.g., in Physics, Applied Physics, Material Science, Physical Engineering, Optical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or a comparable field • Experience in process development, experimental work, data evaluation, or system commissioning • Ideally, you have experience with ion beam sputtering systems, vacuum coating technology, optical thin films, or optical interference filters • You have a good command of English, German skills are of advantage • You have a structured, reliable, and solution-oriented way of working • You are willing to travel internationally to visit customers, support system commissioning, and attend conferences Wir bieten: Modern workplace with best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to support your productivity and innovation. Cross-cultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from at least 100 nationalities as well as our inclusive culture. Career and personal development We deliver a broad spectrum of learning opportunities through videos, e-learnings, classroom trainings, and webinars that offer training in formats that are short, relevant, engaging, personalized, and mobile. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts designed to enhance your everyday life. Join our team and learn more. Canteen with healthy meal options Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices! Team and social events Your engagement makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our holidays parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Come ingegnere R&D (m/f/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, contribuirete allo sviluppo delle nostre piattaforme di spruzzatura a fascio ionico LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS. In questo ruolo, svilupperete processi avanzati di rivestimento a film sottile e sosterrete la realizzazione di sistemi innovativi di rivestimento sotto vuoto per applicazioni ottiche esigenti. Se vi piace lavorare in un ambiente tecnico innovativo, combinando la comprensione scientifica con l'ingegneria pratica, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere la vostra applicazione.

Creare impatto insieme a Bühler! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con le attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler mira a bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, mentre sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con una particolare attenzione a soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili.

Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

Aufgaben:
• Sviluppate e ottimizzate i processi di sputtering dei raggi ionici per la deposizione di sistemi ottici a film sottile

• Siete attivamente coinvolti nello sviluppo, testing e qualificazione di nuovi componenti, soluzioni di processo e funzionalità di sistema

• Coordina ed esegue progetti di R&S in stretta collaborazione con i servizi interni e partner esterni

• Scrivete rapporti sullo sviluppo e sulle applicazioni nonché pubblicazioni scientifiche

• Partecipate a conferenze internazionali ed eventi tecnici per seguire gli ultimi sviluppi, i risultati attuali e costruire reti professionali

• Lei commissiona nuovi sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto

• Supporti il nostro team di vendita e i clienti con esperienza tecnica

Anforderungen:
• Hai completato con successo un corso di laurea, ad esempio in Fisica, Fisica Applicata, Scienza dei Materiali, Ingegneria Fisica, Ingegneria Ottica, Ingegneria Elettrica o un campo comparabile

• Esperienza nello sviluppo di processi, lavoro sperimentale, valutazione dei dati o messa in servizio di sistemi

• Idealmente, avete esperienza con sistemi di sputtering a fascio ionico, tecnologia di rivestimento sotto vuoto, film sottili ottici, o filtri di interferenza ottica

• Hai un buon livello di conoscenza dell'inglese, le competenze tedesche sono di vantaggio

• Hai un modo strutturato, affidabile e orientato alla soluzione di lavoro

• Siete disposti a viaggiare a livello internazionale per visitare i clienti, supportare il sistema di messa in servizio e partecipare a conferenze

descriptionByLocale.fr:
En tant qu'ingénieur en R & D (m/w/d) Ion Beam Sputtering, vous contribuez au développement de nos plateformes de sputter IBS LEYBOLD OPTICS IBS. Dans ce rôle, vous développez des processus de revêtement de film mince avancés et soutenez la mise en place de systèmes de revêtement de vide innovants pour des applications optiques exigeantes.

Deux milliards de personnes mangent quotidiennement des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Tâches:
• Ils développent et optimisent les processus de pulvérisation de faisceaux ioniques pour le dépôt de systèmes de film optique mince

• Vous participez activement au développement, à la mise à l'essai et à la qualification de nouveaux composants, de nouvelles solutions de processus et de nouvelles fonctions système

• Ils coordonnent et mettent en oeuvre des projets de R-D en étroite collaboration avec les services internes et les partenaires externes

• Vous rédigez des rapports de développement et d'application ainsi que des publications scientifiques

• Vous participerez à des conférences et des événements internationaux pour suivre les derniers développements, présenter les résultats et construire des réseaux professionnels

• Ils mettent en service de nouveaux systèmes de revêtement sous vide

• Vous accompagnez notre équipe commerciale et nos clients avec une expertise technique

Exigences:
• Vous avez obtenu avec succès un diplôme technique en physique, physique appliquée, sciences des matériaux, physique, optique, génie électrique ou un domaine d'études similaire

• Vous avez de l'expérience dans le développement de processus, le travail expérimental, l'évaluation de données ou la mise en service de systèmes

• Idéalement, vous avez de l'expérience avec les systèmes de pulvérisation de faisceaux ioniques, la technologie de revêtement sous vide, les films minces optiques ou les filtres d'interférence optique

• Vous avez de bonnes compétences en anglais; les compétences en allemand sont avantageuses

• Elles se caractérisent par une approche structurée, fiable et orientée vers la solution

• Vous êtes prêt à voyager à l'étranger pour visiter les clients, soutenir les opérations du système et participer à des conférences

Nous offrons: Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travailler sur un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour promouvoir votre productivité et votre innovation.

Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive.

Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons une large gamme de possibilités d'apprentissage, comme des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations de présence et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, attrayants, personnalisés et mobiles.

Avantages et réductions pour les employés Profitez d'une variété d'avantages et de réductions pour les employés qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne.

Prestations de retraite ou de prestations professionnelles Profitez de notre prestation de retraite ou de prestations professionnelles – pour un avenir sûr!

Cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables.

Chaque jour, deux milliards de personnes consomment des aliments produits sur les usines de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites par la technologie Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler vise à mettre en ligne les besoins des entreprises, des personnes et de la nature. Nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités d'affaires durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.

C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec nos clients, nos start-up, nos multinationales et nos scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Aspettiamo con ansia un membro del team dedicato (m/p/d) che supporti attivamente il nostro team di assistenza nel servizio clienti dell'area business Grinding & Disperding attraverso iniziativa, flessibilità e orientamento al cliente. Compiti:
• Lei svolge lavori di messa in servizio e di servizio come riparazioni, modifiche, ispezioni, riparazioni e manutenzione di macchine e sistemi individuali in Germania e all'estero

• Lei assume il supporto tecnico o il supporto della nostra base clienti globale per telefono o sul sito e mantiene contatti con i clienti

• Analizza e corregge errori/problemi con i reparti interessati

• Formate i dipendenti dei clienti durante il periodo di servizio nel campo dell'esercizio della macchina

• State lavorando sull'aggiornamento del software macchina

Requisiti:
• Hai completato la formazione professionale come ingegnere meccatronico (m/p/d), meccanico industriale (m/p/d), elettricista (m/p/d) o comparabile, ama continuare con la formazione professionale come master/tecnico (m/p/d) o una laurea in ingegneria elettrica

• Hai esperienza professionale in ingegneria meccanica e impiantistica, idealmente nel campo della dispersione e della rettificatura a umido

• Conoscete il controllo PLC (Siemens)

• Si comunica molto bene in inglese

• Un approccio autonomo e orientato al cliente e una volontà mondiale di viaggiare completano il tuo profilo

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

descriptionByLocale.en:
We look forward to a dedicated team member (m/w/d) who actively supports our service team in the customer service of the business area Grinding & Dispersing through initiative, flexibility and customer orientation. In your role as a service technician (m/w/d) you convince with commitment and communication strength and do not shy away from new challenges. Take your chance and become part of the Bühler world

Let us make a difference at Bühler! Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts have been produced by Bühler technology. With every decision, Bühler is pursuing the goal of reconciling the needs of business, people and nature. We are developing solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.

We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Tasks:
• You carry out commissioning and service work such as repairs, modifications, inspections, repairs and maintenance of individual machines and systems in Germany and abroad

• You take over technical support or support of our global customer base by telephone or on site and maintain customer contacts

• You analyze and fix errors/problems with the relevant departments

• You train customers' employees during the service period in the field of machine operation

• You are working on updating the machine software

Requirements:
• You have completed vocational training as a mechatronics engineer (m/w/d), industrial mechanics (m/w/d), electrician (m/w/d) or comparable, likes to continue with further training as a master/technician (m/w/d) or a degree in electrical engineering

• You have professional experience in machine and plant engineering, ideally in the field of dispersion and wet grinding technology

• You have knowledge of PLC control (Siemens)

• You communicate very well in English

• A self-employed and customer-oriented approach and a worldwide willingness to travel round off your profile

We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work at a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to promote your productivity and innovation.

Intercultural working environment The key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture.

Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, presence training and webinars with short, relevant, appealing, personalized and mobile formats.

Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and learn more.

Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices.

Occupational pension or benefit benefit Benefit from our occupational pension or benefit benefit – for a safe future!

jobs.title: Project Manager (Engineering)
jobs.description:
Managing and leading the project team-including internal stakeholders, subcontractors, and consortium partners, as applicable-as well as coordinating with external interfaces for projects of up to high complexity.

Aufgaben:
• Manage and lead the project team to achieve and further improve the cost, schedule, quality and EHS targets

• Supervise the final negotiations for the allocated project and provides the execution strategy

• Ensures that the project schedule baseline is signed by the involved parties at the start of the project

• Perform proper risk and opportunity management

• Prepare and perform Project Reviews as requested, report according Bühler Project Management process

• Responsible for the site briefing meeting; Ensures that all site relevant documents are handed over to site personnel

• Ensure forecasting accuracy and monitor project KPIs including Schedule Performance Index (SPI) and Cost Performance Index (CPI), timely Turnover (TO) and manual TO Pulls if needed, to drive project success

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree (or equivalent) in Engineering

• Minimum 4 years as Project Manager or proof of sufficient skills (full cycle project management)

• Plant Engineering experience preferred

• Preferably PMI/PMP Certification

• Strong planning, organizing and priority setting skills, with a proven ability to manage teams

• Ability to work in a matrix organization

• Strong problem-solving skills

• Strong teamwork and leadership skills

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, including the ability to interface effectively with people inside and outside of the company

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

布勒莱宝光学设备（北京）有限公司，是德国布勒莱宝光学在北京设立的独资子公司，目前是布勒集团高真空镀膜设备全球两大生产制造基地之一。布勒莱宝光学的业务涉及光学以及能源镀膜两大类业务领域，为中国的精密光学、视光学、汽车、半导体、柔性电子、建筑玻璃等行业的发展做出了贡献。

jobs.description:
Zur Unterstützung unserer Entwicklungs- und Prozessingenieure suchen wir einen engagierten Werkstudenten (m/w/d), der Freude daran hat, aus komplexen Daten wertvolle Erkenntnisse zu gewinnen und damit zur Weiterentwicklung unserer Technologien beizutragen

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Du bereitest große, automatisch generierte Datensätze aus unseren Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen auf, bereinigst sie und strukturierst sie • Du entwickelst aussagekräftige Visualisierungen und Dashboards, um komplexe Prozessdaten zu analysieren • Du identifizierst Korrelationen, Muster und potenzielle kausale Zusammenhänge in Produktions- und Prozessdaten • Du präsentierst und diskutierst deine Analyseergebnisse mit Ingenieur:innen und Fachabteilungen • Du nutzt vorhandene Analyse- und Visualisierungstools, zum Beispiel Grafana • Je nach Qualifikation entwickelst du eigene Softwarelösungen und Auswertungswerkzeuge für eine effiziente Datenanalyse Anforderungen: • Du bist immatrikulierter Student (m/w/d) im Bereich Mathematik, Physik oder Maschinenbau - idealerweise in den ersten Semestern • Du begeisterst dich für Datenanalyse, Statistik und technische Zusammenhänge • Du arbeitest strukturiert und analytisch • Du hast Interesse daran, komplexe Daten grafisch aufzubereiten • Erste Kenntnisse in Datenanalyse- oder Programmierwerkzeugen sind von Vorteil • Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen mit Python, Datenbanken, Visualisierungstools oder vergleichbaren Technologien gesammelt • Du verfügst über gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse Wir bieten: Moderner Arbeitsplatz mit bester technischer Ausstattung Arbeiten Sie an einem modernen Arbeitsplatz, der mit den neuesten technischen Hilfsmitteln ausgestattet ist, um Ihre Produktivität und Innovation zu fördern. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. jobs.description:
Maintain, troubleshoot, repair, and keep records on production equipment, vehicles, HVAC, building and grounds and security system. See day to day functionality of manufacturing equipment and make/oversee repairs as needed.

• Performs trouble-shooting and diagnostic tests on all types of production equipment Investigates and executes economic repair options on production equipment

 (Desired education and experience)

• Basic computer skills and knowledge of Word and Excel software

• Must be able to wear safety equipment(hard hat, safety shoes, safety glasses)

TECHNICAL SKILLS

• Electrical

• Plumbing

• Hydraulics

• Carpentry

• Machine Shop

• Welding

• Troubleshooting electronic machine controls.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities
 Mechanical -- Knowledge of machines and tools, including their designs, uses, repair, and maintenance. Knowledge of electrical, hydraulics, control systems and HVAC systems.
 Design -- Knowledge of design techniques, tools, and principles involved in production of precision technical plans, blueprints, drawings, and models.
 Building and Construction -- Knowledge of materials, methods, and the tools involved in basic carpentry and construction.

Descrizione Mantenere, risolvere i problemi, riparare e tenere registrazioni su attrezzature di produzione, veicoli, HVAC, edifici e terreni, e sistemi di sicurezza. Assicurare la funzionalità quotidiana di attrezzature di produzione e fare / sopravedere le riparazioni, se necessario.

Responsabilità - Esegue test diagnostici e di ricerca di guasti su tutti i tipi di attrezzature di produzione - Indaga ed esegue opzioni di riparazione economica sulle attrezzature di produzione - Esegui programma di manutenzione preventiva - Mantiene l'inventario dei pezzi di ricambio di manutenzione - Assiste nell'installazione di nuove attrezzature e delocalizzazione di attrezzature esistenti - Esegue la manutenzione su edifici, terreni e infrastrutture impianti - Coordina con risorse esterne per la fornitura di beni e servizi di riparazione - Mantiene la massima qualità di lavorazione - Richiede una supervisione minima -

Accetta/performa altre responsabilità/disposizioni assegnate da un supervisore immediato - Completa le attività e gestisce le apparecchiature in modo sicuro - Lavora a un livello di produttività accettabile e comunicato

Requisiti Specifiche di lavoro - Formazione professionale in lettura di progetti, lavorazione di base e controllo di qualità di base - Forte capacità di risoluzione dei problemi elettrici/meccanici - Minimo cinque anni nel campo della manutenzione industriale - Minimo due anni di formazione professionale - Deve avere una patente di guida in Nord Carolina - Competenze informatiche di base e conoscenze del software Word ed Excel - Deve essere in grado di indossare attrezzature di sicurezza (hard hat, scarpe di sicurezza, occhiali di sicurezza) - Capacità di lavorare straordinario quando necessario

Nel sito Beilngries, circa 360 dipendenti della divisione Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) sono dedicati all'ingegneria meccanica e vegetale nei settori della lavorazione del grano e della produzione di malto e malto. > Ciò include la pulizia, l'essiccazione, il trasporto (comprese le attrezzature di trasporto e il carico delle navi), lo stoccaggio e la digitalizzazione per elaborare il grano dal campo al consumatore. Sempre al centro dell'efficienza, della qualità del prodotto e della sostenibilità. > > Come direttore d'assemblaggio (m/f/d) Lei è il punto centrale di contatto sui nostri cantieri in tutto il mondo e assicura che i nostri progetti in ingegneria vegetale e meccanica siano implementati senza intoppi, nel tempo e in alta qualità. > Coordinate team, pianificate processi e aiutate attivamente i nostri clienti a sviluppare le nostre competenze e affidabilità. > > Facciamo la differenza a Bühler insieme! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme. Compiti:
• Assemblaggio e messa in servizio: Organizzazione indipendente e implementazione di assemblaggio e messa in servizio su cantieri in tutto il mondo
• Coordinamento del progetto: interfaccia tra project management, cliente e subappaltatore
• Processo di costruzione: pianificazione e monitoraggio del montaggio e della messa in servizio in termini di qualità, tempo e uso del materiale
• Pianificazione delle risorse: pianificazione operativa del personale e delle macchine proprie ed esterne
• Gestione della qualità e della sicurezza: applicazione delle politiche di sicurezza sul lavoro e riduzione del progresso delle costruzioni
• Documentazione: Conduzione di incontri, accettazione parziale e visite dei clienti incl. Documentazione del cantiere Requisiti
• Formazione commerciale o tecnica completa (costruzione, meccanica vegetale, costruzione di metalli o simili)
• Diversi anni di esperienza professionale in assemblaggio su cantieri, preferibilmente in costruzione di impianti
• Personalità decisionale e orientata alla soluzione
• Talenti organizzativi, forte orientamento del cliente e potenziale di leadership riconoscibile
• Flessibilità e elevata mobilità in termini di disponibilità operativa e posizione (prontezza del viaggio intorno al 90% in tutto il mondo)
• Conoscenza sicura dell'inglese in parola e scrittura
• Titolo di guida della categoria B richiesto Offriamo: Cultura aziendale familiare Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine - in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico. Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva. Previdenza sociale Approfittate delle nostre pensioni aziendali o dei servizi che generano attività – per un futuro sicuro! Eventi e eventi di squadra Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo. Cultura della comunicazione aperta Approfittate di una cultura di comunicazione aperta che promuove la trasparenza e lo scambio! Sviluppo professionale e personale Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the areas of grain processing and malt & brewing.
This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including conveying equipment and ship loading), storage and digitization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with the focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

As assembly conductor (m/f/d) You are the central point of contact on our construction sites worldwide and ensure that our projects in plant and mechanical engineering are implemented smoothly, on time and in high quality.
You coordinate teams, plan processes and actively help our customers to build on our expertise and reliability.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Assembly and commissioning: Independent organization and implementation of assembly and commissioning on construction sites worldwide • Project coordination: interface between project management, customer and subcontractor • Construction process: planning and monitoring of assembly and commissioning in terms of quality, time and material use • Resource planning: operational planning for own and external personnel and machines • Quality and Safety Management: Enforcement of Occupational Safety Policies and Reduction of Construction Progress • Documentation: Conduct of meetings, partial acceptances and customer visits incl. Construction site documentation Requirements • Completed commercial or technical training (construction, plant mechanics, metal construction or similar) • Several years of professional experience in assembly on construction sites, preferably in plant construction • Decision-making and solution-oriented personality • Organizational talent, strong customer orientation and recognizable leadership potential • Flexibility and high mobility in terms of operational readiness and location (travel readiness around 90% worldwide) • Safe knowledge of English in word and writing • Category B driving licence required We offer: Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Occupational pension schemes or asset-generating benefits Benefit from our company pensions or asset-generating services – for a secure future! Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Open communication culture Benefit from an open communication culture that promotes transparency and exchange! Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply (GQ) dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Als Montageleiter (m/w/d) bist Du der zentrale Ansprechpartner auf unseren Baustellen weltweit und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte im Anlagen- und Maschinenbau reibungslos, termingerecht und in hoher Qualität umgesetzt werden.
Du koordinierst Teams, planst Abläufe und trägst aktiv dazu bei, dass unsere Kunden auf unsere Kompetenz und Zuverlässigkeit bauen können.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Montage und Inbetriebnahme: Eigenständige Organisation und Durchführung der Montage und Inbetriebnahme unserer Maschinen und Anlagen auf Baustellen weltweit • Projektkoordination: Schnittstelle zwischen Projektmanagement, Kunden und Subunternehmer • Bauablauf: Planung und Überwachung der Montage und Inbetriebnahme hinsichtlich Qualität, Zeit und Materialeinsatz • Ressourcenplanung: Einsatzplanung für Eigen- und Fremdpersonal sowie Maschinen • Qualitäts- und Sicherheitsmanagement: Durchsetzung von Arbeitssicherheitsrichtlinien und Abnahme der Baufortschritte • Dokumentation: Durchführung von Besprechungen, Teilabnahmen und Kundenbegehungen inkl. Baustellendokumentation Anforderungen: • Abgeschlossene gewerbliche oder technische Ausbildung (Konstruktions-, Anlagenmechanik, Metallbau oder ähnliches) • Mehrjährige Berufserfahrung in der Montage auf Baustellen, vorzugsweise im Anlagenbau • Entscheidungsfreudige und lösungsorientierte Persönlichkeit • Organisationstalent, ausgeprägte Kundenorientierung und erkennbares Führungspotenzial • Flexibilität und hohe Mobilität bezüglich Einsatzbereitschaft und -ort (Reisebereitschaft weltweit ca. 90%) • Sichere Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift • Führerschein Klasse B erforderlich Wir bieten: Familiäre Unternehmenskultur Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Betriebliche Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksame Leistungen Profitiere von unserer betrieblichen Altersvorsorge oder vermögenswirksamen Leistungen – für eine sichere Zukunft! Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Offene Kommunikationskultur Profitieren Sie von einer offenen Kommunikationskultur, die Transparenz und Austausch fördert! Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le site de Beilngries, environ 360 employés de la division Qualité et approvisionnement en grains (GQ) sont dédiés à l'ingénierie des installations et de la mécanique dans les domaines de la transformation des grains et du malt et brassage.
Cela comprend le nettoyage, le séchage, le transport (y compris l'équipement de transport et le chargement des navires), l'entreposage et la numérisation pour traiter le grain du champ au consommateur. Toujours en mettant l'accent sur l'efficacité, la qualité et la durabilité des produits.

En tant que chef d'assemblage (m/f/d) Vous êtes le point de contact central sur nos chantiers de construction dans le monde entier et assurez que nos projets d'ingénierie mécanique et d'usine sont mis en œuvre en douceur, à temps et en haute qualité.
Vous coordonnez les équipes, planifiez les processus et aidez activement nos clients à tirer parti de notre expertise et de notre fiabilité.

Faisons une différence à Bühler ensemble!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des débouchés commerciaux durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • Assemblée et mise en service : Organisation et mise en œuvre indépendantes de réunions et de mise en service sur les chantiers de construction dans le monde entier • Coordination du projet : interface entre la gestion du projet, le client et le sous-traitant • Processus de construction : planification et suivi du montage et de la mise en service en termes de qualité, de temps et d'utilisation des matériaux • Planification des ressources: planification opérationnelle du personnel et des machines propres et externes • Gestion de la qualité et de la sécurité : application des politiques de sécurité au travail et réduction des progrès dans la construction • Documentation: conduite des réunions, acceptations partielles et visites des clients, y compris Documentation du chantier Exigences • Formation commerciale ou technique terminée (construction, mécanique d'usine, construction métallique ou similaire) • Plusieurs années d'expérience professionnelle dans l'assemblage sur les chantiers, de préférence dans la construction d'usines • Prise de décisions et personnalité orientée vers la solution • Un talent organisationnel, une forte orientation client et un potentiel de leadership reconnaissable • Flexibilité et mobilité élevée en termes de disponibilité opérationnelle et de localisation (préparation aux déplacements autour de 90 % dans le monde) • Connaissance de l'anglais en paroles et en écriture • Permis de conduire de catégorie B requis Nous offrons: Culture des entreprises familiales Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme - dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique. Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive. Régimes de retraite professionnels ou prestations génératrices d'actifs Bénéficiez de pensions d'entreprise ou de services générateurs d'actifs – pour un avenir sûr! Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons célébrer ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Culture de communication ouverte Profitez d'une culture de communication ouverte qui favorise la transparence et l'échange ! Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons un large éventail de possibilités d'apprentissage, telles que des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations en face à face et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, engageants, personnalisés et mobiles. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour des aliments produits sur les plantes de Bühler. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des débouchés commerciaux durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

布勒莱宝光学设备（北京）有限公司，是德国布勒莱宝光学在北京设立的独资子公司，目前是布勒集团高真空镀膜设备全球两大生产制造基地之一。布勒莱宝光学的业务涉及光学以及能源镀膜两大类业务领域，为中国的精密光学、视光学、汽车、半导体、柔性电子、建筑玻璃等行业的发展做出了贡献。
Bühler Leybold Optics is a wholly owned subsidiary of Bühler Leybold Optics in Beijing and is currently one of the two global manufacturing bases for high vacuum coating equipment of the Bühler Group. The business of Bühler Leybold Optics covers two major business fields: optics and large area coating, contributing to the development of the precision optics, optics, automotive, semiconductor, flexible electronics and architectural glass industries in China. Aufgaben: • 1.根据销售计划，对项目和关键客户的跟进； • 2.负责新目标市场和客户需求的挖掘和分析，建立和维护客户关系； • 3.基于公司现有技术平台，拓展新的应用方向，开拓新领域客户； • 4.基于市场发展趋势及客户需求，为公司研发方向提供必要参考并驱动项目进展； • 5.项目跟踪，对半导体设备销售和售后服务工作进行协调，保证客户满意，项目顺利； • 6. 协助项目按时回款。 Anforderungen: • 1.理工科专业背景，大学本科及以上学历。 • 2.具有5年及以上半导体行业销售及相关技术经验，熟悉半导体行业市场发展现状，能够识别、确定潜在的商业合作伙伴。 • 3.具有丰富半导体行业人脉资源； • 4.具有较强的判断和决策能力、人际沟通协调能力、计划与执行能力； • 5.有强烈的结果导向，具备较强的项目推动能力； • 6.具备优秀的英语听、说、读、写能力。 Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
In 2007, Bühler (Wuxi) Commercial Co., Ltd. was established in Wuxi, Jiangsu Province. We lead the market in grain handling and processing, consumer food manufacturing, and grinding and dispersion with our advanced technology advantages. We have several independent application centers and customer service centers for milling, pasta, color sorting, consumer food, grinding and dispersion, providing integrated solutions for multiple industry chains.
With our vision of “Innovations for a better world”, we are committed to developing more innovative solutions by leveraging the global resources of the Bühler Group and taking advantage of localization. Aufgaben: • Develop and maintain application software on Bühler's Linux-based embedded platform for machine control, covering control logic, parameter handling, alarms, status management, and machine interfaces. • Develop and maintain firmware for sensors used on Bühler machines, enabling sensing, data collection, local processing, diagnostics, and data upload. • Participate in software testing, verification, and validation. • Support machine integration, commissioning, troubleshooting, and issue resolution. Willingness to travel internationally (market introductions, troubleshooting). • Create and maintain technical documentation, such as software design documents, interface descriptions, test records, and release notes. • Follow software development processes, coding standards, version control and quality requirements. Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree or above in Automation, Electronics Engineering, Computer Science, Control Engineering, or a related field. • 3 or more years of embedded software development experience. • Solid programming skills in C/C++ and good understanding of embedded software development. Familiar with embedded software development tools and workflows, e.g. Eclipse, git etc. We develop on Microsoft Windows for Linux and bare-metal. • Interest in complete machines, and motivated to work in a multidisciplinary and international environment. • Good English reading, writing, and verbal communication skills for international collaboration and technical documentation. • Experience in embedded software development, real-time machine control software, signal processing and closed-loop control, communication networks (IP, CAN, Fieldbus, BLE), low-power embedded systems, relational databases (SQL) is a plus. • Experience with ARM processors, STMicroelectronics STM32, Texas Instruments MCUs, or similar microcontroller platforms is a plus. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel 2007, Bühler (Wuxi) Commercial Co., Ltd. è stata fondata a Wuxi, provincia di Jiangsu. Conduciamo il mercato della lavorazione e della lavorazione del grano, della produzione alimentare di consumo, della macinazione e della dispersione con i nostri vantaggi tecnologici avanzati. Abbiamo diversi centri di applicazione indipendenti e centri di assistenza clienti per fresatura, pasta, smistamento del colore, cibo di consumo, macinazione e dispersione, fornendo soluzioni integrate per catene industriali multiple. > Con la nostra visione di “Innovazioni per un mondo migliore”, ci impegniamo a sviluppare soluzioni più innovative sfruttando le risorse globali del Gruppo Bühler e sfruttando la localizzazione. Aufgaben:
• Sviluppare e mantenere il software di applicazione sulla piattaforma incorporata Linux di Bühler per il controllo della macchina, la logica di controllo di copertura, la gestione dei parametri, gli allarmi, la gestione dello stato e le interfacce della macchina.
• Sviluppare e mantenere il firmware per i sensori utilizzati sulle macchine Bühler, consentendo il rilevamento, la raccolta dei dati, l'elaborazione locale, la diagnostica e il caricamento dei dati.
• Partecipa a test software, verifica e validazione.
• Integrazione della macchina di supporto, messa in servizio, risoluzione dei problemi e risoluzione dei problemi. Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale (introduzione sul mercato, risoluzione dei problemi).
• Creare e mantenere la documentazione tecnica, come documenti di progettazione del software, descrizioni dell'interfaccia, record di prova e note di rilascio.
• Seguire processi di sviluppo software, standard di codifica, controllo della versione e requisiti di qualità. Anforderungen:
• Laurea o superiore in automazione, ingegneria elettronica, informatica, ingegneria di controllo, o un campo relativo.
• 3 o più anni di esperienza di sviluppo software incorporato.
• Competenze di programmazione solide in C/C++ e buona comprensione dello sviluppo software integrato. Familiare con strumenti di sviluppo software incorporati e flussi di lavoro, ad esempio Eclipse, git ecc. Ci sviluppiamo su Microsoft Windows per Linux e bare-metal.
• Interessi in macchine complete e motivati a lavorare in un ambiente multidisciplinare e internazionale.
• Buone capacità di lettura, scrittura e comunicazione verbale per la collaborazione internazionale e la documentazione tecnica.
• Esperienza nello sviluppo software integrato, software di controllo automatico in tempo reale, elaborazione del segnale e controllo a ciclo chiuso, reti di comunicazione (IP, CAN, Fieldbus, BLE), sistemi incorporati a bassa potenza, database relazionali (SQL) è un plus.
• Esperienza con processori ARM, STMicroelectronics STM32, Texas Instruments MCUs, o piattaforme microcontroller simili è un plus. Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine. Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

jobs.description:
The Executive Assistant to Regional President is a business-facing role, who supports the President in strategic analysis, business coordination, executive communication, stakeholder management and selected strategic projects. The role is not positioned as a traditional administrative assistant role, but as a value-added business support position to enhance leadership productivity and regional execution effectiveness.

Aufgaben:
- Strategic and Business Support
• Support the President in reviewing, consolidating and refining strategic perspectives for Greater China business topics.

• Prepare executive summaries based on large volumes of internal and external inputs, including business reports, market information, stakeholder feedback and strategic documents.

• Conduct business, market, industry, policy and competitor analysis to support management decision-making.

• Read, assimilate and summarize external inputs, including market trends, macroeconomic updates, regulatory changes and industry developments.

• Support the preparation, review and improvement of strategic presentations, management reports and professional slide decks for internal and external meetings.

• Support and coordinate M&A projects

• Regional President's Office Coordination

• Help establish and operate the President's Office as an effective working mechanism to support the President's productivity.

• Coordinate annual, quarterly, monthly and weekly business rhythms, management meetings and follow-up mechanisms.

• Maintain and follow up on key action lists, priorities, decisions and deliverables related to regional management topics.

• Prepare meeting minutes for strategic or business-critical meetings, formalize key decisions and coordinate follow-up actions.

• Support the setup and follow-up of regional company rhythms and align with relevant internal stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Management and Cross-cultural Communication

• Support communication and coordination between the President, Greater China Management Team, Group functions and Swiss / European stakeholders.

• Act as a cultural and business bridge between Greater China and European stakeholders.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with executive assistants, business leaders and relevant stakeholders at Group and regional levels.

• Support preparation for senior stakeholder visits, customer visits or Group representative visits from a business and cultural integration perspective.

• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment on key business topics and follow-up actions.

• Executive Communication and Presentation Support

• Draft, review and polish executive-level documents, presentations, meeting materials and formal communication.

• Prepare concise briefing notes before important meetings, stakeholder interactions or business reviews.

• Translate complex business information into structured, clear and actionable management insights.

• Support the President in preparing communication materials for internal management meetings, external engagements and Group-level discussions.

• Ensure quality, consistency and professionalism of documents and presentations.

• Strategic Project and Follow-up Management

• Support selected strategic projects on behalf of the President, including project tracking, research, coordination and follow-up.

• Engage with the Greater China Management Team on regional and Group-level strategic projects.

• Coordinate cross-functional inputs and ensure timely completion of agreed deliverables.

• Identify potential risks, bottlenecks or misalignments in project execution and escalate when necessary.

• Maintain structured documentation of key projects, meeting outcomes and action plans.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Management, Strategy or related disciplines.

• Master's degree, overseas education background, or combined business and engineering education is preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy, business analysis, corporate development, investment / M&A or project management.

• Consulting firm background is highly preferred; M&A, investment advisory or cross-border project experience is a strong advantage.

• Solid business analysis capability, including market research, industry analysis, competitor analysis and business case preparation.

• Experience in strategic planning, market entry, management reporting or executive-level decision support is preferred.

• Experience in preparing professional presentations, executive summaries, business reports, strategy documents or information memoranda is required.

• Prior exposure to China-Europe business environment, manufacturing, industrial technology, supply chain or B2B industries is preferred.

• Fluent Mandarin Chinese and English, both written and spoken.

• Able to prepare professional business documents, reports and presentations in English.

• Confident in communicating with senior stakeholders in a multicultural environment.

• Excellent MS Office skills, especially PowerPoint, Excel and Word.

• Proficient in using AI tools for research, document drafting, executive summaries, presentation refinement, translation and data interpretation.

• Able to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure accuracy, confidentiality, professionalism and business relevance.

• Strong structured thinking, problem-solving capability, business acumen and strategic sensitivity.

• Strong project management and follow-up skills; able to manage multiple priorities and drive tasks to closure.

• Strong stakeholder management capability; able to coordinate cross-functional, cross-cultural and senior-level stakeholders.

• Mature, reliable and highly professional, with strong discretion when handling confidential information.

• Proactive, accountable and learning-agile, with strong ownership and interest in business topics, strategy and organizational development.

• Resilient, adaptable and positive in a complex and fast-changing environment; willing to take this role as a career development opportunity.

• In grado di preparare documenti aziendali professionali, report e presentazioni in inglese.

• Capacità di MS Office eccellenti, in particolare PowerPoint, Excel e Word.

• Proficiente nell'utilizzo di strumenti AI per la ricerca, la redazione di documenti, i riassunti esecutivi, la raffinatezza di presentazione, la traduzione e l'interpretazione dei dati.

descriptionByLocale.en:
The Executive Assistant to Regional President is a business-facing role, who supports the President in strategic analysis, business coordination, executive communication, stakeholder management and selected strategic projects. The role is not positioned as a traditional administrative assistant role, but as a value-added business support position to enhance leadership productivity and regional execution effectiveness.

Aufgaben:
- Strategic and Business Support
• Support the President in reviewing, consolidating and refining strategic perspectives for Greater China business topics.

• Prepare executive summaries based on large volumes of internal and external inputs, including business reports, market information, stakeholder feedback and strategic documents.

• Conduct business, market, industry, policy and competitor analysis to support management decision-making.

• Read, assimilate and summarize external inputs, including market trends, macroeconomic updates, regulatory changes and industry developments.

• Support the preparation, review and improvement of strategic presentations, management reports and professional slide decks for internal and external meetings.

• Support and coordinate M&A projects

• Regional President's Office Coordination

• Help establish and operate the President's Office as an effective working mechanism to support the President's productivity.

• Coordinate annual, quarterly, monthly and weekly business rhythms, management meetings and follow-up mechanisms.

• Maintain and follow up on key action lists, priorities, decisions and deliverables related to regional management topics.

• Prepare meeting minutes for strategic or business-critical meetings, formalize key decisions and coordinate follow-up actions.

• Support the setup and follow-up of regional company rhythms and align with relevant internal stakeholders.

• Stakeholder Management and Cross-cultural Communication

• Support communication and coordination between the President, Greater China Management Team, Group functions and Swiss / European stakeholders.

• Act as a cultural and business bridge between Greater China and European stakeholders.

• Establish and maintain effective working relationships with executive assistants, business leaders and relevant stakeholders at Group and regional levels.

• Support preparation for senior stakeholder visits, customer visits or Group representative visits from a business and cultural integration perspective.

• Coordinate with internal and external stakeholders to ensure alignment on key business topics and follow-up actions.

• Executive Communication and Presentation Support

• Draft, review and polish executive-level documents, presentations, meeting materials and formal communication.

• Prepare concise briefing notes before important meetings, stakeholder interactions or business reviews.

• Translate complex business information into structured, clear and actionable management insights.

• Support the President in preparing communication materials for internal management meetings, external engagements and Group-level discussions.

• Ensure quality, consistency and professionalism of documents and presentations.

• Strategic Project and Follow-up Management

• Support selected strategic projects on behalf of the President, including project tracking, research, coordination and follow-up.

• Engage with the Greater China Management Team on regional and Group-level strategic projects.

• Coordinate cross-functional inputs and ensure timely completion of agreed deliverables.

• Identify potential risks, bottlenecks or misalignments in project execution and escalate when necessary.

• Maintain structured documentation of key projects, meeting outcomes and action plans.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree or above in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Industrial Engineering, Management, Strategy or related disciplines.

• Master's degree, overseas education background, or combined business and engineering education is preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in management consulting, strategy, business analysis, corporate development, investment / M&A or project management.

• Consulting firm background is highly preferred; M&A, investment advisory or cross-border project experience is a strong advantage.

• Solid business analysis capability, including market research, industry analysis, competitor analysis and business case preparation.

• Experience in strategic planning, market entry, management reporting or executive-level decision support is preferred.

• Experience in preparing professional presentations, executive summaries, business reports, strategy documents or information memoranda is required.

• Prior exposure to China-Europe business environment, manufacturing, industrial technology, supply chain or B2B industries is preferred.

• Fluent Mandarin Chinese and English, both written and spoken.

• Able to prepare professional business documents, reports and presentations in English.

• Confident in communicating with senior stakeholders in a multicultural environment.

• Excellent MS Office skills, especially PowerPoint, Excel and Word.

• Proficient in using AI tools for research, document drafting, executive summaries, presentation refinement, translation and data interpretation.

• Able to critically evaluate AI-generated outputs and ensure accuracy, confidentiality, professionalism and business relevance.

• Strong structured thinking, problem-solving capability, business acumen and strategic sensitivity.

• Strong project management and follow-up skills; able to manage multiple priorities and drive tasks to closure.

• Strong stakeholder management capability; able to coordinate cross-functional, cross-cultural and senior-level stakeholders.

• Mature, reliable and highly professional, with strong discretion when handling confidential information.

• Proactive, accountable and learning-agile, with strong ownership and interest in business topics, strategy and organizational development.

• Resilient, adaptable and positive in a complex and fast-changing environment; willing to take this role as a career development opportunity.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the areas of grain processing and malt & brewing.
This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including conveying equipment and ship loading), storage and digitization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with the focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

Start your apprenticeship at Bühler in Beilngries and look forward to:
  • Starting bonus 500, - Euro + additional bonuses for your good performance
  • 1 week of paid learning leave
  • Azubi car for trips to vocational school
  • Exciting apprenticeship projects and excursions
  • Corporate benefits for many shops
  • International open doors thanks to our locations around the world

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. jobs.description:
We're looking for a Mechanical Designer with 3-5 years of experience who can support design work from concept to execution to meet project specifications, optimize design quality and usability, and work closely with cross-functional teams to achieve efficient, manufacturable, and high-value engineering outcomes.

Aufgaben:
• Produce high-quality deliverables such as equipment models and manufacturing drawings using Autodesk Inventor.

• Generate sales drawings using Inventor and AutoCAD.

• Ensure technical compliance and proper fit and function.

• Present work clearly - sharing rationale, incorporating feedback, and driving toward decisions.

• Manage workload priorities to adhere to budget constraints and project timelines.

• Resolve discrepancies that occur during the design and manufacture of Buhler equipment.

• Perform inspections of components, work-in-process, and finished equipment.

• Organize information on project specific SharePoint sites.

• Actively participate in project meetings with cross-functional team members, suppliers, and/or customers.

• Complete design related tasks resulting from equipment installation issues at customer site.

Anforderungen:
Job Specifications
 (Required education and experience)

• Bachelor's Degree in Mechanical Engineering or equivalent

• 3-5 years of relevant work experience

PREFERRED SKILLS

• Proficient in engineering drafting/drawings and engineering principles.

• Working knowledge of manufacturing and assembly practices, e.g. welding, sheet metal forming, press operations, etc.

• Awareness of machine safety codes and designing equipment for the food industry.

• Understanding of GD&T

• Autodesk Inventor and AutoCAD

• PTC Windchill

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.

jobs.description:

Experience in a manufacturing environment with the ability to read drawings and specifications for machining, fabrication, and assembly.

Sputtering Components Inc. (SCI) in Owatonna is a business in southern Minnesota that has served customers all around the world for over 20 years. jobs.title: CNC Machinist
jobs.description:
Sputtering Components Inc. (SCI) in Owatonna is a business in southern Minnesota that has served customers all around the world for over 20 years. Our thin film technologies are used in vacuum coating systems to make windows, smartphones, display screens, solar panels, automobile components, decorative hardware and more.

As a CNC Machinist, you'll take ownership of complex machining assignments, working independently to produce high-quality components while ensuring production goals are met efficiently and safely. You'll have the opportunity to collaborate with experienced engineers on both production and research & development projects, giving you exposure to a variety of challenging and rewarding work. Aufgaben: • Produce a quality product in an efficient manner • Accurately translate blueprints to manufacture parts • Follow all work orders and travelers that the company will provide • Follow all quality standards that are set by the company • Follow all safety rules • Maintain a clean, organized, and debris free work area • Accurately preform setups in the CNC machines on their own • Practice lean manufacturing skills in all areas of the shop • Maintain a positive attitude and strive for continual improvement • Reduce manufacturing costs when possible • Remain proactive at all time • Master Cam knowledge or willing to learn • Basic ability to read and program using G & M codes at the controller • Ability to make their own fixturing and vise jaws • Willing to train other team members Anforderungen: • Produce a quality product in an efficient manner Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
