descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita sostenibile. Nell'ambito del Gruppo Bühler globale, stiamo sviluppando sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia per applicazioni nell'industria ottica, automotive, medicale ed elettronica da oltre 150 anni. Presso la nostra sede di Alzenau, i team internazionali stanno lavorando a soluzioni innovative per i clienti di tutto il mondo. Puoi aspettarti interessanti approfondimenti sugli acquisti operativi e strategici, sui vari compiti e sulla possibilità di partecipare attivamente ai progetti e di acquisire una preziosa esperienza pratica in una società tecnologica internazionale. Facciamo la differenza a Bühler insieme! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Sosterrete il nostro team di acquisto in progetti operativi e strategici emozionanti e ottenere una panoramica completa dei processi di acquisto moderni.

• Siete attivamente coinvolti nel business quotidiano e nel sostegno alle offerte, offrire confronti e la preparazione dei negoziati.

• Siete in contatto diretto con i nostri fornitori internazionali e partecipate ai negoziati sui prezzi e sui contratti.

• Raccogli le tue idee per ottimizzare i processi di acquisto e supportare la loro implementazione insieme ai dipartimenti specializzati.

• Crea analisi e valutazioni e contribuisce così alle decisioni di acquisto informate.

Requisiti
• Sei uno studente iscritto (m/f/d) di amministrazione aziendale, economia, ingegneria industriale o un programma di laurea comparabile.

• Si desidera acquisire esperienza pratica in una società di tecnologia di successo a livello internazionale e sono interessati ad acquistare, supply chain o contesti aziendali.

• Lavori in modo indipendente, cosciente e ti piace assumerti la responsabilità.

• Hai una buona conoscenza di MS Office, in particolare di Excel; Prima conoscenza di SAP è un vantaggio.

• Comunichi in modo sicuro in tedesco e ti senti a tuo agio nello scambio con diversi contatti.

• Convinci attraverso lo spirito di squadra, la volontà di imparare e una mentalità proattiva.

Offriamo:
Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Posti di lavoro diversi e inclusivi
Promuoviamo una cultura inclusiva che valorizza la nostra diversità globale. Il rispetto e l'empatia garantiscono che tutti si sentano al sicuro e possano fare del loro meglio.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and sustainable growth. As part of the global Bühler Group, we have been developing high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems for applications in the optics, automotive, medical and electronics industries for more than 150 years. At our location in Alzenau, international teams are working on innovative solutions for customers around the world.

To support our purchasing team, we are looking for a working student (m/f/d). You can expect exciting insights into operational and strategic purchasing, varied tasks and the opportunity to actively participate in projects and gain valuable practical experience in an international technology company.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You will support our purchasing team in exciting operational and strategic projects and get a comprehensive insight into modern purchasing processes. • You are actively involved in day-to-day business and support in tenders, offer comparisons and the preparation of negotiations. • You are in direct contact with our international suppliers and participate in price and contract negotiations. • You bring your own ideas to optimize purchasing processes and support their implementation together with the specialist departments. • You create analyses and evaluations and thus contribute to informed purchasing decisions. Requirements • You are an enrolled student (m/f/d) of business administration, economics, industrial engineering or a comparable degree program. • You want to gain practical experience in an internationally successful technology company and are interested in purchasing, supply chain or business contexts. • You work independently, conscientiously and like to take responsibility. • You have good knowledge of MS Office, especially Excel; First SAP knowledge is a plus. • You communicate safely in German and feel comfortable in the exchange with different contacts. • You convince through team spirit, willingness to learn and a proactive hands-on mentality. We offer: Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Diverse and inclusive workplace We promote an inclusive culture that values our global diversity. Respect and empathy ensure that everyone feels safe and can do their best. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Dans le cadre du Groupe Bühler mondial, nous développons depuis plus de 150 ans des systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie pour des applications dans les secteurs de l'optique, de l'automobile, de la médecine et de l'électronique. À notre emplacement à Alzenau, les équipes internationales travaillent sur des solutions innovantes pour les clients du monde entier.

Pour soutenir notre équipe d'achat, nous recherchons un étudiant en activité (h/f/d). Vous pouvez vous attendre à des renseignements passionnants sur les achats opérationnels et stratégiques, les tâches variées et la possibilité de participer activement à des projets et d'acquérir une expérience pratique précieuse dans une entreprise technologique internationale.

Faisons une différence à Bühler ensemble!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.

De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.

C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. • Hai una buona conoscenza di inglese e tedesco

Offriamo:
Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Benvenuti in un mondo di oltre 16.000 opportunità per educare te stesso!

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.
We are looking for a motivated working student (m/f/d) who will strengthen our team in Alzenau with energy and commitment. In the field of semiconductors, we design photonics and drive innovations in the field of semiconductors. Become part of our team and help us develop solutions for our business partners.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You support CRM management and maintain and manage accounts, contacts, leads and opportunities in the CRM system • You coordinate sample shipments and coatings, track appointments and create or maintain the corresponding shipping documents • You take over the maintenance of the specification database and ensure the up-to-date and structure of the content • You work in the creation and revision of product texts and agree Stay close to product managers • You support conference and deadline management and keep an eye on important deadlines and deadlines • You support the creation of calculations Requirements • You are an enrolled student ideally in Business Engineering, International Technical Sales Management, Business Administration or a comparable degree program • You work carefully and structured, have an organizational skill and a high level of initiative • You are confident in dealing with the common MS Office programs (further tools such as CRM systems are an advantage) • You have very good knowledge of English and German • You are interested in sales processes and the market or competitive environment We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Learning platform Welcome to a world of over 16,000 opportunities to educate yourself! descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei principali produttori di sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni, abbiamo offerto ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di attrezzature per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, occhiali, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medica e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e implementare con successo progetti complessi. > Stiamo cercando uno studente motivato (m/f/d) che rafforzerà il nostro team ad Alzenau con energia e impegno. Il nostro collega desiderato (m/f/d) è caratterizzato dall'affidabilità e non ha esitazione ad assumere autonomamente i compiti e ad assumersi la responsabilità dei progetti. Sfrutta la tua occasione e entra a far parte di Bühler Alzenau GmbH! Facciamo una differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Sei principalmente responsabile di garantire e migliorare continuamente la qualità dei dati CRM (completezza, coerenza, tempestività)

• Mantenere, avviare e aggiornare i dati dei clienti e dei contatti (compresi i controlli duplicati, i controlli dei dati, i controlli di coerenza)

• Contribuisci alla definizione e all'attuazione delle regole di qualità dei dati e crei linee guida semplici e pratiche per gli utenti

• Supporti l'ulteriore sviluppo e l'ottimizzazione dei processi CRM per garantire una qualità dei dati sostenibile

• Supporti presentazioni interne (Sales & Product Management): È possibile creare / ottimizzare le diapositive PowerPoint nel design aziendale, consolidare gli input e mantenere i modelli

• Sostiene la ricerca sul mercato, sui clienti e sulla concorrenza e riassume le informazioni rilevanti in brevi e significativi approfondimenti

Requisiti
• Sei uno studente iscritto idealmente in ingegneria aziendale, analisi di dati/business, marketing o un programma di laurea comparabile

• Lavori attentamente e strutturato e hai un'alta affinità per dati e dettagli

• Sei sicuro di utilizzare Excel e PowerPoint (altri strumenti come sistemi CRM, Power BI o simili sono un vantaggio)

• Hai ottime competenze tedesche e buone abilitÃ inglese molto buone

• Sei interessato ai processi di vendita e al mercato o all'ambiente competitivo

Offriamo:
Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.
We are looking for a motivated working student (m/f/d) who will strengthen our team in Alzenau with energy and commitment. Our desired colleague (m/f/d) is characterized by reliability and has no hesitation to independently take on tasks and bear responsibility for projects. Take your chance and become part of Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You are primarily responsible for ensuring and continuously improving CRM data quality (completeness, consistency, timeliness) • You maintain, initiate and update customer and contact data (including duplicate checks, data checks, consistency checks) • You contribute to the definition and implementation of data quality rules and create simple, practical guidelines for users • You support the further development and optimization of CRM processes to ensure sustainably high data quality • You support internal presentations (Sales & Product Management): You create/optimize PowerPoint slides in the corporate design, consolidate inputs and maintain templates • You support market, customer and competition research and summarize relevant information in short, meaningful insights Requirements • You are an enrolled student ideally in business engineering, data/business analytics, marketing or a comparable degree program • You work carefully and structured and have a high affinity for data and details • You are confident in using Excel and PowerPoint (other tools such as CRM systems, Power BI or similar are an advantage) • You have very good German skills as well as good to very good English skills • You are interested in sales processes and the market or competitive environment We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei principali produttori di sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni sviluppiamo soluzioni per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, lenti per occhiali e componenti ottici per smartphone, veicoli e tecnologia medica. Il nostro team internazionale fissa ogni giorno nuovi standard e implementa progetti impegnativi. > > Per il nostro team HR ad Alzenau stiamo cercando uno specialista di payroll dedicato (m/f/d) come rappresentante del congedo parentale. Si prende il sopravvento e vari compiti nell'amministrazione del personale. Con il vostro approccio attento e orientato al servizio, assicurate il servizio HR professionale e i processi HR lisci. Facciamo una differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Essi sono responsabili per l'attuazione tempestiva e il monitoraggio della fatturazione mensile, compresi tutti i processi amministrativi successivi.

• Essi supervisionano l'amministrazione del personale lungo il ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, dalla manutenzione dei dati master all'ingresso e all'uscita all'amministrazione di pensione parziale, pensioni e pensioni professionali.

• Creano report e valutazioni HR-relevant da SAP e accompagnano audit interni ed esterni.

• Sei attivamente coinvolto in progetti HR e payroll e supporta il miglioramento continuo e la standardizzazione dei processi.

• Guidano la digitalizzazione dei processi delle risorse umane e agiscono come SAP Super Users per il dipartimento.

Requisiti
• Essi hanno completato la formazione commerciale, idealmente con ulteriore formazione in risorse umane, payroll o una qualificazione comparabile.

• Essi portano diversi anni di esperienza professionale nel libro paga, così come la conoscenza profonda di payroll fiscale e diritto di sicurezza sociale.

• Hanno una buona conoscenza dell'utente in SAP HCM, idealmente anche in SuccessFactors, così come nelle applicazioni di MS Office comuni, in particolare Excel.

• Essi lavorano in modo indipendente, strutturato e affidabile e sono caratterizzati da un elevato grado di responsabilità, discrezione e orientamento al servizio.

• Essi sono forti nella comunicazione, godere di lavorare in un team e godere di ottimizzare i processi e plasmare attivamente la digitalizzazione nel settore delle risorse umane.

Offriamo:
Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Cultura aziendale familiare
Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine – in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been developing solutions for the coating of architectural glass, spectacle lenses and optical components for smartphones, vehicles and medical technology. Our international team sets new standards every day and implements challenging projects.

For our HR team in Alzenau we are looking for a dedicated payroll specialist (m/f/d) as a parental leave representative. You take over the payroll and various tasks in the personnel administration. With your careful and service-oriented approach, you ensure professional HR service and smooth HR processes.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • They are responsible for the timely implementation and monitoring of the monthly billing including all subsequent administrative processes. • They supervise personnel administration along the Employee Lifecycle, from master data maintenance to entry and exit to administration of partial retirement, pensions and occupational pensions. • They create HR-relevant reports and evaluations from SAP and accompany internal and external audits. • You are actively involved in HR and payroll projects and support the continuous improvement and standardization of processes. • They drive the digitalization of human resources processes and act as SAP Super Users for the department. Requirements • They have completed commercial training, ideally with further training in human resources, payroll or a comparable qualification. • They bring several years of professional experience in payroll as well as profound knowledge of payroll tax and social security law. • They have good user knowledge in SAP HCM, ideally also in SuccessFactors, as well as in the common MS Office applications, especially Excel. • They work independently, structured and reliable and are characterized by a high degree of responsibility, discretion and service orientation. • They are strong in communication, enjoy working in a team and enjoy optimising processes and actively shaping digitalisation in the human resources sector. We offer: Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term – in innovation, our employees and economic success. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

jobs.description:
Am Standort Beilngries widmen sich rund 360 Mitarbeitende im Geschäftsbereich Grain Quality and Supply dem Anlagen- und Maschinenbau rund um die Themen Getreideverarbeitung sowie Mälzen & Brauen.
Dies umfasst die Reinigung, Trocknung, den Transport (inkl. Fördertechnik und Schiffsbeladung), die Lagerung und Digitalisierung, um Getreide vom Feld bis zum Verbraucher zu verarbeiten. Immer mit dem Fokus auf Effizienz, Produktqualität und Nachhaltigkeit.

Starte deine Ausbildung bei Bühler in Beilngries und freu dich auf:
• Startprämie 500, - Euro + zusätzliche Prämien für deine guten Leistungen
• Azubi-Auto für Fahrten zur Berufsschule
• 1 Woche bezahlter Lernurlaub
• Spannende Azubi-Projekte und Ausflüge
• Mitarbeitervergünstigungen für viele Shops
• International offene Türen nach deinem Abschluss dank unserer Standorte auf der ganzen Welt

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Als Konstruktionsmechaniker (m/w/d) bist du für die Erstellung der Bauteile unserer Maschinen und Anlagen zuständig. • Nach einigen Wochen in der Lehrwerkstatt wirst du alle Bereiche unserer Fertigung kennenlernen und schnell im Auftragsgeschäft aktiv mitarbeiten. • Unsere Ausbildung ist sehr vielfältig und bietet dir einen perfekten Einstieg in das Berufsleben. • Die Ausbildung dauert i.d.R. 3,5 Jahre, die Berufsschule ist in Eichstätt. Anforderungen: • Du interessierst dich für Technik, hast ein gutes räumliches Vorstellungsvermögen und handwerkliches Geschick. • Außerdem bist du engagiert und zuverlässig, Teamarbeit macht dir Spaß. • Mit dem Mittelschulabschluss und guten Noten in Mathematik, sowie den naturwissenschaftlichen Fächern, bist du bei uns genau richtig. Und nach der Ausbildung? • Dieser Beruf bietet ein sehr breites Feld an Chancen nach der Ausbildung. • Du kannst als Konstruktionsmechaniker in unserer Fertigung arbeiten oder als Monteur „die große Freiheit“ auf Baustellen weltweit kennenlernen. • Wenn du dich noch weiterbilden möchtest (z.B. Industriemeister, Techniker, Maschinenbaustudium oder Ähnliches), bietet dir Bühler dabei Unterstützung an. Wir bieten: • Familiäre Unternehmenskultur • Wir haben eine mehr als 160-jährige Geschichte. Damit sind wir ein Unternehmen, das langfristig denkt und investiert - bei Innovationen, unseren Mitarbeitenden und dem wirtschaftlichen Erfolg. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Mitarbeitendenvorteile und Rabatte Geniessen Sie eine Vielzahl von Mitarbeitendenvorteilen und Ermässigungen, die Ihren Alltag erleichtern. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und erfahren Sie mehr. Grossartiger Kaffee und frisches Obst Geniessen Sie unsere Annehmlichkeiten, wie kostenlosen Premium-Kaffee und frisches Obst - für Ihren perfekten Start in den Tag! Angebote für Gesundheit und Wohlbefinden Wir bieten eine Reihe von Gesundheits- und Wohlfühlangeboten, die Sie dabei unterstützen, sich körperlich und geistig wohl zu fühlen. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden. Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen. Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Nel sito Beilngries, circa 360 dipendenti della divisione Grain Quality and Supply sono dedicati all'ingegneria vegetale e meccanica nei settori della lavorazione del grano e della produzione di malto e produzione. > Ciò include la pulizia, l'essiccazione, il trasporto (comprese le attrezzature di trasporto e il carico delle navi), lo stoccaggio e la digitalizzazione per elaborare il grano dal campo al consumatore. Sempre con l'obiettivo di efficienza, qualità del prodotto e sostenibilità. > > Avvia il tuo apprendistato a Bühler in Beilngries e non esitare a: Auto da traino per viaggi alla scuola professionale Progetti di tirocinanti ed escursioni emozionanti Facciamo la differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Come meccanico di costruzione (m/f/d), siete responsabili della creazione dei componenti delle nostre macchine e impianti.
• Dopo alcune settimane nel workshop, si arriva a conoscere tutte le aree della nostra produzione e partecipare attivamente al business contract.
• La nostra formazione è molto diversificata e vi offre un ingresso perfetto nella vita professionale.
• La formazione di solito dura 3,5 anni, la scuola professionale è in Eichstätt.

Requisiti
• Siete interessati alla tecnologia, hanno una buona immaginazione spaziale e l'artigianato.
• Inoltre, siete impegnati e affidabili, il lavoro di squadra è divertente.
• Con la laurea di scuola media e buoni voti in matematica, così come i soggetti di scienze naturali, si è esattamente a destra con noi.

E dopo l'allenamento?

• Questa professione offre un campo molto ampio di opportunità dopo la formazione.
• È possibile lavorare come meccanico di costruzione (m/f/d) nella nostra produzione o conoscere “la grande libertà” come un infisso esterno.
• Se vuoi continuare la tua formazione (ad esempio master industriale, tecnico, ingegneria meccanica o simili), Bühler ti offre il supporto.

Offriamo:
• Cultura aziendale familiare
• Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine – in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Ottimo caffè e frutta fresca
Godetevi i nostri servizi, come caffè premium gratuito e frutta fresca - per il vostro perfetto inizio della giornata!

Servizi di salute e benessere
Offriamo una gamma di offerte di salute e benessere per aiutarti a sentirti fisicamente e mentalmente confortevole.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.
descriptionByLocale.en:
At the Beilngries site, around 360 employees in the Grain Quality and Supply division are dedicated to plant and mechanical engineering in the areas of grain processing and malt & brewing.
This includes cleaning, drying, transport (including conveying equipment and ship loading), storage and digitization to process grain from the field to the consumer. Always with the focus on efficiency, product quality and sustainability.

Start your apprenticeship at Bühler in Beilngries and look forward to:
• Starting bonus 500, - Euro + additional bonuses for your good performance
• Trainee car for trips to vocational school
• 1 week of paid learning leave
• Exciting trainee projects and excursions
• Employee benefits for many shops
• Internationally open doors after graduation thanks to our locations all over the world

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • As a construction mechanic (m/f/d), you are responsible for the creation of the components of our machines and plants. • After a few weeks in the workshop, you will get to know all areas of our production and quickly actively participate in the contract business. • Our training is very diverse and offers you a perfect entry into professional life. • The training usually lasts 3.5 years, the vocational school is in Eichstätt. Requirements • You are interested in technology, have a good spatial imagination and craftsmanship. • In addition, you are committed and reliable, teamwork is fun. • With the middle school degree and good grades in mathematics, as well as the natural science subjects, you are exactly right with us. And after the training? • This profession offers a very broad field of opportunities after training. • You can work as a construction mechanic (m/f/d) in our production or get to know “the great freedom” as an outdoor fitter. • If you want to continue your education (e.g. industrial master, technician, mechanical engineering degree or similar), Bühler offers you support. We offer: • Family business culture • We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term – in innovation, our employees and economic success. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Great coffee and fresh fruit Enjoy our amenities, such as free premium coffee and fresh fruit - for your perfect start to the day! Health and well-being services We offer a range of health and wellness offerings to help you feel physically and mentally comfortable. Two billion people eat food produced at Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Sur le site de Beilngries, environ 360 employés de la division Qualité et approvisionnement des grains sont dédiés à l'ingénierie des installations et de la mécanique dans les domaines de la transformation des grains et du malt & brassage.
Cela comprend le nettoyage, le séchage, le transport (y compris l'équipement de transport et le chargement des navires), l'entreposage et la numérisation pour traiter le grain du champ au consommateur. Toujours en mettant l'accent sur l'efficacité, la qualité des produits et la durabilité.

Commencez votre apprentissage chez Bühler à Beilngries et attendez avec impatience:
• Prime de départ 500, - Euro + bonus supplémentaires pour votre bonne performance
• Voiture de stagiaire pour les voyages à l'école professionnelle
• 1 semaine de congé d'apprentissage rémunéré
• Projets et excursions passionnants pour les stagiaires
• Avantages sociaux pour de nombreux magasins
• Portes ouvertes à l'échelle internationale après l'obtention du diplôme grâce à nos emplacements partout dans le monde

Faisons la différence ensemble à Bühler!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • En tant que mécanicien de construction (m/f/d), vous êtes responsable de la création des composants de nos machines et de nos usines. • Après quelques semaines dans l'atelier, vous apprendrez à connaître tous les domaines de notre production et participer rapidement activement à l'entreprise contractuelle. • Notre formation est très diversifiée et vous offre une entrée parfaite dans la vie professionnelle. • La formation dure généralement 3,5 ans, l'école professionnelle est à Eichstätt. Exigences • Vous êtes intéressé par la technologie, avez une bonne imagination spatiale et l'artisanat. • En outre, vous êtes engagé et fiable, le travail d'équipe est amusant. • Avec le diplôme d'études secondaires et de bonnes notes en mathématiques, ainsi que les sujets de sciences naturelles, vous avez exactement raison avec nous. Et après l'entraînement ? • Cette profession offre un champ très large d'opportunités après la formation. • Vous pouvez travailler comme mécanicien de construction (m/f/d) dans notre production ou apprendre à connaître la grande liberté en tant qu'installateur extérieur. • Si vous souhaitez poursuivre vos études (par exemple, master industriel, technicien, diplôme en génie mécanique ou similaire), Bühler vous offre un support. Nous offrons: • Culture des entreprises familiales • Nous avons plus de 160 ans d'histoire. Cela fait de nous une entreprise qui pense et investit à long terme – dans l'innovation, nos employés et la réussite économique. Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons fêter ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables. Avantages sociaux et rabais Profitez d'une variété d'avantages sociaux et de réductions qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne. Faites partie de notre équipe et en savoir plus. Grand café et fruits frais Profitez de nos commodités, comme le café premium gratuit et les fruits frais - pour votre début parfait de la journée! Services de santé et de bien-être Nous offrons une gamme d'offres de santé et de bien-être pour vous aider à vous sentir physiquement et mentalement à l'aise. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler. Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité. Nous voulons innover pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble.

Aufgaben: • Fachliche Leitung des Bereichs Quality, Environment, Health & Safety • Disziplinarische Führung der Quality Engineers der Produktion • Wahrnehmung der Funktion als Qualitätsmanagementbeauftragter (QMB) • Strategische Weiterentwicklung und Überwachung des integrierten Managementsystems • Sicherstellung der Anforderungen nach DIN EN ISO 9001 • Beratung der Geschäftsleitung und der Fachbereiche in allen QEHS-relevanten Fragestellungen • Festlegung, Überwachung und Weiterentwicklung von Qualitäts-, Umwelt- und Arbeitsschutzzielen • Planung, Durchführung und Nachbereitung interner und externer Audits • Vorbereitung und Begleitung von Zertifizierungs- und Überwachungsaudits • Erstellung von Managementbewertungen sowie regelmäßige Berichterstattung an die Geschäftsleitung • Analyse von Qualitätsabweichungen, Reklamationen, Umweltvorfällen und Arbeitsunfällen • Koordination von Ursachenanalysen sowie Korrektur- und Vorbeugemaßnahmen • Weiterentwicklung des Reklamationsmanagements und Bearbeitung komplexer Kunden- und Lieferantenreklamationen • Steuerung von kontinuierlichen Verbesserungsprozessen und QEHS-Projekten • Definition, jobs.title: IT Process Specialist
jobs.description:
Join our team as an IT Process Specialist, where you'll play a key role in shaping and improving the business processes that drive our organization. Leveraging your SAP expertise, you'll collaborate with cross-functional teams to analyze, standardize, and continuously enhance end-to-end processes, helping create efficient, scalable solutions that support business growth. This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys solving complex challenges, driving operational excellence, and making a lasting impact through technology and process improvement.

Aufgaben:
• Supporting processes and applications (focus in SAP) in North America.

• Supporting implementation and training for SAP modules and related applications.

• Supporting rollouts of SAP in North America as part of the international SAP Team.

• Developing relationships and works closely with relevant stakeholders both business and IT to evaluate and interpret business requirements.

• Represent/lead discussions related to process and application.

• Participates in testing of new functionality as well as regression testing for new rollouts and new functionality.

• Coordinates and conducts implementation tasks.

• Support super users with daily problems, also across different departments.

• Close collaboration with regional process mangers.

• Regional process and data flow improvements.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science/Engineering or equivalent.

• Minimum 3 years' experience.

• Very good knowledge of SAP (MM, PP)

• Project Lead experience is a plus.

• Excellent communication skills.

• High motivation and high-quality standards.

• Project Management expertise is a plus.

• Strong knowledge in integrated processes.

• Has an understanding of how to proceed systematically/ methodically.

• Fluency in Spanish or Portuguese is considered an advantage.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.

• Perform onsite inspection, installation and commissioning of equipment / machines, troubleshooting and customer training of Buhler products.

• Perform automation and/or electrical remote support when required by customer.

• Promote and support after sales activities with active spare parts and retrofit upgrade sales.

• Support Sales team in term of technical, investigations and site visiting.

• Standby for requisitions from internal & external.

• Liaise with production sites and regional team for technical support and back up.

• Regular communication with customer representatives from technician to management level.

• Prepare written reports in full details of the service activities including pictures and explanation of the trouble process.

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering or related field

• Minimum of 3 years of experience in the process industry and automation & electrical engineering

• Technical knowledge to understand customer needs: Sufficient technical background to understand client processes, not only machines but overall transformation process and operations processes

• Knowledge of sales and service in process engineering operations to recommend customers in Buhler products

Bühler Leybold Optics est synonyme de technologies innovantes et de croissance soutenue. Dans le cadre du groupe Bühler, un groupe d'ingénierie mondial comptant plus de 13 000 employés, nous sommes l'un des principaux fabricants de systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous offrons à nos clients une large gamme d'équipements pour le revêtement de verre architectural, de lunettes, de composants optiques dans les smartphones, les voitures, la technologie médicale et bien plus encore. Notre équipe internationale réussit à établir de nouvelles normes chaque jour et à mettre en œuvre avec succès des projets complexes.
Nous recherchons un gestionnaire de projet junior hautement motivé (h/f/d) qui soutiendra activement notre équipe à Alzenau. Notre collègue souhaité (h/f/d) convainc par son engagement et sa force de communication et n'a pas peur des nouveaux défis. Prenez votre chance et devenez partie du monde Bühler!

Deux milliards de personnes mangent des aliments produits par les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.

布勒莱宝光学设备（北京）有限公司，是德国布勒莱宝光学在北京设立的独资子公司，目前是布勒集团高真空镀膜设备全球两大生产制造基地之一。布勒莱宝光学的业务涉及光学以及能源镀膜两大类业务领域，为中国的精密光学、视光学、汽车、半导体、柔性电子、建筑玻璃等行业的发展做出了贡献。
Bühler Leybold Optics is a wholly owned subsidiary of Bühler Leybold Optics in Beijing and is currently one of the two global manufacturing bases for high vacuum coating equipment of the Bühler Group. The business of Bühler Leybold Optics covers two major business fields: optics and large area coating, contributing to the development of the precision optics, optics, automotive, semiconductor, flexible electronics and architectural glass industries in China. Aufgaben: • 1. 负责 IBT（离子束校平）及 IBF（离子束抛光 / 修正）工艺的全流程开发与持续优化，编制工艺流程、工艺规范（Spec）、工艺配方（Recipe）等文件； • 2. 设计并执行工艺测试方案，定位并解决测试过程中的工艺异常； • 3. 负责样品的表面形貌/膜厚的测量及表征，分析测量数据并追溯偏差来源，推动工艺改进； • 4. 基于离子源工作原理，根据工艺需求调节离子源参数特性（束流、能量、均匀性等），维护离子源设备稳定运行并排查相关异常； • 5. 结合客户工艺要求选择适配的测试方法，确保交付指标满足客户 Spec，参与客户技术交流并提供工艺层面专业支持。 Anforderungen: • 1. 博士研究生学历，物理学相关专业； • 2.具有5 年以上IBT/IBF工艺开发经验； • 3. 精通离子源工作原理，具备离子源参数调节与优化能力，能够建立离子源参数与工艺效果之间的量化关系； • 4. 熟悉 IBT/IBF 或相关离子束加工工艺，具备工艺开发实际经验，理解设备算法原理并能对测量结果进行判读与修正； • 5.了解多轴运动系统基础机械原理，运动学坐标转换； • 6. 掌握多种表面形貌/膜厚测试方法，可以熟练使用测试设备（如椭偏仪），能够根据客户需求和材料特性选择适配的测试方案； • 7. 英语熟练，可作为工作语言进行跨国技术沟通与文档撰写； • 8. 具备较强的问题分析与独立解决能力，能够独立承担工艺研发课题，自学能力强。 Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.description:
Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 12.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der führenden Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es täglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen einen motivierten Auszubildenden (m/w/d), der unser Team in Alzenau tatkräftig unterstützt. Du bist engagiert, zuverlässig und möchtest eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen? Dann bewerbe dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams!

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Aufgaben: • Während deiner Ausbildung zum Industriekaufmann bzw. zur Industriekauffrau (m/w/d) lernst du die vielseitige Welt eines international tätigen Unternehmens kennen. • Du durchläufst spannende Bereiche wie Einkauf, Kundensupport und Finanzwesen und erhältst dabei umfassende Einblicke in kaufmännische und betriebswirtschaftliche Abläufe. • Du entwickelst deine Kenntnisse in Fremdsprachen, digitalen Anwendungen sowie Präsentations- und Kommunikationstechniken kontinuierlich weiter. • In abteilungsübergreifenden Projekten bringst du deine Ideen aktiv ein und übernimmst von Anfang an Verantwortung. • Zudem unterstützt du das Management bei abwechslungsreichen Aufgaben und sammelst wertvolle Praxiserfahrung. Anforderungen: • Einen guten mittleren Schulabschluss oder einen höheren Bildungsabschluss • Gute Kenntnisse in Deutsch, Mathematik und Englisch • Begeisterung für kaufmännische Zusammenhänge und organisatorische Aufgaben • Freude am Umgang mit digitalen Anwendungen • Eine selbstständige, zuverlässige und sorgfältige Arbeitsweise • Motivation, Neues zu lernen und gemeinsam etwas zu bewegen Wir bieten: Kantine mit gesunden Mahlzeiten Geniessen Sie gesunde Mahlzeiten in unserer Kantine zu fairen Preisen. Teamanlässe und Events Ihr Engagement macht es uns möglich. Das wollen wir gemeinsam mit Ihnen feiern. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Dans le cadre du groupe Bühler, un groupe d'ingénierie mondial comptant plus de 13 000 employés, nous sommes l'un des principaux fabricants de systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous offrons à nos clients une large gamme de systèmes pour le revêtement de verre architectural, de lunettes et de composants optiques – par exemple pour les smartphones, l'industrie automobile et la technologie médicale. Notre équipe internationale établit chaque jour de nouvelles normes et réalise avec succès des projets difficiles.

Pour notre emplacement à Hasselroth, nous recherchons un stagiaire motivé (h/f/d) qui soutiendra activement notre équipe. Vous êtes engagé, fiable et voulez assumer vos responsabilités tôt? Puis postuler maintenant et faire partie de notre équipe!

Faisons une différence ensemble à Bühler!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches: • Lors de votre formation en tant que machiniste (h/f/d), vous apprendrez à connaître différents matériaux et travailler avec des machines modernes et des outils de coupe. • Vous évaluez et analysez les contrats de production technique et les appliquez avec précision. • Vous apprenez à entretenir et inspecter professionnellement les systèmes de fabrication. • Vous travaillez avec une précision de millimètre et apprenez à utiliser en toute sécurité des machines de broyage, de tournage et de fraisage contrôlées par ordinateur. • Avec notre partenaire de formation, vous acquerrez les bases dans les domaines du travail des métaux, de l'hydraulique et de la construction ainsi que dans la programmation des systèmes. Da oltre 150 anni offriamo ai nostri clienti un'ampia gamma di sistemi per il rivestimento di vetri architettonici, lenti per occhiali, componenti ottici di smartphone, automobili, tecnologia medicale e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale riesce ogni giorno a stabilire nuovi standard e a realizzare con successo progetti complessi.

Cerchiamo un tirocinante motivato (m/f/d) che supporterà attivamente il nostro team ad Alzenau. Sei impegnato, affidabile e vuoi svolgere compiti in modo indipendente? Allora candidati subito ed entra a far parte del nostro team.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano ogni giorno cibo prodotto con i sistemi Bühler. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano su veicoli i cui componenti sono stati prodotti con le tecnologie Bühler.

Compiti: • Sviluppate e programmate soluzioni software su misura per le nostre macchine e sistemi innovativi. • Installi e configuri software per applicazioni industriali. • Fornite supporto competente ai clienti interni ed esterni nell'utilizzo delle nostre soluzioni software. • Imparerai a conoscere diversi linguaggi e tecnologie di programmazione e utilizzerai le tue conoscenze direttamente nella pratica. • Lavori attivamente in diversi team di progetto e ti assumi la responsabilità dei tuoi sottoprogetti passo dopo passo. Rispetto ed empatia garantiscono che tutti si sentano sicuri e possano fare del loro meglio. Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and constant growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global mechanical engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been offering our customers a wide range of systems for coating architectural glass, eyeglass lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

We are looking for a motivated trainee (m/f/d) who will actively support our team in Alzenau. Are you committed, reliable and want to take on tasks independently? Then apply now and become part of our team.

Let's make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food every day that was produced on Bühler systems. A billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of balancing the needs of the economy, people and nature. This is how we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You develop and program tailor-made software solutions for our innovative machines and systems. • You install and configure software for industrial applications. • You provide competent support to internal and external customers in using our software solutions. • You will get to know different programming languages ​​and technologies and use your knowledge directly in practice. • You work actively in different project teams and take responsibility for your own sub-projects step by step. Requirements: • You have a secondary school leaving certificate – ideally with good grades in mathematics, English and computer science. You are passionate about computers and technology and, ideally, you already have some basic PC or programming knowledge. • You enjoy thinking logically, finding solutions and trying out new things. • You enjoy working in a team, are reliable and show initiative. • What matters most to us is that you are curious and want to help shape the digital future of our machines! We offer: Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars in short, relevant, engaging, personalized and mobile formats. Team occasions and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities for this. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Diverse and inclusive workplace We promote an inclusive culture that values our global diversity. Respect and empathy ensure that everyone feels safe and can do their best. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technology to boost your productivity and innovation. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. This is how we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. That's why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Bereitet es Ihnen Freude, bestehende technische Produkte kontinuierlich zu optimieren und weiterzuentwickeln? Sind Kundenzufriedenheit und Produktqualität für Sie entscheidende Faktoren für nachhaltigen Markterfolg? Unsere Business Area Chocolate & Coffee entwickelt innovative Technologien und Lösungen für die industrielle Verarbeitung von Kakao, Schokolade und Kaffee. Werden Sie Teil unseres Teams und gestalten Sie gemeinsam mit uns die Zukunft dieser genussvollen Produkte – wir freuen uns darauf, Sie kennenzulernen!

Aufgaben:
• Sie verantworten die Pflege, Optimierung und Weiterentwicklung bestehender Produkte aus unserem Portfolio – unter Berücksichtigung von Kosten, Terminen und Qualität

• Gemeinsam mit dem Einkauf und unseren Lieferanten überwachen und optimieren Sie die Kostenbasis bestehender Produkte

• Sie konzipieren, realisieren und validieren kundenspezifische Anpassungen und stellen dabei die Einhaltung der Kosten-, Termin- und Qualitätsvorgaben sicher

• In multidisziplinären und internationalen Entwicklungsprojekten übernehmen Sie die Leitung von Teilprojekten

• Sie erstellen und pflegen produktspezifische Dokumentationen unter Einhaltung der geltenden Vorschriften, Normen und gesetzlichen Anforderungen

Anforderungen:
• Bachelorabschluss oder gleichwertige Ausbildung in Mechatronik oder Maschinenbau

• Mindestens drei Jahre Berufserfahrung als Entwicklungsingenieur:in

• Analytische und strukturierte Arbeitsweise sowie ausgeprägte Umsetzungs- und Kommunikationsstärke

• Sicherer Umgang mit MS Office und Autodesk Inventor sowie idealerweise Erfahrung mit weiteren Entwicklungs- und Berechnungswerkzeugen wie Ansys, MDesign oder SimScale

• Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift sowie gute Deutschkenntnisse

jobs.title: Estagiário Jurídico
Project Engineer - Automation
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
Buhler Inc. seeks a full-time Project Engineer – Automation based in Plymouth, MN. The Project Engineer – Automation delivers electrical and automation engineering services by designing, programming, testing, and commissioning PLC/PCS control software for industrial systems in the food industry, such as grain milling, animal feed, and consumer foods, and ensures projects meet customer expectations, comply with internal directives and safety standards, and are timely completed. Specific duties include: 1) Design, develop, and simulate PLC and PCS (Plant Control System) software according to project scope for customers in the food industry through the application of knowledge in computer science, automation engineering, and mathematical analysis during the development process. 2) Manage the technical scope of assigned work to achieve the project goals and objectives. 3) Create system specifications and project documentation according to company standards and compliance requirements. 4) Integrate automation systems into manufacturing environments by collaborating with mechanical, electrical, and software engineering teams. 5) Lead testing and commissioning activities, including Customer Acceptance Tests (CAT); on-site commissioning, support, and customer training; and the development of digital service solutions. 6) Provide remote and on-site troubleshooting to ensure reliable operation of automation systems after commissioning. 7) Conduct on-site training for customers (system operation, troubleshooting). 8) Capture and apply all learned lessons to increase execution performance and quality. 9) Develop application solutions using the following technologies: WinCos Scada R1, WinCos Scada R2, Mercury Scada, VisiWin .NET Machine Control, VisiWin V7 Machine Control, GCPro, IOSimuli V2, WinTrend V2, Device2L MEAG configuration, Rockwell Automation Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, Schneider Electric Unity Pro, Microsoft SQL, Microsoft Visual Basic, Microsoft Visual C#, VMWare, JavaScript. This position requires international and domestic travel up to 50% of the time.

Anforderungen:
This position requires two (2) years of experience with PLC programming in a mechatronics environment. Experience must include two (2) years of experience, which may be concurrent, in all of the following: 1) Designing, developing, and simulating PLC and PCS (Plant Control System) software according to project scope for customers in the food industry through the application of knowledge in computer science, automation engineering, and mathematical analysis during the development process. 2) Creating system specifications and project documentation according to company standards and compliance requirements. 3) Integrating automation systems into manufacturing environments by collaborating with mechanical, electrical, and software engineering teams. 4) Leading testing and commissioning activities, including Customer Acceptance Tests (CAT); on-site commissioning, support, and customer training; and the development of digital service solutions. 5) Developing application solutions using the following technologies: WinCos Scada R1, WinCos Scada R2, Mercury Scada, VisiWin .NET Machine Control, VisiWin V7 Machine Control, GCPro, IOSimuli V2, WinTrend V2, Device2L MEAG configuration, Rockwell Automation Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, Schneider Electric Unity Pro, Microsoft SQL, Microsoft Visual Basic, Microsoft Visual C#, VMWare, JavaScript. All experience may have been gained concurrently. This position requires international and domestic travel up to 50% of the time. Salary: $106, 267 to $110, 000/year. Benefits offered: Health Insurance w/ Health Savings Acct.; Dental; Vision & Life Insurance; Short Term & Long Term Disability; 401(k) w/ 6% company contribution; 15 days vacation; Sick Time; Maternity & Paternity Leave. Please apply online at https://jobs.buhlergroup.com/.

• Anforderungen. 3 Integration von Automatisierungssystemen in Fertigungsumgebungen durch Zusammenarbeit mit mechanischen, elektrischen und Software-Engineering-Teams. 4 Führende Test- und Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten, einschließlich Customer Acceptance Tests (CAT); Inbetriebnahme, Support und Kundenschulung vor Ort sowie Entwicklung digitaler Servicelösungen. 5) Entwicklung von Anwendungslösungen mit folgenden Technologien: WinCos Scada R1, WinCos Scada R2, Mercury Scada, VisiWin .NET Machine Control, VisiWin V7 Machine Control, GCPro, IOSimuli V2, WinTrend V2, Device2L MEAG-Konfiguration, Rockwell Automation Studio 5000, Siemens TIA Portal, Schneider Electric Unity Pro, Microsoft SQL, Microsoft Visual Basic, Microsoft Visual C#, VMWare, JavaScript.
