jobs.title: Sales Account Manager
jobs.description:
Build lasting customer partnerships and drive business growth in a dynamic, customer-focused role. As a Sales Account Manager, you'll serve as a trusted advisor to customers, helping them identify solutions that support their goals while expanding opportunities for both new projects and aftermarket products and services. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you'll combine relationship management, technical knowledge, and commercial expertise to deliver exceptional customer experiences and impactful business results.

Aufgaben:
•	Manage and maintain assigned accounts, while fostering long-term customer relationships.
•	Develop new accounts and identify new clients who may benefit from company products, services, aftermarket solutions, or project-based offerings.
•	Execute sales strategies that support both new project sales and service sales growth.
•	Initiate and maintain customer contact to understand requirements, identify opportunities, and recommend solutions that best meet customer needs related to quality, price, delivery, and long-term value.
•	Negotiate contracts, tender terms, and conditions to meet both customer and company needs.
•	Prepare, calculate, and administer customer quotations, proposals, and account documentation.
•	Provide pre-sales technical assistance, product education, and customer training as needed.
•	Support after-sales services by providing technical backup, coordinating solutions, and assisting with customer order concerns or service-related needs.
•	Work with engineering, quoting, accounting, design, development, production, purchasing, quality, research, sales, and other technical experts to support customer requirements and sales opportunities.
•	Collect and analyze market data, customer information, competitor activity, sales performance, and cost information to support business planning and strategy.
•	Maintain customer records, CRM database information, SOM reports, trip reports, expense reports, and other sales-related documentation.
•	Contribute to sales budget planning, SWOT analysis, and broader business sales strategy.
•	Meet regular sales targets and coordinate sales projects across assigned accounts, territories, and customer opportunities.
•	Support marketing activities by attending trade shows, exhibitions, conferences, industry associations, and other customer-facing events.
•	Make technical presentations and demonstrate how products, services, aftermarket offerings, or project solutions meet customer needs.
•	Maintain and continuously update product, technical, and industry knowledge.
•	Participate in sales training, sales seminars, and product training activities.
•	Provide training and support materials for other members of the sales team as needed.
•	Manage miscellaneous projects and complete other duties as assigned.

Anforderungen:
•	Bachelor's degree in business, engineering, or a related field preferred, or an equivalent combination of education and experience.
•	5+ years experience in capital equipment sales, technical sales, industrial sales, aftermarket sales, or related customer-facing sales roles is preferred.
•	Microsoft Office is required.
•	Experience with enterprise software such as SAP is preferred.
•	Familiarity with AutoCAD, Project Wise, and D3 is nice to have.
•	Strong customer relationship, sales, and negotiation skills.
•	Technical knowledge of products, services, equipment, and customer applications.
•	Ability to provide technical advice, product education, pre-sales assistance, and after-sales support.
•	Ability to read and understand electrical and mechanical technical drawings.
•	Strong interpersonal, written, and verbal communication skills with the ability to work effectively with customers, internal teams, and a variety of personalities.
•	Strong organizational skills with the ability to plan, prioritize, coordinate, and manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
•	Ability to work independently with minimal supervision and make effective decisions within company guidelines.
•	Ability to identify, evaluate, problem solve, and support resolution of customer, account, and business issues.
•	Ability to analyze costs, sales, customer needs, market trends, and competitive activity.
•	Proactive team player with an ownership approach.
•	Ability to understand and maintain confidentiality related to organizational and employee information.
•	Speaks and understands English.
•	Ability to travel up to 60% domestically and internationally, including frequent travel and non-traditional work schedules.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Costruire partnership con i clienti durevoli e guidare la crescita aziendale in un ruolo dinamico, focalizzato sul cliente. In qualità di Sales Account Manager, sarai un consulente affidabile per i clienti, aiutandoli a identificare soluzioni che supportano i loro obiettivi, espandendo opportunità sia per i nuovi progetti che per i prodotti e servizi post-vendita. Lavorando a stretto contatto con i team interfunzionali, unirete la gestione delle relazioni, le conoscenze tecniche e le competenze commerciali per offrire esperienze di cliente eccezionali e risultati aziendali di impatto.

Aufgaben:
• Gestisci e mantieni i conti assegnati, mentre promuovi i rapporti con i clienti a lungo termine.
• Sviluppa nuovi account e identifica nuovi clienti che possono beneficiare di prodotti aziendali, servizi, soluzioni aftermarket o offerte basate su progetti.
• Esegui strategie di vendita che supportano sia la crescita delle vendite di progetti che la crescita delle vendite di servizi.
• Avviare e mantenere il contatto con il cliente per comprendere i requisiti, identificare le opportunità e consigliare soluzioni che meglio soddisfano le esigenze del cliente relative a qualità, prezzo, consegna e valore a lungo termine.
• Negoziare contratti, termini di offerta e condizioni per soddisfare le esigenze del cliente e dell'azienda.
• Preparare, calcolare e amministrare le citazioni dei clienti, le proposte e la documentazione del conto.
• Fornire assistenza tecnica pre-vendita, formazione del prodotto e formazione del cliente secondo le necessità.
• Sostenere i servizi post-vendita fornendo backup tecnico, soluzioni di coordinamento, e assistere con le preoccupazioni dell'ordine del cliente o le esigenze legate al servizio.
• Lavorare con ingegneria, citando, contabilità, progettazione, sviluppo, produzione, acquisto, qualità, ricerca, vendite e altri esperti tecnici per supportare le esigenze dei clienti e le opportunità di vendita.
• Raccogliere e analizzare i dati di mercato, le informazioni del cliente, l'attività concorrente, le prestazioni di vendita e le informazioni di costo per supportare la pianificazione aziendale e la strategia.
• Mantenere i record dei clienti, le informazioni del database CRM, i rapporti SOM, i rapporti di viaggio, i rapporti di spesa e altri documenti relativi alle vendite.
• Contribuire alla pianificazione del budget di vendita, analisi SWOT e più ampia strategia di vendita di affari.
• Incontrare obiettivi di vendita regolari e coordinare i progetti di vendita attraverso conti assegnati, territori e opportunità dei clienti.
• Sostenere le attività di marketing partecipando a fiere, mostre, conferenze, associazioni di settore e altri eventi di customer-facing.
• Rendere presentazioni tecniche e dimostrare come prodotti, servizi, offerte aftermarket, o soluzioni di progetto soddisfano le esigenze del cliente.
• Mantenere e aggiornare continuamente le conoscenze di prodotto, tecnico e industriale.
• Partecipano alla formazione delle vendite, ai seminari di vendita e alle attività di formazione dei prodotti.
• Fornire materiali di formazione e supporto per altri membri del team di vendita come necessario.
• Gestire vari progetti e completare altri compiti assegnati.

Anforderungen:
• Corso di laurea in economia, ingegneria, o un campo correlato preferito, o una combinazione equivalente di istruzione e di esperienza.
• 5+ anni di esperienza nelle vendite di attrezzature di capitale, vendite tecniche, vendite industriali, vendite aftermarket, o relativi ruoli di vendita al cliente è preferito.
• Microsoft Office è richiesto.
• L'esperienza con software enterprise come SAP è preferita.
• Familiarità con AutoCAD, Project Wise, e D3 è bello avere.
• Forte rapporto cliente, vendite e competenze di negoziazione.
• Conoscenza tecnica di prodotti, servizi, attrezzature e applicazioni dei clienti.
• Capacità di fornire consulenza tecnica, formazione dei prodotti, assistenza pre-vendita e assistenza post-vendita.
• Capacità di leggere e comprendere disegni tecnici elettrici e meccanici.
• Forte capacità di comunicazione interpersonale, scritta e verbale con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con i clienti, le squadre interne e una varietà di personalità.
• Forte capacità organizzative con la capacità di pianificare, prioritizzare, coordinare e gestire più attività contemporaneamente.
• Capacità di lavorare indipendentemente con una minima supervisione e prendere decisioni efficaci all'interno delle linee guida aziendali.
• Capacità di identificare, valutare, risolvere i problemi e supportare la risoluzione dei problemi di cliente, account e business.
• Capacità di analizzare i costi, le vendite, le esigenze del cliente, le tendenze del mercato e l'attività competitiva.
• Giocatore di squadra attivo con un approccio di proprietà.
• Capacità di comprendere e mantenere la riservatezza relativa alle informazioni organizzative e dei dipendenti.
• Parla e comprende l'inglese.
• Capacità di viaggiare fino all'80% a livello nazionale e internazionale, tra cui viaggi frequenti e orari di lavoro non tradizionali.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufbau nachhaltiger Kundenpartnerschaften und Förderung des Geschäftswachstums in einer dynamischen, kundenorientierten Rolle. Als Sales Account Manager sind Sie als vertrauenswürdiger Berater für Kunden tätig und helfen ihnen, Lösungen zu finden, die ihre Ziele unterstützen und gleichzeitig die Möglichkeiten für neue Projekte und Aftermarket-Produkte und -Dienstleistungen erweitern. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams kombinieren Sie Beziehungsmanagement, technisches Wissen und kaufmännisches Fachwissen, um außergewöhnliche Kundenerfahrungen und wirkungsvolle Geschäftsergebnisse zu liefern.

Aufgaben:
• Verwalten und pflegen Sie zugewiesene Konten und fördern Sie gleichzeitig langfristige Kundenbeziehungen.
• Entwickeln Sie neue Konten und identifizieren Sie neue Kunden, die von Unternehmensprodukten, Dienstleistungen, Aftermarket-Lösungen oder projektbasierten Angeboten profitieren können.
• Führen Sie Vertriebsstrategien aus, die sowohl den Verkauf neuer Projekte als auch das Umsatzwachstum im Service unterstützen.
• Initiieren und pflegen Sie den Kundenkontakt, um Anforderungen zu verstehen, Chancen zu identifizieren und Lösungen zu empfehlen, die den Kundenbedürfnissen in Bezug auf Qualität, Preis, Lieferung und langfristigen Wert am besten entsprechen.
• Verhandeln Sie Verträge, Ausschreibungsbedingungen und Bedingungen, um sowohl Kunden- als auch Unternehmensbedürfnisse zu erfüllen.
• Bereiten, berechnen und verwalten Sie Kundenangebote, Vorschläge und Kontodokumentation.
• Bieten Sie vor dem Verkauf technische Unterstützung, Produktschulung und Kundenschulung nach Bedarf.
• Unterstützen Sie After-Sales-Services, indem Sie technisches Backup bereitstellen, Lösungen koordinieren und bei Kundenbestellungen oder servicebezogenen Bedürfnissen helfen.
• Arbeiten Sie mit Engineering, Zitieren, Buchhaltung, Design, Entwicklung, Produktion, Einkauf, Qualität, Forschung, Verkauf und anderen technischen Experten, um Kundenanforderungen und Verkaufsmöglichkeiten zu unterstützen.
• Sammeln und analysieren Sie Marktdaten, Kundeninformationen, Wettbewerbsaktivitäten, Verkaufsleistung und Kosteninformationen zur Unterstützung der Geschäftsplanung und -strategie.
• Pflegen Sie Kundenaufzeichnungen, CRM-Datenbankinformationen, SOM-Berichte, Reiseberichte, Spesenberichte und andere verkaufsbezogene Dokumentationen.
• Tragen Sie zur Verkaufsbudgetplanung, SWOT-Analyse und einer breiteren Geschäftsverkaufsstrategie bei.
• Erfüllen Sie regelmäßige Verkaufsziele und koordinieren Sie Vertriebsprojekte über zugewiesene Konten, Gebiete und Kundenmöglichkeiten hinweg.
• Unterstützen Sie Marketingaktivitäten durch die Teilnahme an Messen, Ausstellungen, Konferenzen, Branchenverbänden und anderen kundenorientierten Veranstaltungen.
• Machen Sie technische Präsentationen und zeigen Sie, wie Produkte, Dienstleistungen, Aftermarket-Angebote oder Projektlösungen den Kundenbedürfnissen entsprechen.
• Pflegen und aktualisieren Sie kontinuierlich Produkt-, technisches und Branchenwissen.
• Nehmen Sie an Verkaufsschulungen, Verkaufsseminaren und Produktschulungen teil.
• Stellen Sie bei Bedarf Schulungs- und Supportmaterialien für andere Mitglieder des Verkaufsteams bereit.
• Verwalten Sie verschiedene Projekte und erledigen Sie andere Aufgaben wie zugewiesen.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor-Abschluss in Business, Engineering oder einem verwandten Bereich bevorzugt, oder eine gleichwertige Kombination von Bildung und Erfahrung.
• 5+ Jahre Erfahrung im Verkauf von Investitionsgütern, technischen Verkäufen, industriellen Verkäufen, Aftermarket-Verkäufen oder verwandten kundenorientierten Verkaufsrollen werden bevorzugt.
• Microsoft Office ist erforderlich.
• Erfahrung mit Unternehmenssoftware wie SAP wird bevorzugt.
• Vertrautheit mit AutoCAD, Project Wise und D3 ist schön zu haben.
• Starke Kundenbeziehung, Verkaufs- und Verhandlungsfähigkeiten.
• Technische Kenntnisse von Produkten, Dienstleistungen, Geräten und Kundenanwendungen.
• Fähigkeit, technische Beratung, Produktschulung, Pre-Sales-Unterstützung und After-Sales-Support bereitzustellen.
• Fähigkeit, elektrische und mechanische technische Zeichnungen zu lesen und zu verstehen.
• Starke zwischenmenschliche, schriftliche und verbale Kommunikationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden, internen Teams und einer Vielzahl von Persönlichkeiten zu arbeiten.
• Starke organisatorische Fähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben gleichzeitig zu planen, zu priorisieren, zu koordinieren und zu verwalten.
• Fähigkeit, unabhängig mit minimaler Aufsicht zu arbeiten und effektive Entscheidungen innerhalb der Unternehmensrichtlinien zu treffen.
• Fähigkeit zur Identifizierung, Bewertung, Problemlösung und Unterstützung der Lösung von Kunden-, Konto- und Geschäftsproblemen.
• Fähigkeit, Kosten, Verkäufe, Kundenbedürfnisse, Markttrends und Wettbewerbsaktivitäten zu analysieren.
• Proaktiver Teamplayer mit einem Eigentümeransatz.
• Fähigkeit, die Vertraulichkeit in Bezug auf Organisations- und Mitarbeiterinformationen zu verstehen und zu wahren.
• Spricht und versteht Englisch.
• Fähigkeit, bis zu 80% im Inland und international zu reisen, einschließlich häufiger Reisen und nicht-traditioneller Arbeitszeiten.

descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bâtir des partenariats clients durables et stimuler la croissance des entreprises dans un rôle dynamique et axé sur le client. En tant que directeur de compte de vente, vous serez un conseiller de confiance pour les clients, les aidant à identifier des solutions qui soutiennent leurs objectifs tout en élargissant les opportunités pour de nouveaux projets et des produits et services après-vente. En étroite collaboration avec des équipes interfonctionnelles, vous combinerez la gestion des relations, les connaissances techniques et l'expertise commerciale pour offrir des expériences client exceptionnelles et des résultats commerciaux pertinents.

Aufgaben:
• Gérer et maintenir les comptes attribués, tout en favorisant les relations client à long terme.
• Élaborer de nouveaux comptes et identifier de nouveaux clients qui peuvent bénéficier de produits, de services, de solutions de marché secondaire ou d'offres basées sur des projets.
• Exécuter des stratégies de vente qui soutiennent à la fois les ventes de nouveaux projets et la croissance des ventes de services.
• Entreprendre et maintenir le contact avec le client pour comprendre les exigences, identifier les possibilités et recommander des solutions qui répondent le mieux aux besoins du client en matière de qualité, de prix, de livraison et de valeur à long terme.
• Négocier des contrats, des modalités d'appel d'offres et des conditions pour répondre aux besoins des clients et des entreprises.
• Préparer, calculer et administrer les devis des clients, les propositions et la documentation des comptes.
• Fournir, au besoin, une assistance technique, une formation sur les produits et une formation à la clientèle avant la vente.
• Services de soutien après-vente en fournissant une sauvegarde technique, des solutions de coordination et en aidant à répondre aux préoccupations des clients ou aux besoins liés au service.
• Travailler avec l'ingénierie, la citation, la comptabilité, la conception, le développement, la production, l'achat, la qualité, la recherche, les ventes, et d'autres experts techniques pour soutenir les besoins des clients et les opportunités de vente.
• Recueillir et analyser les données du marché, l'information sur les clients, l'activité des concurrents, le rendement des ventes et l'information sur les coûts pour appuyer la planification et la stratégie d'affaires.
• Tenir à jour les dossiers des clients, les données de la base de données CRM, les rapports SOM, les rapports de voyage, les rapports de dépenses et d'autres documents liés aux ventes.
• Contribuer à la planification du budget des ventes, à l'analyse SWOT et à une stratégie commerciale plus vaste.
• Respecter les objectifs de vente réguliers et coordonner les projets de vente dans les comptes, territoires et occasions de clients assignés.
• Soutenir les activités de marketing en participant à des foires commerciales, des expositions, des conférences, des associations industrielles et d'autres événements destinés aux clients.
• Faire des présentations techniques et démontrer comment les produits, les services, les offres après-vente ou les solutions de projet répondent aux besoins des clients.
• Maintenir et mettre à jour en permanence les connaissances sur les produits, les techniques et l'industrie.
• Participer à des activités de formation sur les ventes, des séminaires sur les ventes et des activités de formation sur les produits.
• Fournir au besoin du matériel de formation et de soutien aux autres membres de l'équipe de vente.
• Gérer divers projets et accomplir d'autres tâches selon les affectations.

• Baccalauréat en affaires, en génie ou dans un domaine connexe préféré, ou une combinaison équivalente d'études et d'expérience.
• 5+ ans d'expérience dans les ventes d'équipement, les ventes techniques, les ventes industrielles, les ventes après-vente, ou les rôles de vente liés à la clientèle est préféré.
• Microsoft Office est nécessaire.
• L'expérience avec les logiciels d'entreprise comme SAP est préférée.
• Familiarité avec AutoCAD, Project Wise et D3 est agréable à avoir.
• Bonne relation client, ventes et compétences en négociation.
• Connaissance technique des produits, des services, des équipements et des applications client.
• Capacité de fournir des conseils techniques, une formation sur les produits, une assistance avant la vente et un soutien après la vente.
• Capacité de lire et de comprendre les dessins techniques électriques et mécaniques.
• Fortes compétences en communication interpersonnelle, écrite et verbale avec la capacité de travailler efficacement avec les clients, les équipes internes et une variété de personnalités.
• Des compétences organisationnelles solides avec la capacité de planifier, de prioriser, de coordonner et de gérer simultanément plusieurs tâches.

jobs.title: Quotation Engineer (Automation)
jobs.description:
Responsible for producing quotation documents with internal tools, consisting of pricing, concept drawing, presentation material, and other supporting sales process. Provide technical leadership and direction for projects in the quotation phase. In charge to deliver the required quotation services within the given time and required quality, while ensuring compliance with Bühler related directives and EHS standards.

Aufgaben:
• Responsible for preparing automation quotations using Bühler internal tools, standards and quotation processes

• Clarifies automation requirements with internal project sales teams and, where required, directly with customers

• Performs technical and commercial analysis of customer requirements in close alignment with the Sales Manager

• Develops project-specific plant automation concepts based on customer requirements, project scope, technical feasibility and Bühler solution standards

• Collaborates with Sales, Technology, Engineering, Commercial Services, Mechanical Engineers and Automation Specialists to develop competitive and high-quality quotations

• Ensures technical and commercial ownership of assigned quotations, including scope, assumptions, risks, exclusions and deliverables

• Provides timely responses to internal technical questions and supports clarification of technical issues during the quotation phase

• Proactively follows up on submitted quotation documents with internal stakeholders or customers to support the sales process

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Automation Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Industrial Engineering or any related Engineering degree

• Minimum of 2–3 years of experience in an engineering role, preferably in quotation, project, or technical sales engineering

• Experience in Industrial Automation

• Demonstrated ability to manage technical and commercial aspects of quotations

• Experience in layout preparation, technical concept development, and customer-facing discussions

• Proficiency in the English language

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Quotation Officer
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Execute the customer quotation process end-to-end in contributing to sales turnover.

• Handle incoming customer requests professionally, ensuring prompt and thorough resolution of issues.

• Collect and validate all relevant customer information to accurately identify and fulfill their requirements.

• Build Level 1 competency in spare parts identification for assigned BUs, supported by 2nd-level Technical Advisors and BA/BU (Global/Region) teams during the quotation process.

• Process technical and commercial inquiries.

• Prepare comprehensive quotations for spare and wear parts, covering both commercial and technical aspects.

• Work with BOMs (Bill of Material / Part List), customer project documents, and technical drawings.

• Coordinate delivery, invoice and payments.

• Assist with customer complaints and warranty claims as needed, in close collaboration with the regional Quality partner.

• Engage with multiple stakeholders to support customer technical and commercial inquiries.

• Perform additional duties and responsibilities as business needs evolve.

Anforderungen:
• Mechanical, Electrical & Electronics, Mechatronics Engineering or similar education background.

• Basic knowledge machinery and familiar with MRO.

• At least 3 years of hands-on experience in order processing, logistics, or Customer Services.

• Knowledgeable in incoterms.

• IT savvy, proficient in MS Office, with working knowledge of SAP/ CRM platforms (e.g. Salesforce SAP (SD Module, Stock, Purchasing).

• English and any other ASEAN language of an advantage

jobs.description:
Bühler Group in Lagos, Nigeria is looking for an Area Sales Manager – Milling Solutions to expand our market presence across Ghana, Liberia, Nigeria, Sierra Leone, and The Gambia. This role is responsible for developing and executing regional sales strategies, managing the complete sales cycle, building strong customer relationships, and delivering tailored milling solutions that create customer value. The position works closely with cross-functional teams, represents Bühler in the market, identifies new business opportunities, and contributes to sustainable growth through consultative selling and market development.

Aufgaben:
•	Develop and execute the regional sales strategy for Bühler's Milling Solutions across West Africa.
•	Manage the full sales cycle from business development to contract closure and handover.
•	Drive new business opportunities, grow strategic accounts, and build a sustainable sales pipeline.
•	Understand customer needs and deliver value-driven milling solutions using Bühler's technologies and services.
•	Prepare proposals, tenders, commercial offers, and business cases in collaboration with internal teams.
•	Lead commercial negotiations and secure profitable business agreements.
•	Build strong customer and stakeholder relationships while monitoring market and competitor trends.
•	Maintain accurate sales forecasts, CRM records, and account plans.
•	Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure successful project execution and customer satisfaction.
•	Represent Bühler at customer visits and industry events, with frequent travel across the assigned West African markets
.

Anforderungen:
•	Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Food Technology, Milling Science, Business, or a related field.
•	Minimum 8 years of experience in sales, business development, or key account management within industrial equipment, food or grain processing, or a related industry.
•	Proven success in solution selling, strategic account management, contract negotiation, and new business development.
•	Strong understanding of milling technologies, customer operations, and commercial value creation.
•	Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills.
•	Proficiency in CRM tools and Microsoft Office.
•	Fluent in English; French or regional language skills are an advantage.
•	Willingness to travel frequently across West Africa.

jobs.title: Area Sales Manager

titleByLocale.fr: Gestionnaire des ventes de secteur CF/CM (270)

jobs.description:
Bühler Group in Algiers, Algeria, is looking for an Area Sales Manager CF/CM to expand our market presence across Algeria. This role is responsible for developing new business opportunities, managing key accounts and the complete sales cycle, providing technical and commercial solutions, and strengthening Bühler's market presence and reputation. The position works closely with customers and cross-functional teams to deliver tailored capital equipment and process solutions, support market development, and contribute to sustainable growth.

Aufgaben:
• Identify and develop new business opportunities, diversify the account base, grow strategic accounts, and build strong customer relationships at all levels.

• Understand customer needs and provide technical advice on capital equipment and process solutions, matching requirements with the right Bühler equipment solutions.

• Manage the full sales cycle for complex, high-value projects, including technical and commercial proposals, tenders, contract negotiations, and handover.

• Drive market development initiatives and proactively promote equipment upgrades, retrofit projects, and other opportunities to strengthen Bühler's market presence and reputation in Algeria.

• Maintain strong customer and stakeholder relationships, manage key accounts, identify and resolve customer issues, and ensure a high level of customer satisfaction.

• Develop and maintain sales materials and product knowledge, monitor customer and market needs, and collaborate with internal teams to develop sales strategies and business plans.

• Maintain accurate customer, sales, forecasts, account plans, and opportunity records in the company's CRM system.

Anforderungen:
• Engineering, technical, or business degree, or equivalent demonstrated technical experience.

• Minimum 5 years of experience in capital equipment or large project sales; experience in the food or packaging industry is highly desired.

• Proven track record in new business development, solution selling, strategic account management, and closing complex, high-value projects, including tendering and contract negotiation.

• Strong technical understanding of industrial production equipment and excellent knowledge of sales and relationship management.

• Ability to work effectively within a matrix organization, coordinate with multiple internal teams, and contribute to strategy and business planning.

• Able to work independently and manage an assigned territory with a high degree of autonomy, with a strong focus on developing new customer relationships.

• Fluent in French and English. An existing network of contacts in the Algerian food or packaging manufacturing sector is an advantage.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, and presentation skills, with the ability to travel as required.

Diese Rolle ist verantwortlich für die Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, die Verwaltung von Key Accounts und des gesamten Verkaufszyklus, die Bereitstellung technischer und kommerzieller Lösungen sowie die Stärkung der Marktpräsenz und des Rufs von Bühler. Die Position arbeitet eng mit Kunden und funktionsübergreifenden Teams zusammen, um maßgeschneiderte Investitionsgüter und Prozesslösungen zu liefern, die Marktentwicklung zu unterstützen und zu nachhaltigem Wachstum beizutragen.

Aufgaben:
• Identifizieren und entwickeln Sie neue Geschäftsmöglichkeiten, diversifizieren Sie die Kontobasis, bauen Sie strategische Konten auf und bauen Sie starke Kundenbeziehungen auf allen Ebenen auf.

• Verstehen Sie die Kundenbedürfnisse und bieten Sie technische Beratung zu Investitions- und Prozesslösungen, die die Anforderungen mit den richtigen Bühler-Gerätelösungen erfüllen.

• Verwalten Sie den gesamten Verkaufszyklus für komplexe, hochwertige Projekte, einschließlich technischer und kommerzieller Vorschläge, Ausschreibungen, Vertragsverhandlungen und Übergabe.

• Pflegen Sie starke Kunden- und Stakeholder-Beziehungen, verwalten Sie Key Accounts, identifizieren und lösen Sie Kundenprobleme und sorgen Sie für eine hohe Kundenzufriedenheit.

• Entwickeln und pflegen Sie Vertriebsmaterialien und Produktkenntnisse, überwachen Sie die Kunden- und Marktbedürfnisse und arbeiten Sie mit internen Teams zusammen, um Verkaufsstrategien und Geschäftspläne zu entwickeln.

• Pflegen Sie genaue Kunden-, Verkaufs-, Prognosen-, Kontopläne und Gelegenheitsaufzeichnungen im CRM-System des Unternehmens.

Anforderungen:
• Ingenieur-, Technik- oder Business-Abschluss oder gleichwertige nachgewiesene technische Erfahrung.

• Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in Investitionsgütern oder Großprojektverkäufen; Erfahrung in der Lebensmittel- oder Verpackungsindustrie ist sehr erwünscht.

• Nachgewiesene Erfolgsbilanz in der Entwicklung neuer Geschäftsbereiche, dem Verkauf von Lösungen, dem strategischen Account Management und dem Abschluss komplexer, hochwertiger Projekte, einschließlich Ausschreibungen und Vertragsverhandlungen.

• Starkes technisches Verständnis von industriellen Produktionsanlagen und hervorragende Kenntnisse des Vertriebs- und Beziehungsmanagements.

• Fähigkeit, effektiv in einer Matrixorganisation zu arbeiten, mit mehreren internen Teams zu koordinieren und zur Strategie- und Geschäftsplanung beizutragen.

• Kann unabhängig arbeiten und ein zugewiesenes Gebiet mit einem hohen Maß an Autonomie verwalten, mit einem starken Fokus auf die Entwicklung neuer Kundenbeziehungen.

• Fließend in Französisch und Englisch. Ein bestehendes Netzwerk von Kontakten im algerischen Lebensmittel- oder Verpackungssektor ist von Vorteil.

• Starke Kommunikation, Stakeholder-Management und Präsentationsfähigkeiten mit der Fähigkeit, bei Bedarf zu reisen.

jobs.title: Project Coordinator
jobs.description:
Bühler Group is looking for an experienced Project Coordinator to join our local Project Execution team in Algiers.
In this role, you will coordinate the successful execution of Plant Projects and Customer Service (CS) projects across Algeria, ensuring they are delivered in line with agreed schedules, budgets, quality standards, safety requirements, and customer expectations.
As the key local interface, you will connect the customer's Project Manager with Bühler's regional teams, headquarters, and Business Unit Project Managers. Your ability to communicate effectively in French and English, maintain disciplined follow-up, and facilitate the timely resolution of issues will be essential throughout the project lifecycle. Aufgaben: • Own day-to-day local project coordination from project handover through commissioning, customer acceptance and final project closure. • Act as a key interface between customer Project Managers and Bühler's regional/HQ and Business Unit Project Managers, ensuring clear, timely and accurate communication in French and English. • Maintain project plans, schedules, milestones, action lists and responsibilities, and proactively follow up on agreed actions through completion. • Coordinate meetings, site activities, project documentation, deliveries and site-readiness requirements with Project Management, Customer Service, Sales, Engineering, Logistics, suppliers and customers. • Monitor project progress against scope, schedule, cost, quality and EHS requirements; identify risks, deviations and potential issues early, support corrective actions and escalate when required. • Prepare clear meeting minutes, progress reports, project summaries and management updates covering project status, key decisions, risks and next steps. • Build strong and trusted customer relationships, manage expectations and support the resolution of project issues or conflicts with professionalism, diplomacy and emotional intelligence. • Support commissioning, customer acceptance, project handover, closure and lessons-learned activities. • Manage multiple priorities effectively and ensure strong follow-up and ownership throughout the project lifecycle. • Collaborate effectively within an international, cross-functional and matrix organization, using sound judgement and a practical, delivery-focused approach. • Use Microsoft Office effectively; knowledge of Microsoft Project or similar planning tools is preferred, while SAP/ERP experience is an advantage. Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Project Management or a comparable technical discipline. • Minimum 5 years of experience in project coordination or execution, preferably in industrial equipment, plant engineering, installation, commissioning or Customer Service projects. • Proven experience in customer-facing projects and coordination of multiple internal and external stakeholders. • Fluent in French and English, both written and spoken. • Based in Algeria, eligible to work locally and willing to travel regularly to customer sites. • Verwalten Sie mehrere Prioritäten effektiv und gewährleisten Sie eine starke Nachverfolgung und Eigenverantwortung während des gesamten Projektlebenszyklus.

• Arbeiten Sie effektiv in einer internationalen, funktionsübergreifenden und Matrixorganisation mit einem fundierten Urteilsvermögen und einem praktischen, lieferungsorientierten Ansatz zusammen.

• Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in kundenorientierten Projekten und der Koordination mehrerer interner und externer Stakeholder.

Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei principali produttori di sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni, abbiamo offerto ai nostri clienti una vasta gamma di attrezzature per il rivestimento di vetro architettonico, occhiali, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medica e molto altro ancora. Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e ad implementare con successo progetti complessi. > Nella vostra posizione responsabile come R&D Project Manager (m/f/d), guidate team interdisciplinari, guidate soluzioni innovative e apportate un contributo importante all'ulteriore sviluppo dei nostri prodotti. Applicare ora e diventare parte del nostro team.
Facciamo una differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme. Compiti: • Conduci progetti R&D nel campo delle tecnologie di film sottile ottico e rivestimento sotto vuoto – dall'idea di progetto all'implementazione industriale • Sei responsabile per obiettivi di progetto, scadenze, budget, risorse, qualità e rischi • Si controllano progetti di sviluppo finanziati con fondi pubblici, dall'amministrazione delle applicazioni e dei progetti alla reportistica dei progetti • Coordinano gli stakeholder di progetto interni ed esterni, tra cui lo sviluppo, la progettazione, la produzione e la gestione dei prodotti, nonché università, istituti di ricerca, clienti e fornitori. • Promuovano la comunicazione veloce e trasparente nel team di progetto e denunciano con finalità mirate • Prendere decisioni informate rapidamente e proattivamente spingere i progetti in avanti • Traducono risultati di ricerca e sviluppo in prodotti e processi commercializzabili e sviluppano continuamente i metodi e gli standard della gestione dei progetti R&D Requisiti • Hai completato studi tecnici o scientifici, ad esempio in fisica, ottica/fotonica, scienze dei materiali, chimica, ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica o ingegneria industriale • Porti diversi anni di esperienza nella gestione di progetti di sviluppo o innovazione esigenti, idealmente in ingegneria meccanica o vegetale • Hai una comprensione tecnica di base della tecnologia del vuoto e dei processi di rivestimento • Hai esperienza con progetti di ricerca e sviluppo finanziati con fondi pubblici e idealmente con la loro applicazione, amministrazione e documentazione • Convincono con un metodo di lavoro strutturato, auto-responsabile e di comunicazione, conducono squadre interdisciplinari in modo sicuro e hanno ottime competenze tedesche e inglesi Offriamo: Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione. Ambiente di lavoro interculturale La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva. Sviluppo professionale e personale Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili. Mensa con pasti sani Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi. Previdenza sociale Approfittate delle nostre pensioni aziendali o dei servizi di asset-generazione – per un futuro sicuro! Piattaforma di apprendimento Benvenuti in un mondo di oltre 16.000 opportunità per continuare la vostra formazione! Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.
In your responsible position as R&D Project Manager (m/f/d), you lead interdisciplinary teams, drive innovative solutions and make an important contribution to the further development of our products. Apply now and become part of our team.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You lead R&D projects in the field of optical thin film and vacuum coating technologies – from project idea to industrial implementation • You are responsible for project goals, deadlines, budgets, resources, quality and risks • You control publicly funded development projects, from application and project administration to project reporting • They coordinate internal and external project stakeholders, including development, design, production and product management, as well as universities, research institutes, customers and suppliers. • They promote fast and transparent communication in the project team and report purposefully • You make informed decisions quickly and proactively drive projects forward • They translate research and development results into marketable products and processes and continuously develop the methods and standards of R&D project management Requirements • You have completed technical or scientific studies, for example in physics, optics/photonics, materials sciences, chemistry, mechanical engineering, electrical engineering or industrial engineering • You bring several years of experience in the management of demanding development or innovation projects, ideally in mechanical or plant engineering • You have a basic technical understanding of vacuum technology and coating processes • You have experience with publicly funded research and development projects and ideally with their application, administration and documentation • They convince with a structured, self-responsible and communication-strong working method, lead interdisciplinary teams safely and have very good German and English skills We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Bühler Leybold Optics est synonyme de technologies innovantes et de croissance soutenue. Dans le cadre du Groupe Bühler, groupe d'ingénierie mondial comptant plus de 13 000 employés, nous sommes l'un des principaux fabricants de systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous offrons à nos clients une large gamme d'équipements pour le revêtement de verre architectural, de lunettes, de composants optiques dans les smartphones, les voitures, la technologie médicale et bien plus encore. Notre équipe internationale réussit à établir de nouvelles normes chaque jour et à réaliser avec succès des projets complexes.
En tant que gestionnaire de projets de R & D (h/f/d), vous dirigez des équipes interdisciplinaires, pilotez des solutions innovantes et contribuez de façon importante au développement de nos produits. Faites une demande maintenant et faites partie de notre équipe.

À Bühler, faisons la différence ensemble!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite par les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches: • Vous dirigez des projets de R & D dans le domaine des technologies de film mince optique et de revêtement sous vide – de l'idée de projet à la mise en œuvre industrielle • Vous êtes responsable des objectifs du projet, des échéances, des budgets, des ressources, de la qualité et des risques • Vous contrôlez les projets de développement financés par l'État, de l'administration des demandes et des projets à l'établissement de rapports sur les projets • Ils coordonnent les parties prenantes internes et externes du projet, y compris le développement, la conception, la production et la gestion des produits, ainsi que les universités, les instituts de recherche, les clients et les fournisseurs. • Ils favorisent une communication rapide et transparente au sein de l'équipe du projet et rendent compte de manière ciblée • Vous prenez des décisions éclairées rapidement et proactivement pour faire avancer les projets • Ils traduisent les résultats de la recherche et du développement en produits et processus commercialisables et élaborent continuellement les méthodes et les normes de gestion de projets de R-D. Exigences • Vous avez effectué des études techniques ou scientifiques, par exemple en physique, en optique/photonique, en sciences des matériaux, en chimie, en génie mécanique, en génie électrique ou en génie industriel. • Vous apportez plusieurs années d'expérience dans la gestion de projets de développement ou d'innovation exigeants, idéalement en mécanique ou en génie végétal • Vous avez une compréhension technique de base de la technologie du vide et des processus de revêtement • Vous avez de l'expérience dans des projets de recherche et de développement financés par l'État et idéalement dans leur application, leur administration et leur documentation • Ils convainquent avec une méthode de travail structurée, autoresponsable et forte en communication, dirigent des équipes interdisciplinaires en toute sécurité et ont de très bonnes compétences en allemand et en anglais Nous offrons: Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travailler dans un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour augmenter votre productivité et votre innovation. Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive. descriptionByLocale.en:
Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the leading manufacturers of high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of architectural glass, eyeglasses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

We are looking for a highly motivated and committed working student (m/f/d) who actively supports our team in Alzenau. Exciting tasks await you, in which you can prove your pronounced initiative and willingness to learn. Take your chance and become part of Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You set up industrial PCs and control computers for our plants and machines. • You install operating systems, software and required applications according to our standards. • You perform functional tests and make sure that the systems are ready for use. • You support the configuration of computers in the production and service environment. • You document hardware, software statuses and completed installations. • You work closely with engineering, service and production. Requirements • You are an enrolled student of (m/f/d), ideally in the field of computer science, business informatics, electrical engineering or a comparable discipline. • You enjoy working with computer hardware and technical systems. • You have initial knowledge of Windows operating systems as well as hardware and software installation. • You work carefully, structured and like to take responsibility. • You have a hands-on mentality and also tackle practical tasks. • You are a team player with a reliable and solution-oriented way of working. We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Diverse and inclusive workplace We promote an inclusive culture that values our global diversity. Respect and empathy ensure that everyone feels safe and can do their best. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.

Compiti:
• Vivrete un pratico doppio corso di studio in cui la conoscenza universitaria e l'applicazione in azienda si completano idealmente l'un l'altro.

• In varie fasi pratiche, si lavorerà su compiti e progetti specifici e conoscere diverse aree e interfacce specialistiche.

• Completa i tuoi studi in collaborazione con TH Aschaffenburg.

• Inoltre, si beneficia di supporto personale, ambienti di lavoro modernamente attrezzati e preparazione precoce per iniziare la tua carriera.

• Dopo la laurea, una vasta gamma di prospettive si aprirà per voi, ad esempio in progettazione elettrica, programmazione PLC, sviluppo software e messa in servizio.

Requisiti
• Hai Abitur, Fachhochschulreife o una qualifica scolastica paragonabile.

• I contesti tecnici ti ispirano – soprattutto argomenti di matematica, fisica e programmazione.

• Porti abilità pratiche e interesse nei compiti artigianali-tecnici e sei felice di partecipare.

• Sei caratterizzato da motivazione, piacere di apprendimento, spirito di squadra e responsabilità personale.

• Una patente di guida di classe B – a seconda dell'area di applicazione – un plus.

Il tuo modello di studio – TH AB dual:
• Laurea in Ingegneria (B.Eng.)

• Durata: 6 semestri (periodo standard di studio, doppio organizzato)

• Inizio: Winter Semester 2027

• Teoria della posizione: Aschaffenburg University of Technology (concetto ibrido: presenza + e-learning moderno)

• Quota pratica: circa il 50% – già dal 1. Semester attivo in azienda

• Modello settimanale (durante il periodo di lezione): 3 giorni di teoria a TH AB + 2 giorni di pratica in azienda → tempo libero di lezione = uso completo pratico in azienda

Te lo meriti:
Pugnalato da seniority:
• 1. Anno: 1.303 €

• 2. Anno: 1.365 €

• 3. Anno: 1.444 €
incl. Assunzione di tasse universitarie.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group – a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees – we are the market leader in high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been developing equipment for coating spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology, cameras, head-up displays and much more. Our international team sets new standards every day and successfully implements complex projects.

You are enthusiastic about the interface between electrical engineering, information technology, mechanical engineering and automation? Do you want to closely integrate theory and practice from the beginning and take on real responsibility in exciting projects from the first semester? Then our dual study in cooperation with the Technical University of Aschaffenburg (TH AB) is just the right thing!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You will experience a practical dual course of study in which university knowledge and application in the company ideally complement each other. • In varied practical phases, you will work on specific tasks and projects and get to know several specialist areas and interfaces. • You complete your studies in cooperation with TH Aschaffenburg. • In addition, you benefit from personal support, modernly equipped working environments and early preparation for starting your career. • After graduation, a wide range of perspectives will open up for you, e.g. in electrical design, PLC programming, software development and commissioning. Requirements • You have Abitur, Fachhochschulreife or a comparable school qualification. • Technical contexts inspire you – especially topics from mathematics, physics and programming. • You bring practical skill and interest in craft-technical tasks and are happy to take part. • You are characterized by motivation, learning pleasure, team spirit and personal responsibility. • A driving license of class B – depending on the area of application – a plus. Your study model – TH AB dual: • Degree: Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) • Duration: 6 semesters (standard period of study, dual organized) • Start: Winter Semester 2027 • Location Theory: Aschaffenburg University of Technology (hybrid concept: presence + modern e-learning) • Practical share: about 50% – already from the 1. Semester active in the company • Weekly model (during the lecture period): 3 days of theory at TH AB + 2 days of practice in the company → lecture-free time = full practical use in the company You will deserve this: Staggered by seniority: • 1. Year: 1.303 € • 2. Year: 1,365 € • 3. Year: 1,444 € incl. Assumption of tuition fees. We offer: Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

Vous êtes enthousiaste quant à l'interface entre le génie électrique, la technologie de l'information, le génie mécanique et l'automatisation ? Voulez-vous intégrer étroitement la théorie et la pratique dès le début et prendre une vraie responsabilité dans des projets passionnants dès le premier semestre? Ensuite, notre étude duelle en collaboration avec l'Université technique d'Aschaffenburg (TH AB) est juste la bonne chose!

Faisons la différence ensemble à Bühler!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • Vous vivrez un double cours pratique dans lequel les connaissances universitaires et l'application dans l'entreprise se complètent idéalement. • Dans des phases pratiques variées, vous travaillerez sur des tâches et des projets spécifiques et apprendrez à connaître plusieurs domaines spécialisés et interfaces. • Vous terminez vos études en collaboration avec TH Aschaffenburg. • De plus, vous bénéficiez d'un soutien personnel, d'un environnement de travail moderne et d'une préparation précoce pour commencer votre carrière. • Après l'obtention du diplôme, un large éventail de perspectives s'ouvrira pour vous, par exemple dans la conception électrique, la programmation PLC, le développement et la mise en service de logiciels. Exigences • Vous avez Abitur, Fachhochschulreife ou une qualification scolaire comparable. • Les contextes techniques vous inspirent – en particulier les sujets des mathématiques, de la physique et de la programmation. • Vous apportez des compétences pratiques et de l'intérêt pour les tâches techniques artisanales et sont heureux de participer. • Vous êtes caractérisé par la motivation, le plaisir d'apprendre, l'esprit d'équipe et la responsabilité personnelle. • Un permis de conduire de classe B – selon le domaine d'application – un plus. Votre modèle d'étude – TH AB dual: • Diplôme: Baccalauréat en génie (B.Eng.) • Durée: 6 semestres (période normale d'études, double organisation) • Début: Semestre d'hiver 2027 • Théorie de localisation: Aschaffenburg University of Technology (concept hybride: présence + e-learning moderne) • Partage pratique : environ 50% – déjà de la 1. Semestre actif dans l'entreprise • Modèle hebdomadaire (pendant la période de lecture): 3 jours de théorie à TH AB + 2 jours de pratique dans l'entreprise → temps sans conférence = pleine utilisation pratique dans l'entreprise Vous mériterez ceci : Dirigé par l'ancienneté : • 1. Année: 1.303 € • 2. Année: 1 365 € • 3. Année: 1 444 € Inclusion des frais de scolarité. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Leybold Optics è sinonimo di tecnologie innovative e crescita costante. Come parte del Gruppo Bühler, un gruppo di ingegneria globale con oltre 13.000 dipendenti, siamo uno dei leader di mercato nei sistemi di rivestimento sottovuoto ad alta tecnologia. Da oltre 150 anni, abbiamo offerto ai nostri clienti un'ampia gamma di attrezzature per il rivestimento di lenti da spettacolo, componenti ottici in smartphone, auto, tecnologia medica, telecamere, display head-up e molto altro. Il nostro team internazionale riesce a stabilire nuovi standard ogni giorno e ad implementare con successo progetti complessi. > > Sei interessato all'interfaccia tra ingegneria meccanica, ingegneria elettrica e informatica? Vuoi assumerti una vera responsabilità durante i tuoi studi e partecipare a progetti entusiasmanti? Allora il nostro doppio studio Mechatronics in collaborazione con l'Università Tecnica di Aschaffenburg (TH AB) è solo la cosa giusta per voi! Facciamo la differenza insieme a Bühler! Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler. > Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale. > Vogliamo creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Compiti:
• Vivrete un pratico doppio corso di studio in cui la conoscenza universitaria e l'applicazione in azienda si completano idealmente l'un l'altro.

• In varie fasi pratiche, si lavorerà su compiti e progetti specifici e conoscere diverse aree e interfacce specialistiche.

• Completa i tuoi studi in collaborazione con TH Aschaffenburg.

• Inoltre, si beneficia di supporto personale, ambienti di lavoro modernamente attrezzati e preparazione precoce per iniziare la tua carriera.

• Dopo la laurea, avrai una vasta gamma di prospettive, ad esempio in messa in servizio, programmazione PLC, pianificazione della produzione e gestione del progetto.

Requisiti
• Hai Abitur, Fachhochschulreife o una qualifica scolastica paragonabile.

• I contesti tecnici ti ispirano – soprattutto argomenti di matematica, fisica e programmazione.

• Porti abilità pratiche e interesse nei compiti artigianali-tecnici e sei felice di partecipare.

• Sei caratterizzato da motivazione, piacere di apprendimento, spirito di squadra e responsabilità personale.

• Una patente di guida di classe B – a seconda dell'area di applicazione – un plus.

Il tuo modello di studio – TH AB dual:
• Laurea in Ingegneria (B.Eng.)

• Durata: 6 semestri (periodo standard di studio, doppio organizzato)

• Inizio: Winter Semester 2027

• Teoria della posizione: Aschaffenburg University of Technology (concetto ibrido: presenza + e-learning moderno)

• Quota pratica: circa il 50% – già dal 1. Semester attivo in azienda

• Modello settimanale (durante il periodo di lezione): 3 giorni di teoria a TH AB + 2 giorni di pratica in azienda → tempo libero di lezione = uso completo pratico in azienda

Te lo meriti:
Pugnalato da seniority:
• 1. Anno: 1.303 €

• 2. Anno: 1.365 €

• 3. Anno: 1.444 €
incl. Assunzione di tasse universitarie.

Offriamo:
Eventi e eventi di squadra
Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Sviluppo professionale e personale
Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Ambiente di lavoro interculturale
La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Mensa con pasti sani
Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo prodotto nelle piante di Bühler ogni giorno. Un miliardo di persone viaggiano in veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte utilizzando le tecnologie Bühler.
Con ogni decisione, Bühler persegue l'obiettivo di conciliare le esigenze dell'economia, delle persone e della natura. In questo modo, sviluppiamo soluzioni che aprono opportunità di business sostenibili nel settore alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Vogliamo innovare per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione alle soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Ecco perché lavoriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e scienziati per ottenere un impatto più veloce insieme.

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology, cameras, head-up displays and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

You are interested in the interface between mechanical engineering, electrical engineering and computer science? Do you want to take on real responsibility during your studies and participate in exciting projects? Then our dual study Mechatronics in cooperation with the Technical University of Aschaffenburg (TH AB) is just the right thing for you!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You will experience a practical dual course of study in which university knowledge and application in the company ideally complement each other. • In varied practical phases, you will work on specific tasks and projects and get to know several specialist areas and interfaces. • You complete your studies in cooperation with TH Aschaffenburg. • In addition, you benefit from personal support, modernly equipped working environments and early preparation for starting your career. • After graduation, you will have a wide range of perspectives, e.g. in commissioning, PLC programming, production planning and project management. Requirements • You have Abitur, Fachhochschulreife or a comparable school qualification. • Technical contexts inspire you – especially topics from mathematics, physics and programming. • You bring practical skill and interest in craft-technical tasks and are happy to take part. • You are characterized by motivation, learning pleasure, team spirit and personal responsibility. • A driving license of class B – depending on the area of application – a plus. Your study model – TH AB dual: • Degree: Bachelor of Engineering (B.Eng.) • Duration: 6 semesters (standard period of study, dual organized) • Start: Winter Semester 2027 • Location Theory: Aschaffenburg University of Technology (hybrid concept: presence + modern e-learning) • Practical share: about 50% – already from the 1. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Dans le cadre du groupe Bühler, un groupe d'ingénierie mondial comptant plus de 13 000 employés, nous sommes l'un des leaders du marché des systèmes de revêtement sous vide à film mince de haute technologie. Depuis plus de 150 ans, nous offrons à nos clients une large gamme d'équipements pour le revêtement des lentilles de spectacle, des composants optiques dans les smartphones, les voitures, la technologie médicale, les caméras, les écrans tête haute et bien plus encore. Notre équipe internationale réussit à établir de nouvelles normes chaque jour et à réaliser avec succès des projets complexes.

Vous êtes intéressé par l'interface entre le génie mécanique, le génie électrique et l'informatique? Voulez-vous assumer de véritables responsabilités pendant vos études et participer à des projets passionnants? Puis notre double étude Mecatronics en collaboration avec l'Université technique d'Aschaffenburg (TH AB) est juste la bonne chose pour vous!

Faisons la différence ensemble à Bühler!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. jobs.title: Finance & Accounting Specialist
jobs.description:
Buhler Group Türkiye, based in Izmir, is looking for a skilled and proactive professional to join our Finance Team as a "Finance & Accounting Specialist". The role will be responsible for managing accounting, tax, and finance operations, ensuring accurate execution of account reconciliations, bank transactions, sales invoicing, and month-end closing activities. The position will also support the Finance Manager in financial reporting and finance-related processes, contributing to the effective and compliant operation of Bühler Türkiye's finance function.

Aufgaben:
• Manage daily treasury operations, including cash positioning and liquidity planning as well as relations with banks to optimize banking services,

• Execute vendor payments and employee expense reimbursements

• Monitor accounts receivable aging report and ensure timely collections from customers

• Record daily bank transactions in the ERP system

• Submit monthly tax declarations accurately and on time

• Prepare quarterly and annual tax declarations, filings and government payments in coordination with Finance Manager

• Manage fixed asset records and perform monthly depreciation calculations

• Issue customer invoices in coordination with service, sales, and order management teams

• Prepare and maintain accurate, well-supported balance sheet reconciliations

• Support timely and accurate completion of month-end close activities

• Support preparation of financial reports in line with IFRS/Swiss Gap Fer, corporate guidelines, and local regulations

• Ensure proper documentation and approval for manual journal entries

• Perform analytical reviews of GL accounts and key transactions

• Coordinate internal and external audit activities in cooperation with the Finance Manager

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Finance, Accounting, Economics or a relevant field

• Minimum 5 years of relevant business experience in finance and accounting

• Prior experience in an audit firm is preferred

• Fluency in English

• Active user skills of “Logo-Netsis 3 Standard” and SAP

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications

• Strong team player with the ability to work under pressure

• Agile, proactive, self-motivated, and results-oriented

• A hands-on attitude and willingness to take ownership of tasks of varying complexity

• Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced environment with a strong problem-solving mindset and a data-driven approach

• Proven ability to build strong relationships with stakeholders at all levels of the organization

• Residing in İzmir or willing to relocate to İzmir

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo efficace in un ambiente veloce con una forte mentalità problem-solving e un approccio data-driven

• Prova capacità di costruire relazioni forti con gli stakeholder a tutti i livelli dell'organizzazione
