jobs.title: Ausbildung: Industriemechaniker/-in (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Bühler Leybold Optics steht für innovative Technologien und stetiges Wachstum. Als Teil der Bühler Group, einem weltweit agierenden Maschinenbaukonzern mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden, sind wir einer der führenden Hersteller von Hightech-Dünnfilm-Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen. Seit mehr als 150 Jahren bieten wir unseren Kunden ein breites Angebot an Anlagen für die Beschichtung von Architekturglas, Brillengläsern, optischen Komponenten in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und vielem mehr. Unserem internationalen Team gelingt es tagtäglich neue Maßstäbe zu setzen und komplexe Projekte erfolgreich umzusetzen.

Wir suchen einen motivierten Auszubildenden (m/w/d), der unser Team in Hasselroth tatkräftig unterstützt. Du bist engagiert, zuverlässig und möchtest eigenständig Aufgaben übernehmen? Dann bewerbe dich jetzt und werde Teil unseres Teams.

Lass uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.
Mit jeder Entscheidung verfolgt Bühler das Ziel, die Bedürfnisse von Wirtschaft, Mensch und Natur in Einklang zu bringen. So entwickeln wir Lösungen, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir wollen Innovationen für eine bessere Welt schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Unsere Weihnachtsfeiern, Sommerpartys, Sportveranstaltungen und Teamevents bieten die besten Gelegenheiten dazu. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Nous sommes impatients d'un membre de l'équipe (h/f/d) qui soutiendra activement notre service à la clientèle en tant qu'équipe établie et réussie à Alzenau par l'initiative, la flexibilité et la créativité. Dans votre rôle de responsable de compte et ingénieur de cycle de vie (h/f/d), vous incarnez la capacité de gérer les interfaces avec compétence et d'agir comme point de contact pour nos clients. Dans cette position, vous pouvez vous attendre à des défis passionnants chaque jour. Prenez votre chance et devenez membre du monde Bühler!

À Bühler, faisons la différence ensemble!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite sur des plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette manière, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. jobs.title: Commissioning Process Engineer
jobs.description:
Build the future of food production – and see the world while doing it.
Do you thrive on challenge, technology, and global adventure? Join a Swiss family-owned company and help commission high-tech production systems for the food and feed industry. Expect up to 80% international travel, working on-site with clients in 3–8 week blocks across the globe. To kick things off, your first year will be based in Prague for onboarding and team integration. Aufgaben: • Manage your projects during commissioning and communicate with important stakeholders around the world (customers, project managers, supervisors) • You will start up the plant or machines with our software • You will be on-site to resolve queries and adjust processes to ensure efficient operation of production lines • Your visit to the customer will also include an assessment of the overall technical condition of the plant and electrical installation • Record important data during commissioning and share it with our department to support continuous improvement processes Anforderungen: • Strong Electrical background • Have practical knowledge and experience in process engineering ideally in the food processing industry • Willingness to learn or experience in commissioning of new machines • Know some basics of PLC programming or willingness to learn • Enthusiasm for travel (> 80% of working time will be spent outside the office on sites) • Professional level of English Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Manager, LO
jobs.description:
Join Bühler as a Regional Sales Manager and lead the growth of Leybold Optics across Southeast Asia. You will develop strategic customer relationships, drive new business opportunities, and deliver advanced coating solutions for the Precision Optics, Semiconductor, and Ophthalmic industries.

Aufgaben:
• Develop and execute the Southeast Asia sales strategy for the Precision Optics, Semiconductor, and Ophthalmic segments.

• Drive order intake, revenue growth, profitability, and market expansion across the region.

• Build, manage, and convert a strong pipeline of strategic opportunities and investment projects.

• Grow key customer accounts and expand Bühler's installed base through new equipment, upgrades, and service solutions.

• Identify emerging market trends, customer needs, and technology developments to unlock new business opportunities.

• Partner with customers to deliver technical and commercial solutions that address coating, productivity, and manufacturing challenges.

• Lead the full sales cycle, from opportunity identification and proposal development to negotiation and contract closure.

• Build trusted relationships with senior stakeholders, business leaders, and technical decision-makers.

• Manage and support regional agents and channel partners to achieve growth and market development objectives.

• Maintain accurate forecasts, monitor competitive activity, and represent Bühler at industry events, seminars, and customer engagements.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Physics, Optical Engineering, Materials Science, Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Semiconductor Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Minimum five years of experience in technical sales, business development, or key-account management, including at least two years in a senior or regional role.

• Proven success in achieving sales, order intake, revenue, margin, or market-development targets.

• Experience selling complex capital equipment, technical systems, or advanced manufacturing solutions.

• Relevant experience in one or more of the following areas is strongly preferred:

• Precision optics or photonics

• Semiconductor equipment or manufacturing

• Ophthalmic lens manufacturing

• Vacuum coating or thin-film deposition

• Optical or functional coatings

Rejoignez Bühler en tant que directeur régional des ventes et dirigez la croissance de Leybold Optics dans toute l'Asie du Sud-Est. Vous développerez des relations client stratégiques, générerez de nouvelles opportunités d'affaires et fournirez des solutions de revêtement avancées pour les industries de précision optique, semi-conducteur et ophtalmique.

Aufgaben:
• Élaborer et exécuter la stratégie de vente en Asie du Sud-Est pour les segments de précision optique, semi-conducteur et ophtalmique.

• Favoriser la prise de commandes, la croissance des revenus, la rentabilité et l'expansion du marché dans toute la région.

• Bâtir, gérer et convertir une solide gamme de possibilités stratégiques et de projets d'investissement.

• Développer les comptes clients clés et étendre la base installée de Bühler grâce à de nouveaux équipements, des mises à niveau et des solutions de service.

• Identifier les nouvelles tendances du marché, les besoins des clients et les développements technologiques afin de dégager de nouvelles occasions d'affaires.

• Faites équipe avec les clients pour offrir des solutions techniques et commerciales qui répondent aux défis du revêtement, de la productivité et de la fabrication.

• Diriger le cycle complet des ventes, de l'identification des possibilités et de l'élaboration de propositions à la négociation et à la clôture des contrats.

• Établir des relations de confiance avec les principaux intervenants, les chefs d'entreprise et les décideurs techniques.

• Gérer et soutenir les agents régionaux et canaliser les partenaires pour atteindre les objectifs de croissance et de développement du marché.

• Maintenir des prévisions précises, surveiller l'activité concurrentielle et représenter Bühler lors d'événements, de séminaires et d'engagements de la clientèle.

- C'est pas vrai.
• Baccalauréat en physique, génie optique, sciences des matériaux, génie mécanique, génie électrique, génie semi-conducteur ou une discipline technique connexe.

• Au moins cinq ans d'expérience dans les ventes techniques, le développement des affaires ou la gestion de comptes clés, y compris au moins deux ans dans un rôle supérieur ou régional.

• Réussir à atteindre les objectifs en matière de ventes, de commandes, de revenus, de marge ou de développement du marché.

• Expérience de vente d'équipement complexe, de systèmes techniques ou de solutions de fabrication avancées.

• L'expérience pertinente dans un ou plusieurs des domaines suivants est fortement privilégiée :

• Optique de précision ou photonique

• Matériel ou fabrication de semi-conducteurs

• Fabrication de lentilles ophtalmiques

• Revêtement sous vide ou dépôt en film mince

• Revêtements optiques ou fonctionnels

Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour de la nourriture produite avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines.
Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité.
Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. Par conséquent, nous faisons équipe avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

jobs.title: Navigator Configurator Specialist
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• DESIGN AND DEVELOPMENT - Creating and managing configurators for our machines, both locally and globally.
• INNOVATION - Always aiming to design state-of-the-art configurators for our new machines, as well as keeping our existing configurators up-to-date and efficient.
• TEAMWORK - Working closely with Product Management, Purchasing, Manufacturing, Logistics, and Quotation teams.
• TRAINING -Training manufacturing teams on new and updated configurators, providing data evaluations.
• SUPPORT - Stepping in to support teams as a Super User when needed.

Anforderungen:
• Technical education (Mechanical Engineering preferred) or equivalent experience
• Experience with AutoCAD or similar software
• Understanding of manufacturing principles.
• Fluent English (B2+), knowledge of Czech and German is a plus
• Comfortable juggling multiple projects and meeting deadlines.
• Good interpersonal, communication, and teamwork skills
• Customer-focused with good judgment and decision-making abilities.
• Bonus points for experience as a configurator builder, and knowledge of SAP/PLC, Windchill

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.

We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

jobs.title: Installation Supervisor
jobs.description:
Help us bring food production facilities to life.

As an Installation Supervisor at Bühler, you'll be on-site where our projects take shape. You'll guide installation teams, coordinate contractors, solve technical issues, and ensure that our machines and production systems are installed safely, correctly, and on schedule.

This role involves up to 90% international travel, primarily across Europe, with occasional assignments in other parts of the world. Installation assignments typically last 3 to 8 weeks.

To support your onboarding and development, you'll be based in Prague during your first year. During this time, you'll follow a structured onboarding and training program while joining customer site installations alongside experienced colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gradually take on more responsibility and build the skills needed to manage installation projects independently. Aufgaben: • Supervise the installation of Bühler machines and production solutions • Plan and coordinate daily installation activities on customer sites • Guide installation teams and contractors carrying out the work • Monitor quality, safety, schedules, and site readiness • Solve technical and organizational issues directly on-site • Keep customers, project managers, and internal teams informed • Prepare site reports and escalate risks or delays when needed The focus of this position is technical supervision and coordination. You'll guide the teams carrying out the installation rather than perform the installation work yourself. Anforderungen: We welcome both experienced installation professionals and candidates ready to progress from a practical technical role. You may already supervise installations or commissioning activities. Alternatively, you may have experience as a Service Technician, Site Engineer, or in another technical on-site role and be ready to take on more responsibility. What matters most is your technical understanding, sound judgement on-site, willingness to travel, and ability to work effectively with customers and contractors. You'll need: • Technical education or relevant practical technical experience • Good technical and problem-solving skills • Confidence communicating and coordinating with others • Communicative English (B2+) • Willingness to travel internationally • Driving licence New to installation management? We'll support you. Becoming a successful Installation Supervisor doesn't happen overnight. That's why we provide a structured onboarding program, technical training, and support from experienced colleagues. Whether you're already an experienced Installation Supervisor or stepping up from another hands-on technical role, we'll help you develop the skills and confidence needed to succeed in this position. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it: Aiutateci a portare a vita impianti di produzione alimentare. Come supervisore di installazione presso Bühler, sarete sul posto dove i nostri progetti prendono forma. Potrai guidare team di installazione, coordinare gli appaltatori, risolvere problemi tecnici, e garantire che le nostre macchine e sistemi di produzione siano installati in modo sicuro, corretto e puntuale. Questo ruolo coinvolge fino al 90% viaggi internazionali , principalmente in tutta Europa, con incarichi occasionali in altre parti del mondo. Le assegnazioni di installazione tipicamente durano da 3 a 8 settimane. Per sostenere il vostro onboarding e lo sviluppo, vi baserete a Praga durante il vostro primo anno. Durante questo periodo, seguirai un programma di onboarding e formazione strutturato, unendo le installazioni del sito del cliente insieme a colleghi esperti. Con l'esperienza acquisita, gradualmente assumerai più responsabilità e costruirai le competenze necessarie per gestire i progetti di installazione in modo indipendente. Aufgaben: • Supervisione dell'installazione di macchine e soluzioni di produzione Bühler • Pianificare e coordinare le attività di installazione giornaliere sui siti dei clienti • Guide team di installazione e appaltatori che effettuano il lavoro • Monitorare la qualità, la sicurezza, gli orari e la disponibilità del sito • Risolvere le questioni tecniche e organizzative direttamente in loco • Tenere informati clienti, project manager e team interni • Preparare report del sito e aumentare i rischi o ritardi quando necessario Il focus di questa posizione è la supervisione tecnica e il coordinamento. Potrai guidare le squadre che effettuano l'installazione piuttosto che eseguire il lavoro di installazione da soli. Anforderungen: Accogliamo sia professionisti di installazione esperti che candidati pronti a progredire da un ruolo tecnico pratico. È già possibile supervisionare installazioni o attività di messa in servizio. In alternativa, si può avere esperienza come tecnico di servizio, Site Engineer, o in un altro ruolo tecnico in loco e essere pronti a assumersi più responsabilità. Ciò che conta di più è la vostra comprensione tecnica, il giudizio sonoro sul posto, la volontà di viaggiare, e la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con i clienti e gli appaltatori. Ti servira': • Istruzione tecnica o esperienza tecnica pratica rilevante • Buone competenze tecniche e problem solving • Confidenza che comunica e coordina con gli altri • Inglese comunicativo (B2+) • Volontà di viaggiare a livello internazionale • Patente di guida Nuovo alla gestione dell'installazione? Ti supporteremo. Diventare un supervisore di installazione di successo non accade durante la notte. Ecco perché forniamo un programma di onboarding strutturato, formazione tecnica e supporto da colleghi esperti. Sia che tu sia già un esperto supervisore di installazione o che passi da un altro ruolo tecnico pratico, ti aiuteremo a sviluppare le competenze e la fiducia necessarie per avere successo in questa posizione. descriptionByLocale.en:
Help us bring food production facilities to life.

As an Installation Supervisor at Bühler, you'll be on-site where our projects take shape. You'll guide installation teams, coordinate contractors, solve technical issues, and ensure that our machines and production systems are installed safely, correctly, and on schedule.

This role involves up to 90% international travel, primarily across Europe, with occasional assignments in other parts of the world. Installation assignments typically last 3 to 8 weeks.

To support your onboarding and development, you'll be based in Prague during your first year. During this time, you'll follow a structured onboarding and training program while joining customer site installations alongside experienced colleagues. As you gain experience, you'll gradually take on more responsibility and build the skills needed to manage installation projects independently. Aufgaben: • Supervise the installation of Bühler machines and production solutions • Plan and coordinate daily installation activities on customer sites • Guide installation teams and contractors carrying out the work • Monitor quality, safety, schedules, and site readiness • Solve technical and organizational issues directly on-site • Keep customers, project managers, and internal teams informed • Prepare site reports and escalate risks or delays when needed The focus of this position is technical supervision and coordination. You'll guide the teams carrying out the installation rather than perform the installation work yourself. Anforderungen: We welcome both experienced installation professionals and candidates ready to progress from a practical technical role. You may already supervise installations or commissioning activities. Alternatively, you may have experience as a Service Technician, Site Engineer, or in another technical on-site role and be ready to take on more responsibility. What matters most is your technical understanding, sound judgement on-site, willingness to travel, and ability to work effectively with customers and contractors. You'll need: • Technical education or relevant practical technical experience • Good technical and problem-solving skills • Confidence communicating and coordinating with others • Communicative English (B2+) • Willingness to travel internationally • Driving licence New to installation management? We'll support you. Becoming a successful Installation Supervisor doesn't happen overnight. That's why we provide a structured onboarding program, technical training, and support from experienced colleagues. Whether you're already an experienced Installation Supervisor or stepping up from another hands-on technical role, we'll help you develop the skills and confidence needed to succeed in this position. Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines. Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries. We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Helfen Sie uns, Lebensmittelproduktionsanlagen zum Leben zu erwecken.

Als Installationsleiter bei Bühler sind Sie vor Ort, wo unsere Projekte Gestalt annehmen. Sie führen Installationsteams, koordinieren Auftragnehmer, lösen technische Probleme und stellen sicher, dass unsere Maschinen und Produktionssysteme sicher, korrekt und termingerecht installiert werden.

Diese Rolle umfasst bis zu 90% internationale Reisen, vor allem in ganz Europa, mit gelegentlichen Einsätzen in anderen Teilen der Welt. Installationszuweisungen dauern typischerweise 3 bis 8 Wochen.

Um Ihr Onboarding und Ihre Entwicklung zu unterstützen, werden Sie in Ihrem ersten Jahr in Prag ansässig sein. Während dieser Zeit folgen Sie einem strukturierten Onboarding- und Schulungsprogramm, während Sie neben erfahrenen Kollegen an den Installationen Ihrer Kunden teilnehmen. Wenn Sie Erfahrungen sammeln, übernehmen Sie allmählich mehr Verantwortung und bauen die Fähigkeiten auf, die erforderlich sind, um Installationsprojekte unabhängig zu verwalten. Aufgaben: • Beaufsichtigen Sie die Installation von Bühler Maschinen und Produktionslösungen • Planen und Koordinieren der täglichen Installationsaktivitäten an Kundenstandorten • Anleitung von Installationsteams und Auftragnehmern, die die Arbeiten durchführen • Überwachen Sie Qualität, Sicherheit, Zeitpläne und Standortbereitschaft • Lösen Sie technische und organisatorische Probleme direkt vor Ort • Kunden, Projektmanager und interne Teams auf dem Laufenden halten • Erstellen Sie Websiteberichte und eskalieren Sie bei Bedarf Risiken oder Verzögerungen Der Schwerpunkt dieser Position liegt in der technischen Überwachung und Koordination. Sie führen die Teams, die die Installation durchführen, anstatt die Installationsarbeiten selbst durchzuführen. Anforderungen: Wir begrüßen sowohl erfahrene Installationsprofis als auch Kandidaten, die bereit sind, von einer praktischen technischen Rolle voranzukommen. Sie können bereits Installationen oder Inbetriebnahmeaktivitäten überwachen. Alternativ können Sie Erfahrung als Servicetechniker, Site Engineer oder in einer anderen technischen Rolle vor Ort haben und bereit sein, mehr Verantwortung zu übernehmen. Was am wichtigsten ist, ist Ihr technisches Verständnis, Ihr fundiertes Urteil vor Ort, Ihre Reisebereitschaft und Ihre Fähigkeit, effektiv mit Kunden und Auftragnehmern zusammenzuarbeiten. Sie benötigen: • Technische Ausbildung oder einschlägige praktische technische Erfahrung • Gute technische und problemlösende Fähigkeiten • Vertrauen Kommunikation und Koordination mit anderen • Kommunikatives Englisch (B2+) • Bereitschaft, international zu reisen • Führerschein Neu im Installationsmanagement? Wir werden Sie unterstützen. Ein erfolgreicher Installationsüberwacher zu werden, passiert nicht über Nacht. Deshalb bieten wir ein strukturiertes Onboarding-Programm, technische Schulungen und Unterstützung durch erfahrene Kollegen. Egal, ob Sie bereits ein erfahrener Installationsbetreuer sind oder eine andere praktische technische Rolle übernehmen, wir helfen Ihnen, die Fähigkeiten und das Vertrauen zu entwickeln, die erforderlich sind, um in dieser Position erfolgreich zu sein. Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. Bühler zielt darauf ab, Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft bei jeder Entscheidung in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsbranche eröffnen. Wir bemühen uns, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Daher arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der akademischen Welt zusammen, um die Wirkung gemeinsam zu beschleunigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aidez-nous à mettre en place des installations de production alimentaire.

En tant que superviseur d'installation chez Bühler, vous serez sur place où nos projets prennent forme. Vous guiderez les équipes d'installation, coordonnerez les entrepreneurs, réglerez les problèmes techniques et veillerez à ce que nos machines et nos systèmes de production soient installés en toute sécurité, correctement et à temps.

Ce rôle implique jusqu'à 90 % de voyages internationaux, principalement à travers l'Europe, avec des affectations occasionnelles dans d'autres parties du monde. Les tâches d'installation durent généralement 3 à 8 semaines.

Pour soutenir votre intégration et votre développement, vous serez basé à Prague pendant votre première année. Pendant ce temps, vous suivrez un programme structuré d'embarquement et de formation tout en rejoignant les installations du site client aux côtés de collègues expérimentés. Au fur et à mesure que vous acquerrez de l'expérience, vous assumerez progressivement plus de responsabilités et développerez les compétences nécessaires pour gérer les projets d'installation de façon indépendante. Aufgaben: • Superviser l'installation des machines Bühler et des solutions de production • Planifier et coordonner les activités quotidiennes d'installation sur les sites clients • Guider les équipes d'installation et les entrepreneurs effectuant les travaux • Surveiller la qualité, la sécurité, les horaires et l'état de préparation du site • Résoudre les problèmes techniques et organisationnels directement sur place • Informer les clients, les gestionnaires de projet et les équipes internes • Préparer des rapports de site et augmenter les risques ou les retards au besoin Ce poste est axé sur la supervision et la coordination techniques. Vous guiderez les équipes qui effectuent l'installation plutôt que d'effectuer le travail d'installation vous-même. - C'est pas vrai. Nous accueillons à la fois des professionnels d'installation expérimentés et des candidats prêts à passer d'un rôle technique pratique. Vous pouvez déjà superviser des installations ou des activités de mise en service. Vous pouvez aussi avoir de l'expérience en tant que technicien de service, ingénieur de site ou dans un autre rôle technique sur place et être prêt à assumer plus de responsabilités. Ce qui compte le plus, c'est votre compréhension technique, votre jugement sur place, votre volonté de voyager et votre capacité de travailler efficacement avec les clients et les entrepreneurs. Vous aurez besoin : • Enseignement technique ou expérience technique pertinente • Bonnes compétences techniques et résolution de problèmes • La confiance communique et coordonne avec les autres • Anglais communicatif (B2+) • Volonté de voyager à l'étranger • Permis de conduire Nouveau dans la gestion de l'installation? Nous allons vous soutenir. Devenir un superviseur d'installation réussi ne se produit pas du jour au lendemain. C'est pourquoi nous offrons un programme structuré d'embarquement, une formation technique et le soutien de collègues expérimentés. Que vous soyez déjà un superviseur d'installation expérimenté ou que vous preniez un autre rôle technique pratique, nous vous aiderons à développer les compétences et la confiance nécessaires pour réussir dans ce poste. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour de la nourriture produite avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. Par conséquent, nous faisons équipe avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les universités pour accélérer l'impact ensemble.

jobs.title: Vice President of Human Resources
jobs.description:
Join our executive leadership team as Vice President of Human Resources and play a pivotal role in shaping the people strategy that drives business success across the United States, Canada, and Mexico.
As the HR leader for the region, you will have the opportunity to influence organizational culture, strengthen leadership capability, and lead initiatives across talent management, workforce planning, total rewards, employee relations, and organizational effectiveness. You will guide the regional HR team while ensuring people strategies align with business objectives and create an exceptional employee experience.
This is a unique opportunity for an experienced HR leader to make a lasting impact in a dynamic, multinational organization where people, culture, and business success go hand in hand. Aufgaben: • Serve as a trusted advisor to the CEO and executive leadership team on organizational design, talent strategy, succession planning, and change management. • Translate business strategy into long-term people and workforce plans for the North American region. • Drive the HR Shared Services strategy across North American locations. • Lead HR participation in mergers, acquisitions, restructures, and major business transformations. • Own the enterprise-wide talent management strategy, capacity planning, and succession planning for executive and critical roles. • Oversee leadership development programs, regional learning centers, apprenticeship programs, and workforce capability development. • Provide executive oversight of recruiting, onboarding, and retention strategies. • Ensure effective succession pipelines and proactive talent risk mitigation. • Lead strategy of payroll, benefits, wellness, and total rewards strategy. • Ensure compensation programs are competitive, equitable, and aligned with business objectives. • Govern salary structures, incentive programs, and executive compensation inputs. • Ensure full compliance with federal, state, and international employment laws. • Oversee HR investigations, EEO/AA programs, audits, and regulatory reporting. • Represent the organization in high-level legal, labor, or regulatory matters. • Establish and maintain enterprise HR policies and procedures. • Lead resolution of complex employee relations matters and executive-level corrective actions. • Foster positive labor relations and employee engagement across all locations. • Provide executive approval for all immigration, global mobility, and international transfers. • Ensure ongoing legal status and support for international employees and executives. • Champion company culture, values, inclusion, and employee engagement initiatives. • Drive consistency and alignment of employee experience across the North America region. • Own the HR operating budget and ensure cost-effective delivery of HR services. • Ensure HR systems, processes, and analytics support business decision-making. • Performs other executive-level duties as required. Anforderungen: • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or related field (Master's degree preferred). • SPHR, SCP, or equivalent senior HR certification strongly preferred. • Minimum of 10+ years of progressive HR leadership experience, including multi-site or regional responsibility. • Prior experience leading HR at a senior/executive level in a manufacturing, engineering, production, or industrial environment. • Advanced skills in PowerPoint, Excel, Word, and Outlook. • Experience with enterprise HRIS platforms (SAP SuccessFactors, ADP), workforce analytics tools, compensation systems, and HR reporting technologies. • Strong customer orientation with proven ability to build and maintain relationships. • Strong analytical capabilities with the ability to interpret market data and campaign metrics. • Effective leadership skills with ability to motivate and guide teams. • Clear verbal and written communication skills across diverse audiences. • Ability to work independently, manage multiple priorities, and make sound decisions. • Strong organizational skills and project management capabilities. • Solid judgment, problem‑solving skills, and ability to think both strategically and tactically. • Understanding of confidentiality requirements. • Ability to work under pressure in a fast‑paced environment. • German or Spanish language skills are a plus. • Ability to travel 30-40%. Unisciti al nostro team dirigente come Vice President of Human Resources e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione della strategia delle persone che guida il successo aziendale negli Stati Uniti, Canada e Messico. > Come leader HR per la regione, si avrà l'opportunità di influenzare la cultura organizzativa, rafforzare la capacità di leadership, e condurre iniziative attraverso la gestione del talento, la pianificazione della forza lavoro, le ricompense totali, le relazioni dei dipendenti e l'efficacia organizzativa. Potrai guidare il team regionale delle risorse umane, assicurando alle persone strategie allineate agli obiettivi aziendali e creare un'esperienza dipendente eccezionale. Questa è un'opportunità unica per un leader HR esperto per fare un impatto duraturo in un'organizzazione dinamica e multinazionale in cui le persone, la cultura e il successo aziendale vanno di pari passo.

Aufgaben:
• Servire come consulente di fiducia per il team di leadership CEO e esecutivo in progettazione organizzativa, strategia di talento, pianificazione di successione e gestione dei cambiamenti.

• Tradurre strategia aziendale in persone a lungo termine e piani di forza lavoro per la regione nordamericana.

• Guidare la strategia HR Shared Services in tutte le sedi nordamericane.

• Lead HR partecipazione a fusioni, acquisizioni, ristrutturazioni e importanti trasformazioni aziendali.

• Possiedi la strategia di gestione del talento a livello aziendale, la pianificazione della capacità e la pianificazione di successione per ruoli esecutivi e critici.

• Superare i programmi di sviluppo della leadership, i centri di apprendimento regionale, i programmi di apprendistato e lo sviluppo della capacità della forza lavoro.

• Fornire supervisione esecutivo di reclutamento, onboarding e strategie di ritenzione.

• Assicurare efficaci condutture di successione e la mitigazione del rischio di talenti proattivi.

• Guidare la strategia di payroll, benefici, benessere e la strategia di ricompensa totale.

• Assicurare programmi di compensazione sono competitivi, equitable, e allineati con gli obiettivi aziendali.

• Governare strutture salariali, programmi di incentivazione e ingressi di compensazione esecutiva.

• Assicurare il pieno rispetto delle leggi federali, statali e internazionali sul lavoro.

• supervisionare le indagini sulle risorse umane, i programmi EEO/AA, gli audit e i rapporti normativi.

• Rappresentare l'organizzazione in questioni legali, di lavoro o regolamentari di alto livello.

• Stabilire e mantenere le politiche e le procedure aziendali HR.

• Risoluzione di piombo di questioni complesse relazioni dei dipendenti e azioni correttive di livello esecutivo.

• Promuovere rapporti di lavoro positivi e l'impegno dei dipendenti in tutte le posizioni.

• Fornire l'approvazione esecutiva per tutta l'immigrazione, la mobilità globale e trasferimenti internazionali.

• Assicurare lo stato legale in corso e il supporto per dipendenti e dirigenti internazionali.

• Campione della cultura aziendale, valori, inclusione e iniziative di coinvolgimento dei dipendenti.

• Consistenza e allineamento dell'esperienza dei dipendenti nella regione del Nord America.

• Possedere il bilancio operativo HR e garantire la consegna economica dei servizi HR.

• Assicurare sistemi, processi e processi di analisi supportano il processo decisionale aziendale.

• Esegui altri compiti di livello esecutivo come richiesto.

Anforderungen:
• Corso di laurea in Risorse Umane, Business Administration, o relativo campo (la laurea preferita).

• SPHR, SCP, o equivalente senior certificazione HR fortemente preferito.

• Minimo di 10+ anni di esperienza di leadership HR progressiva, tra cui responsabilità multi-sito o regionale.

• Esperienza prioritaria che conduce le risorse umane a livello senior/executive in un ambiente di produzione, ingegneria, produzione o industriale.

• Capacità avanzate in PowerPoint, Excel, Word e Outlook.

• Esperienza con piattaforme HRIS aziendali (SAP SuccessFactors, ADP), strumenti di analisi della forza lavoro, sistemi di compensazione e tecnologie di reporting HR.

• Forte orientamento del cliente con comprovata capacità di costruire e mantenere relazioni.

• Forte capacità analitiche con la capacità di interpretare i dati di mercato e le metriche di campagna.

• Capacità di leadership efficaci con capacità di motivare e guidare i team.

• Competenze di comunicazione verbali e scritte chiare attraverso il pubblico vario.

• Capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, gestire più priorità e prendere decisioni valide.

• Forte capacità organizzative e capacità di gestione del progetto.

• Giudizio solido, capacità di problem solving e capacità di pensare sia strategicamente che tatticamente.

• Comprensione dei requisiti di riservatezza.

• Capacità di lavorare sotto pressione in un ambiente frenetico.

• Le competenze linguistiche tedesche o spagnole sono un vantaggio.

• Capacità di viaggiare 30-40%.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden. descriptionByLocale.fr:
Joignez-vous à notre équipe de direction à titre de vice-président des Ressources humaines et jouez un rôle central dans l'élaboration de la stratégie en matière de ressources humaines qui favorise le succès des entreprises aux États-Unis, au Canada et au Mexique.
En tant que chef des RH de la région, vous aurez l'occasion d'influencer la culture organisationnelle, de renforcer la capacité de leadership et de diriger les initiatives de gestion des talents, de planification de l'effectif, de récompenses totales, de relations avec les employés et d'efficacité organisationnelle. Vous guiderez l'équipe régionale des RH tout en veillant à ce que les stratégies en matière de ressources humaines cadrent avec les objectifs opérationnels et créent une expérience exceptionnelle pour les employés.
C'est une occasion unique pour un leader expérimenté des RH d'avoir un impact durable dans une organisation multinationale dynamique où les gens, la culture et le succès des affaires vont de pair. Aufgaben: • Servir de conseiller de confiance auprès du chef de la direction et de l'équipe de direction sur la conception organisationnelle, la stratégie des talents, la planification de la relève et la gestion du changement. • Traduire la stratégie d'affaires en plans à long terme de personnel et de main-d'oeuvre pour la région nord-américaine. • Diriger la stratégie des services partagés en RH dans les régions nord-américaines. • Diriger la participation des RH aux fusions, aux acquisitions, aux restructurations et aux grandes transformations commerciales. • Posséder la stratégie globale de gestion des talents, la planification des capacités et la planification de la relève pour les rôles de direction et les rôles essentiels. • Superviser les programmes de perfectionnement en leadership, les centres d'apprentissage régionaux, les programmes d'apprentissage et le développement des capacités de la main-d'oeuvre. • Assurer la supervision exécutive des stratégies de recrutement, d'embarquement et de maintien en poste. • Assurer l'efficacité des pipelines de relève et l'atténuation proactive des risques liés aux talents. • Diriger la stratégie de paie, d'avantages sociaux, de bien-être et de récompenses totales. • Veiller à ce que les programmes de rémunération soient concurrentiels, équitables et conformes aux objectifs opérationnels. • Structures salariales, programmes incitatifs et intrants de rémunération des cadres supérieurs. • Assurer le plein respect des lois fédérales, des États et internationales sur l'emploi. • Superviser les enquêtes sur les RH, les programmes d'EEO/AA, les vérifications et les rapports réglementaires. • Représenter l'organisation en matière de droit, de travail ou de réglementation. • Établir et maintenir des politiques et des procédures ministérielles en matière de RH. • Diriger la résolution de questions complexes de relations avec les employés et de mesures correctives au niveau de la direction. • Favoriser des relations de travail positives et l'engagement des employés dans tous les endroits. • Fournir l'approbation exécutive pour tous les transferts d'immigration, de mobilité mondiale et internationaux. • Assurer un statut juridique et un soutien continus aux employés et aux cadres internationaux. • Promouvoir la culture d'entreprise, les valeurs, l'inclusion et les initiatives d'engagement des employés. • Favoriser l'uniformité et l'harmonisation de l'expérience des employés dans la région de l'Amérique du Nord. • Détenir le budget de fonctionnement des RH et assurer la prestation rentable des services de RH. • Veiller à ce que les systèmes, les processus et l'analyse des RH appuient la prise de décisions opérationnelles. • Exécute d'autres fonctions de direction au besoin. - C'est pas vrai. • Baccalauréat en ressources humaines, administration des affaires ou domaine connexe (diplôme de maîtrise préféré). • La DSRH, le SCP ou l'équivalent de la certification RH senior ont fortement préféré. • Au moins 10 ans d'expérience progressive en leadership en RH, y compris la responsabilité multi-site ou régionale. • Expérience antérieure menant les RH à un niveau supérieur ou exécutif dans un environnement industriel, industriel ou de fabrication. • Compétences avancées en PowerPoint, Excel, Word et Outlook. • Expérience avec les plateformes HRIS d'entreprise (SAP SuccessFactors, ADP), les outils d'analyse de la main-d'oeuvre, les systèmes de rémunération et les technologies de rapport RH. • Une forte orientation client avec une capacité prouvée de construire et de maintenir des relations. • Fortes capacités d'analyse permettant d'interpréter les données du marché et les mesures de campagne. • Compétences efficaces en leadership avec capacité de motiver et de guider les équipes. • Compétences claires en communication verbale et écrite pour divers auditoires. • Capacité de travailler de façon indépendante, de gérer plusieurs priorités et de prendre de bonnes décisions. • Des compétences organisationnelles solides et des capacités de gestion de projet. • Un jugement solide, des compétences en résolution de problèmes et la capacité de penser stratégiquement et tactiquement. • Compréhension des exigences de confidentialité. • Capacité de travailler sous pression dans un environnement rapide. • Les compétences linguistiques en allemand ou en espagnol sont un plus. • Capacité de voyager de 30 à 40%. Deux milliards de personnes mangent chaque jour de la nourriture produite avec des équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines. Bühler vise à équilibrer l'humanité, la nature et l'économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les industries mondiales de l'alimentation humaine, de l'alimentation animale et de la mobilité. Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant l'accent sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine - in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico.

La chiave del nostro successo è la nostra forza lavoro diversificata da più di 100 nazioni e la nostra cultura inclusiva.

Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology cameras, head up displays of cars and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

To support our team in Alzenau, we are looking for a reliable and service-oriented personality who, with organizational talent, accuracy and enjoyment of administrative tasks, ensures the smooth running of our daily business.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • Travel management: organisation and booking of business trips and processing of visa applications • SAP activities: Recording of time bookings and creation of requirements and orders • Fleet management: Care of leasing vehicles including contract management, negotiations with leasing companies and claims coordination • Office Management: Administrative and organizational support in day-to-day business • Reception Representation: Representation Supervision of the reception, including visitor registration and telephone exchange (reception opening hours: 07:30 to 17:00) Requirements • They have successfully completed commercial training and have several years of professional experience in the assistant sector or in comparable administrative functions. • You are safe in dealing with MS Office; Knowledge of SAP is an advantage. • They communicate very safely in German and well in English – both verbally and in writing. • They work independently, structured, carefully and goal-oriented. • A friendly, professional appearance, organizational talent and a pronounced service orientation distinguish you. We offer: Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. 2007年，布勒（无锡）商业有限公司成立于江苏无锡市。凭借先进的技术优势，公司在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造及研磨与分散等领域引领市场。公司拥有制粉，面条，色选，消费食品，研磨分散等多个独立应用中心及客户服务中心，提供多产业链集成解决方案。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案。

Aufgaben:
• 基于 Unity3D 进行三维可视化、数字孪生、仿真交互类项目功能开发；

• 负责 3D 场景搭建、模型整合、相机控制、视角切换、漫游等基础交互实现；

• 完成界面开发，包括数据面板、按钮、弹窗、列表、图表联动等；

• 对接后端接口，实现数据解析、数据绑定、三维场景与数据联动展示；

• 实现模型点击查询、信息弹窗、区域高亮、路径动画、点位标记等业务功能；

• 参与项目打包发布（PC 端、WebGL、Windows 应用等）；

• 协助测试定位 Bug，完成功能迭代与优化。

Anforderungen:
• 大学本科学历及以上，本科及以上学历；计算机、软件等相关专业优先。

• 精通Unity3D，5年以上相关工作经验

• 有完整U3D上线/量产项目经验，至少1-2个案例

• 有从github下载相关库并应用的经验

• 有三维场景交互、数据可视化、仿真演示类项目经验优先；

• 熟悉 Unity 编辑器使用，掌握场景、物体、材质、灯光、预设体基础操作；

• 能独立完成 UGUI 界面制作与交互，适配多分辨率；

• 具备基本的网络请求认知，能完成接口对接与数据展示；

• 良好的数学和计算机图形学基础，能独立编写与优化Shader

• 熟悉WebGL下图形渲染相关的配置，对于WebGL下Unity相关限制有所了解并有相应对策

• 熟练使用 C# 进行开发，对于常用算法有所掌握能独立编写逻辑代码，理解面向对象基础。

• 能够熟练应用AI工具，使用AI提效

• 了解Three.js和UE5

• 了解协程、射线检测、事件、数据解析（JSON）等常用功能

• 有基础英语读写能力，及口语沟通能力

• 勇于攻坚技术难点，积极拥抱新技术

• 具备良好的沟通能力和理解能力；

• 能适应必要的现场调试、出差或驻场支持工作。

We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

2007年，布勒（无锡）商业有限公司成立于江苏无锡市。凭借先进的技术优势，公司在谷物处理加工、消费食品制造及研磨与分散等领域引领市场。公司拥有制粉，面条，色选，消费食品，研磨分散等多个独立应用中心及客户服务中心，提供多产业链集成解决方案。我们秉持“布勒创新，驱动未来”愿景 ，携布勒集团全球资源，利用本地化优势，致力于开发更多创新解决方案。

• 具有 .NET 平台开发经验；

• 熟悉异步、泛型、委托、反射、多线程等相关基础知识。

• 熟悉 PostgreSQL、SQL Server、MySQL 中的一种或多种数据库，熟悉 ADO.NET、EF、EF Core、SqlSugar、Dapper 等 ORM 框架。

jobs.title: Technical Training Specialist (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Are you passionate about creating engaging learning experiences and turning technical knowledge into practical training solutions that support customer success?

The Consumer Foods Academy equips Bühler employees and customers with the skills to operate, maintain, and optimize our biscuit machines and production lines. In this role, you will design, coordinate, and deliver digital, classroom, and hands-on training programs for internal and external audiences. Working closely with experts and technicians, you will translate complex technical knowledge into practical learning solutions that drive professional development and operational excellence.

If this sounds like the right opportunity for you, we look forward to receiving your CV and motivational letter. Please note that this role can be based in either Denmark or Austria. Aufgaben: • Design, coordinate, and deliver technical training courses for Bühler customers and employees worldwide, in line with CF Academy guidelines and Bühler standards. • Develop modern, interactive training modules for internal and external target groups, including technicians, engineers, operators, and maintenance personnel. • Tailor training content and methods to defined learning objectives, combining theoretical and practical knowledge for biscuit production lines. • Create and maintain training materials, such as presentations, video tutorials, and interactive learning modules. • Review and update training concepts in close collaboration with the CF Academy lead, and support related communication and promotional activities. Anforderungen: • Technical education or training, such as an apprenticeship, technical college qualification, university degree, or relevant experience in a technical environment. • Strong hands-on technical mindset with a passion for practical work on machinery and equipment. • Strong ability to structure and explain complex technical topics clearly, with motivation to share knowledge in classroom or virtual training settings. • Hands-on interest in machines, production environments, technical processes, and modern learning formats. • Good Microsoft Office skills and experience or interest in creating e-learnings. • Strong English and Danish skills; German is an advantage. • Structured, independent, and precise working style with a positive, confident, and approachable communication style. • Willingness and ability to travel approximately 30% of the time, including international travel as required. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Sei appassionato di creare esperienze di apprendimento coinvolgenti e trasformare le conoscenze tecniche in soluzioni pratiche di formazione che supportano il successo del cliente? La Consumer Foods Academy equipaggia dipendenti e clienti Bühler con le competenze per operare, mantenere e ottimizzare le nostre macchine per biscotti e linee di produzione. In questo ruolo, progettare, coordinare e fornire programmi di formazione digitale, aula e hands-on per il pubblico interno ed esterno. Lavorando a stretto contatto con esperti e tecnici, tradurrai conoscenze tecniche complesse in soluzioni pratiche di apprendimento che spingono lo sviluppo professionale e l'eccellenza operativa. Se questo suona come l'opportunità giusta per voi, non vediamo l'ora di ricevere il vostro CV e lettera motivazionale. Si prega di notare che questo ruolo può essere basato in Danimarca o in Austria.

Aufgaben:
• Progettazione, coordinare e fornire corsi di formazione tecnica per clienti e dipendenti Bühler in tutto il mondo, in linea con le linee guida CF Academy e gli standard Bühler.

• Sviluppare moduli di formazione moderni e interattivi per gruppi target interni ed esterni, tra cui tecnici, ingegneri, operatori e personale di manutenzione.

• Contenuto e metodi di formazione su misura per obiettivi di apprendimento definiti, combinando conoscenze teoriche e pratiche per le linee di produzione di biscotti.

• Creare e mantenere materiali di formazione, come presentazioni, tutorial video e moduli di apprendimento interattivo.

• Revisione e aggiornamento dei concetti di formazione in stretta collaborazione con il direttore CF Academy, e supporto di comunicazione e attività promozionali.

Anforderungen:
• Istruzione tecnica o formazione, come un apprendistato, qualifica di college tecnico, laurea o esperienza rilevante in un ambiente tecnico.

• Forte mentalità tecnica pratica con una passione per il lavoro pratico su macchinari e attrezzature.

• Forte capacità di strutturare e spiegare chiaramente argomenti tecnici complessi, con la motivazione di condividere le conoscenze in classe o impostazioni di formazione virtuale.

• Hands-on interesse per macchine, ambienti di produzione, processi tecnici e formati di apprendimento moderni.

• Buone competenze Microsoft Office e l'esperienza o l'interesse a creare e-learnings.

• Forti competenze inglesi e danesi; il tedesco è un vantaggio.

• Stile di lavoro strutturato, indipendente e preciso con uno stile di comunicazione positivo, sicuro e accessibile.

• Volontà e capacità di viaggiare circa il 30% del tempo, compresi i viaggi internazionali come richiesto.

Sind Sie leidenschaftlich daran interessiert, ansprechende Lernerfahrungen zu schaffen und technisches Wissen in praktische Schulungslösungen umzuwandeln, die den Kundenerfolg unterstützen?

Die Consumer Foods Academy stattet Bühler Mitarbeiter und Kunden mit den Fähigkeiten aus, unsere Keksmaschinen und Produktionslinien zu betreiben, zu warten und zu optimieren. In dieser Rolle entwerfen, koordinieren und liefern Sie digitale, Klassenzimmer- und praktische Schulungsprogramme für interne und externe Zielgruppen. In enger Zusammenarbeit mit Experten und Technikern übersetzen Sie komplexes technisches Wissen in praktische Lernlösungen, die die berufliche Entwicklung und operative Exzellenz vorantreiben.

Wenn dies nach der richtigen Gelegenheit für Sie klingt, freuen wir uns auf Ihren Lebenslauf und Ihr Motivationsschreiben. Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.

• Hai completato una laurea tecnica, in alternativa un'ulteriore formazione come tecnico, economista aziendale o una qualifica paragonabile.

• Porti la tua prima esperienza professionale nel supporto vendite, nel servizio interno di vendita, nella preparazione di offerte o in una funzione paragonabile.

• Idealmente, hai già lavorato con strumenti di citazione, calcolo, CRM o configurazione del prodotto e hai una buona comprensione tecnica e commerciale.

• Grazie alle vostre buone competenze linguistiche in inglese, è possibile comunicare in modo sicuro con i clienti internazionali, nonché le vendite e le aree specialistiche in tutto il mondo.

• Un modo sistematico, strutturato e attento di lavorare, oltre a forti capacità di comunicazione e coordinamento, vi distingue.

• Iniziativa, affidabilità, lavoro di squadra e divertimento di lavorare insieme in un ambiente internazionale completano il tuo profilo.

Offriamo una vasta gamma di opportunità di apprendimento, come video, formazione online, formazione faccia a faccia e webinar con formati brevi, rilevanti, coinvolgenti, personalizzati e mobili.

Godetevi pasti sani nella nostra mensa a prezzi equi.

Il vostro impegno ci rende possibile. Vogliamo festeggiare insieme a te. Le nostre feste di Natale, feste estive, eventi sportivi e eventi di squadra offrono le migliori opportunità per farlo.

Posto di lavoro moderno con le migliori attrezzature tecniche
Lavorare in un luogo di lavoro moderno dotato degli ultimi strumenti tecnici per aumentare la produttività e l'innovazione.

Cultura aziendale familiare
Abbiamo più di 160 anni di storia. Questo ci rende una società che pensa e investe a lungo termine – in innovazione, i nostri dipendenti e il successo economico.

Vantaggi e sconti dei dipendenti
Godetevi una varietà di vantaggi e sconti per i dipendenti che rendono la vostra vita quotidiana più facile. Diventa parte della nostra squadra e scopri di più.

descriptionByLocale.en:
As part of the globally active Bühler Group, Bühler Leybold Optics is one of the market leaders for high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have been developing innovative solutions for the coating of architectural glass, spectacle lenses and optical components for smartphones, vehicles and medical technology.

As an employee of (m/f/d) Sales Interior Service / Sales Support, you support the sales team and division management with offers, calculations and project documents. With your structured working method, you ensure efficient processes and accompany international customer projects administratively. Become part of Bühler Alzenau GmbH!

Let us make a difference together at Bühler!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • They create, revise and verify the plausibility of calculations and offers for international plant projects. • They bring together information and requirements from our worldwide sales and specialist areas in a structured manner and create a reliable supply basis. • They support our customers worldwide during the offer process and are at their disposal as a competent contact person. • You coordinate the internal coordination with engineering, purchasing, project management and service and thus support the sales team in the preparation of the offer. • They ensure complete and proper project budgeting. • You take on administrative and organizational tasks in the Sales Back Office and support the department management in evaluations, presentations and reports. Requirements • You have completed a technical degree, alternatively a further education as a technician, business economist or a comparable qualification. • You bring your first professional experience in sales support, sales internal service, in the preparation of offers or in a comparable function. • Ideally, you have already worked with quotation, calculation, CRM or product configuration tools and have a good technical and commercial understanding. • You are safe in dealing with MS Office; Knowledge of SAP is an advantage. • Thanks to your good English language skills, you can communicate securely with international customers as well as worldwide sales and specialist areas. • A systematic, structured and careful way of working as well as strong communication and coordination skills set you apart. • Initiative, reliability, teamwork and enjoyment of working together in an international environment round off your profile. We offer: Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. Canteen with healthy meals Enjoy healthy meals in our canteen at fair prices. Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation. Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term – in innovation, our employees and economic success. Employee benefits and discounts Enjoy a variety of employee benefits and discounts that make your everyday life easier. Become part of our team and find out more. With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries. We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together.

jobs.title: Service Sales Engineer
jobs.description:
Bühler Group in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia is looking for a CS Sales professional to develop new client relationships and business for the sale of spare parts, retrofits, and single machine products. This role is responsible for developing sales opportunities, managing customer relationships, understanding customer needs, preparing commercial proposals and quotations, and supporting growth across the assigned territory. The position works closely with the Sales and Service Team, aligns market activities with the Area Sales/Service Manager, and contributes to customer satisfaction and business growth.

Aufgaben:
• Develop and maintain sales materials and current product knowledge.

• Establish, manage, and maintain relationships with current and potential clients.

• Prepare action plans and schedules to increase business activities in the assigned territory.

• Identify sales prospects, contact new and existing accounts, and follow up on leads and referrals resulting from field activity.

• Align and complement market activities with the existing Area Sales/Service Manager in the assigned territory.

• Identify and understand customer needs and provide optimum customer service and support.

• Identify, handle, and resolve customer complaints and concerns.

• Communicate new product and service opportunities and special developments gathered through field activity to the Supervisor.

• Prepare presentations, proposals, and quotations, and generate sales leads for equipment and plant business.

• Participate in marketing events such as seminars.

• Ensure client data in CRM is up to date.

• Implement company sales targets in the assigned market territory and contribute to budget achievement for Orders Released, Turnover, and DB1 for plant & equipment and CS business.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering.

• Minimum 3 years of experience in the Grains and Food Processing industry.

• Strong knowledge of Grains and Food Processing, with outstanding sales and customer relationship management skills.

• Ability to conduct sales conversations and contract negotiations, with strong presentation and negotiation skills.

• Ability to develop technical/technological solutions with and for customers; strong problem-solving and decision-making skills.

• Excellent written and oral communication skills, with the ability to work effectively with internal and external stakeholders and in a matrix organization.

• Fluent in English; knowledge of Arabic is an advantage. PSSR experience is an advantage.

• Willingness to travel and ability to work independently, manage time and priorities effectively, and handle confidential and sensitive information.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Bühler Group a Riyadh, Arabia Saudita sta cercando un professionista di vendite CS per sviluppare nuove relazioni cliente e business per la vendita di pezzi di ricambio, retrofit e prodotti per macchine singole. Questo ruolo è responsabile per lo sviluppo di opportunità di vendita, la gestione delle relazioni con i clienti, la comprensione delle esigenze dei clienti, la preparazione di proposte commerciali e citazioni, e sostenere la crescita in tutto il territorio assegnato. La posizione lavora a stretto contatto con il Team Vendite e Servizi, allinea le attività di mercato con l'Area Sales/Service Manager e contribuisce alla soddisfazione del cliente e alla crescita del business.

Aufgaben:
• Sviluppare e mantenere i materiali di vendita e le conoscenze attuali del prodotto.

• Stabilire, gestire e mantenere relazioni con clienti attuali e potenziali.

• Preparare piani d'azione e programmi per aumentare le attività commerciali nel territorio assegnato.

• Identificare le prospettive di vendita, contattare i conti nuovi e esistenti, e seguire i lead e i rinvii derivanti dall'attività sul campo.

• Allineare e integrare le attività di mercato con l'Area Sales/Service Manager esistente nel territorio assegnato.

• Identificare e comprendere le esigenze dei clienti e fornire un servizio clienti ottimale e supporto.

• Identificare, gestire e risolvere reclami e preoccupazioni dei clienti.

• Comunicare nuove opportunità di prodotto e di servizio e sviluppi speciali riuniti attraverso l'attività sul campo al Supervisore.

• Preparare le presentazioni, le proposte e le citazioni, e generare i cavi di vendita per attrezzature e impianti.

• Partecipa a eventi di marketing come seminari.

• Assicurarsi che i dati dei clienti in CRM siano aggiornati.

• Implementare obiettivi di vendita aziendale nel territorio di mercato assegnato e contribuire al raggiungimento di bilancio per Ordini Rilasciati, Turnover e DB1 per impianti e attrezzature e business CS.

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in ingegneria.

• Minimo 3 anni di esperienza nel settore dei cereali e della trasformazione alimentare.

• Forte conoscenza di Grains and Food Processing, con eccezionali competenze di gestione delle vendite e delle relazioni con i clienti.

• Capacità di condurre conversazioni di vendita e trattative contrattuali, con forti capacità di presentazione e negoziazione.

• Capacità di sviluppare soluzioni tecniche/tecnologiche con e per i clienti; forti capacità di problem solving e decision-making.

• Eccellente capacità di comunicazione scritta e orale, con la capacità di lavorare efficacemente con gli stakeholder interni ed esterni e in un'organizzazione di matrice.

• Fluente in inglese; la conoscenza dell'arabo è un vantaggio. L'esperienza PSSR è un vantaggio.

• Volontà di viaggiare e capacità di lavorare in modo indipendente, gestire il tempo e le priorità in modo efficace, e gestire informazioni riservate e sensibili.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano cibo ogni giorno che è stato prodotto con attrezzature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler si propone di bilanciare l'umanità, la natura e l'economia in ogni decisione, sviluppando soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori alimentare, alimentare e della mobilità globale.
Ci sforziamo di creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con un focus speciale su soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, ci impegniamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e accademia per accelerare l'impatto insieme.

jobs.title: SPS-Programmierer (m/w/d) Maschinenbau

Bühler Leybold Optics gehört zu den weltweit führenden Unternehmen im Bereich Hightech‑Dünnfilm‑Beschichtungssysteme. Als Teil der globalen Bühler Group mit über 13.000 Mitarbeitenden entwickeln wir Technologien, die in Smartphones, Autos, Medizintechnik und Architekturglas auf der ganzen Welt eingesetzt werden.

Als SPS-Programmierer (m/w/d) sind Sie für die Anpassung, Weiterentwicklung und Neuentwicklung der Software unserer Vakuumbeschichtungsanlagen verantwortlich. Mit Ihrer strukturierten und selbstständigen Arbeitsweise und Ihrer Freude an Innovationen sind Sie ein wichtiges Mitglied unseres internationalen und dynamischen Teams bei der Bühler Alzenau GmbH. Ergreifen Sie die Chance und bewerben Sie sich jetzt!

As part of the global Bühler Group with more than 13,000 employees, we develop technologies that are used in smartphones, cars, medical technology and architectural glass all over the world.


Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Bühler Leybold Optics est l'une des plus grandes entreprises du monde dans le domaine des systèmes de revêtement de film mince de haute technologie. Dans le cadre du Groupe Bühler mondial avec plus de 13 000 collaborateurs, nous développons des technologies qui sont utilisées dans les smartphones, les voitures, la technologie médicale et le verre architectural dans le monde entier.


À Bühler, faisons la différence ensemble!
Deux milliards de personnes mangent de la nourriture produite par les plantes de Bühler chaque jour. Un milliard de personnes voyagent dans des véhicules dont les pièces ont été produites grâce aux technologies Bühler.
Avec chaque décision, Bühler poursuit l'objectif de concilier les besoins de l'économie, des personnes et de la nature. De cette façon, nous développons des solutions qui ouvrent des débouchés commerciaux durables dans les industries mondiales des aliments pour animaux, des aliments pour animaux et de la mobilité.
Nous voulons créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, avec un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C'est pourquoi nous travaillons avec les clients, les start-up, les multinationales et les scientifiques pour obtenir un impact plus rapide ensemble. Tâches : • Développement de solutions logicielles personnalisées : Vous développez des solutions logicielles personnalisées pour contrôler nos installations et machines. • Couverture du cycle du projet: Vous prenez en charge tout le cycle des projets logiciels, de la conception à la mise en œuvre. • Planification et mise en oeuvre: Vous planifiez et mettez en œuvre des systèmes de mesure et de contrôle complexes. • Mise en service du logiciel: Vous supportez le logiciel mis en service à la fois à Alzenau et, si nécessaire, directement sur le site du client. • Coopération interministérielle : Vous travaillez en étroite collaboration avec d'autres ministères et contribuez au développement de nos processus. Exigences • Études réussies : Vous avez réussi des études en génie électrique, en technologie des communications, en technologie d'automatisation, en informatique technique ou dans un domaine comparable. • Expérience professionnelle en automatisation: Vous pouvez montrer l'expérience professionnelle initiale dans le domaine de l'automatisation des machines et des équipements. • Expérience avec C# et WPF: Vous avez une connaissance approfondie de C# et WPF. • Expérience technique et expérience PLC: Idéalement, vous avez une expérience technique et une expérience avec les connexions PLC, en particulier Beckhoff et Siemens. • Compétences linguistiques: Très bon allemand et bonnes compétences en anglais en mots et en écriture complètent votre profil. Nous offrons: Développement professionnel et personnel Nous offrons un large éventail de possibilités d'apprentissage, telles que des vidéos, des formations en ligne, des formations en face à face et des webinaires avec des formats courts, pertinents, engageants, personnalisés et mobiles. Une cantine avec des repas sains Profitez de repas sains dans notre cantine à des prix équitables. Manifestations et événements en équipe Votre engagement nous rend possibles. Nous voulons célébrer ça avec vous. Nos fêtes de Noël, les fêtes d'été, les événements sportifs et les événements en équipe offrent les meilleures occasions de le faire. Un lieu de travail moderne avec le meilleur équipement technique Travailler dans un lieu de travail moderne équipé des derniers outils techniques pour augmenter votre productivité et votre innovation. Avantages sociaux et rabais Profitez d'une variété d'avantages sociaux et de réductions qui facilitent votre vie quotidienne. Faites partie de notre équipe et en savoir plus. Environnement de travail interculturel La clé de notre succès est notre main-d'oeuvre diversifiée de plus de 100 pays et notre culture inclusive. jobs.title: Regional Channel Development Manager
jobs.description:
As Regional Channel Partner Specialist, you will serve as the primary link between our commercial team and our region network of distributors, reseller and dealers. Your mission is to scale our market presence by empowering partners with the technical knowledge, sales tools, and strategic support they need to succeed. The role is task to manage the entire partner lifecycle from scouting and onboarding new partners to driving revenue growth within established accounts.

Aufgaben:
• Identify, recruit, and onboard high-performing channel partners in key geographic territories. Develop and execute strategic channel programs to drive significant sales growth and market share expansion through partner networks

• Establish clear performance metrics and goals for each partner, aligned with overall channel objectives. Regularly monitor partner performance, identify areas for improvement, and implement corrective actions as needed

• Coordinate with the internal team to provide partners with deep-dive training product and services

• Build strong, trust-based relationships with key decision-makers within partner organizations. Proactively identify and address partner challenges and roadblocks to ensure smooth collaboration

• Stay abreast of industry trends, competitor activity, and market conditions that may impact the channel landscape. Analyze partner performance data to identify trends, opportunities, and areas for improvement. Generate comprehensive reports on channel performance, including sales results, pipeline metrics, and partner satisfaction levels

Anforderungen:
• Bachelors degree in business management or equivalent

• Minimum 5 years of experience in channel management, with a proven track record of success in driving significant revenue growth through partner networks. Prior sales experience and track records will be an added advantage.

• Proficiency in CRM system

• Proficiency in English, both spoken and written

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

Project Manager for fulfillment work related to the production of machines, tools, products and other equipment related to BuhlerPrince's product portfolio, with substantial latitude for unreviewed action or decision. This role primarily focuses on smaller new equipment projects & retrofits for the existing installed base across North America.

Aufgaben:
