• Lead cross-functional project teams, proactively managing project risks, opportunities, deviations, change orders, and claims to ensure successful project outcomes.

• Conduct project reviews, oversee project documentation and handoffs, and ensure site personnel receive the information and resources needed for safe and effective project execution.

• Capture lessons learned and drive continuous improvement initiatives while supporting operational excellence within the Project Management and Quotation teams; travel domestically and internationally as required to support project activities.

Required Skills and Experience

• 4-year Engineering degree or other equivalent training or experience

• Excellent oral and written communication skills

• Experience working in a team environment

• Experience managing work groups without having direct authority

• Ability to manage customer relationships

• Sound judgement and decision-making skills

• Strong planning and organizational skills

• Highly developed computer skills in Microsoft Office Suite

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Understanding of die casting machinery specifications, automation, and die casting processes.

• 3+ years of professional project management experience

• Experience working in an international matrix organizatio

• German language skills a plus.

jobs.title: Field Service Team Leader

titleByLocale.fr: Chef d ' équipe du Service mobile

jobs.description:
Bühler Group in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia is looking for a Field Service Team Leader to support the Service Operations Manager in leading daily field service operations and ensuring the effective deployment of field service engineers across projects and customer sites. This role is responsible for resource planning, workforce utilization, technical coordination, team development, and the safe and efficient execution of service activities. The position works closely with Project Managers, Safety Advisors, customers, and cross-functional teams to anticipate resource requirements, maintain high technical and quality standards, strengthen customer relationships, and identify service sales opportunities. The role also promotes a culture of safety, integrity, accountability, and continuous development while contributing to operational excellence, customer satisfaction, and sustainable business growth.

Aufgaben:
• Work closely with the Service Operations Manager to oversee daily operations and lead the field service team.

• Assign, coordinate, and monitor field service activities and engineers executing site work across various projects.

• Prepare and monitor FSE resource plans and utilization with the manager to balance availability, target backlogs, and business demands.

• Participate in or lead weekly resource allocation meetings with the Project Management team.

• Review the FSE skill matrix to ensure the right engineer is assigned to the right project or service task.

• Demonstrate exemplary professional behavior, a positive personal attitude, and high technical standards.

• Seek management support and guidance proactively when complex situations arise.

• Coordinate FSE deployments and manage workflows for mobilization and travel plans.

• Partner with Project Managers to forecast upcoming project needs and secure necessary manpower.

• Build strong relationships with customers during service execution to convert working relationships into long-term business partnerships.

• Identify and promote service sales opportunities with customers during site visits to drive business growth.

• Collaborate with Safety Advisors to ensure FSE compliance and maintain a zero-incident on sites.

• Support the team in utilizing safety tools, reporting hazards, and logging safety events in the system.

• Assign and monitor all required team training regarding safety, integrity, quality, and the company code of conduct.

• Encourage the team to actively participate in company-organized safety and quality initiatives.

• Immediately report any misconduct or unsafe activities by team members or contractors to upper management.

• Create and execute FSE development plans covering technical skills, soft skills, and product certifications.

• Provide hands-on technical coaching to the team and arrange technical discussions with OEM when product clarifications are needed.

• Establish team goals aligned with business KPIs, driving discussions during the annual EPM cycle.

• Lead motivational activities and assess team engagement through regular feedback and Survey action plans

• You will be responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.

• Living Buhler Group core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.

Anforderungen:
• A bachelor's degree in mechanical / electrical engineering.

• Proven 6 to 10 years technical and Leadership experience within Food Industry.

• Project management and site management background are an advantage.

• Proficiency in both spoken & written in English, Arabic language is an advantage.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

• segnalare immediatamente eventuali attività di cattiva condotta o non sicure da parte dei membri del team o degli appaltatori alla gestione superiore.

• Creare ed eseguire piani di sviluppo FSE che coprono competenze tecniche, competenze morbide e certificazioni di prodotto.

• Fornire assistenza tecnica alla squadra e organizzare discussioni tecniche con OEM quando sono necessari chiarimenti di prodotto.

• Stabilire obiettivi di squadra allineati con business KPI, guida discussioni durante il ciclo annuale EPM.

• Guidare attività motivazionali e valutare l'impegno del team attraverso feedback regolari e piani d'azione Survey

• L'utente sarà responsabile di garantire il rispetto delle normative, procedure e linee guida esterne e interne applicabili.

Anforderungen:
• Laurea in ingegneria meccanica / elettrica.

• Da 6 a 10 anni esperienza tecnica e Leadership all'interno dell'industria alimentare.

jobs.title: Field Service Coordinator
jobs.description:
As a Field Service Coordinator, you will play a key role in supporting our Field Service Engineers and ensuring exceptional service for our customers. In this fast-paced, collaborative position, you will coordinate daily field service activities, serve as a primary point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, and help drive efficient service execution. Success in this role requires strong organizational skills, customer focus, and the ability to build positive relationships while supporting a high-performing service team.

Aufgaben:
• Create customer quotes, orders, and purchase requisitions in SAP

• Follow up with customers on pending quotes, purchase orders, revisions, and scheduling

• Schedule and track jobs in SAP Connect

• Provide FSE's with necessary job information i.e., when to schedule travel, machine information, contact information, etc.

• Be the first point of contact for the Field Service Engineers regarding scheduling

• Follow up with parts needed per job

• Handle incoming calls and e-mails from internal and external customers, both domestic and international

• Escalate concerns to the Team Lead when necessary

• Edit trip reports, approve time efforts in Connect, and maintain CATs reporting

• Support CAQ, Buhler's Quality Process, through SAP and scheduling

• Must arrive to work predictably and promptly

• Manage miscellaneous projects and complete various tasks as needed

Anforderungen:
• High School Diploma or GED required

• Associate degree or equivalent is preferred

• Excellent interpersonal communication skills and relationship building skills to effectively work with a variety of people and personalities; able to communicate clearly and effectively in person and in writing, internally and externally

• Ability to work with minimal supervision

• Excellent time management and organizational skills

• Professional telephone etiquette is essential

• Ability to identify, evaluate, and problem solve in high pressure situations

• Advanced MS Word, Excel, Power Point & Outlook skills

• Able to type 50 wpm or more

• SAP or similar ERP experience is preferred

• Familiar with manufacturing a plus

• Able to react and remain positive in an ever-changing environment

• Able to work independently within a team setting

Bühler Leybold Optics stands for innovative technologies and steady growth. As part of the Bühler Group, a global engineering group with over 13,000 employees, we are one of the market leaders in high-tech thin-film vacuum coating systems. For more than 150 years, we have offered our customers a wide range of equipment for the coating of spectacle lenses, optical components in smartphones, cars, medical technology cameras, head up displays of cars and much more. Our international team succeeds in setting new standards every day and successfully implementing complex projects.

We are looking for a motivated working student (m/f/d) who actively supports our technical documentation. Our desired colleague (m/f/d) impresses with commitment and reliability and is not afraid to take on tasks independently.

Let's make a difference at Bühler together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to create innovations for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You create and update operating instructions, safety and warnings for high-precision vacuum coating systems (Machinery Directive, Risk Assessment & Co.) • You bring structure to our digital document archive (editing system + modern tools) • You actively obtain information directly from designers, developers and service technicians • You check texts for comprehensibility, technical correctness and compliance with standards – and make them better Requirements • Matriculated studies (e.g. mechanical engineering, mechatronics, technical editing, communication design, industrial engineering, etc.) • Very good German (C1–C2) – you write precisely, understandably and stylistically clean • Joy of explaining complex technology so that everyone understands it • Structured, careful way of working ("right to the detail" is your thing) We offer: Team events and events Your commitment makes it possible for us. We want to celebrate this together with you. Our Christmas parties, summer parties, sporting events and team events offer the best opportunities to do so. Family business culture We have more than 160 years of history. This makes us a company that thinks and invests in the long term - in innovation, our employees and economic success. Intercultural working environment Key to our success is our diverse workforce from more than 100 nations and our inclusive culture. Professional and personal development We offer a wide range of learning opportunities, such as videos, online training, face-to-face training and webinars with short, relevant, engaging, personalised and mobile formats. jobs.title: HR Advisor
jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
•	Provide practical, clear and people-focused HR advice to managers and employees on employee relations, performance, attendance, workplace matters and dependant-related leave.
•	Guide, coach and influence managers and leaders, helping them make sound people decisions that support business performance and positive employee outcomes.
•	Build trusted relationships with employees, managers and stakeholders across Bühler UK's business locations.
•	Identify people priorities and translate business needs into practical HR solutions aligned with organisational objectives.
•	Develop, implement and review HR policies, procedures and working practices to ensure legal compliance, data protection and alignment with best practice.
•	Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, internal moves, secondments, family leave, offboarding, exit interviews and leaver reporting.
•	Support managers through restructures, redundancies, retirements and other organisational changes, ensuring appropriate legal processes are followed.
•	Support recruitment and resourcing activity, including hiring strategies, job descriptions and adverts, interview coordination, onboarding and talent pipelines.
•	Deliver HR initiatives across workforce planning, talent management, employee relations, engagement, organisational development, diversity and inclusion, and hybrid working.
•	Lead learning and development activities, including training needs analysis, programme design and delivery, career pathways, appraisals, leadership programmes and HR workshops.
•	Manage apprenticeship, internship, graduate, secondment, reward and recognition programmes, including relevant administration and end-to-end coordination.
•	Analyse and report HR data, maintain accurate HR records, support pay, reward, benefits and employee communications, and undertake HR projects as required.

Anforderungen:
•	Demonstrable experience working with business areas at HR Advisor level within a complex matrix organisation.
•	Good knowledge across key HR disciplines, including employee relations, learning and development, and recruitment, with an understanding of pay topics and a strong working knowledge of UK employment and immigration law.
•	A proactive, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to prioritise competing demands, manage multiple cases and projects, and meet tight deadlines.
•	Strong learning and development expertise, with the ability to identify training needs and design, create and deliver engaging programmes.
•	An adaptable and inquisitive self-starter who thrives in a varied working environment and is committed to continuous learning.
•	High emotional intelligence and a genuine passion for people management, employee engagement and improving the employee experience.
•	An articulate and diplomatic communicator who can build trusted relationships and manage the expectations of a diverse range of stakeholders.
•	The ability to collaborate effectively as part of a team while also working confidently and independently.
•	A CIPD qualification would be advantageous.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Registrato:
• Fornire consulenza HR pratica, chiara e incentrata sulle persone a manager e dipendenti su relazioni con i dipendenti, prestazioni, presenze, questioni relative al posto di lavoro e congedi legati alle persone a carico.
• Guidare, istruire e influenzare manager e leader, aiutandoli a prendere decisioni valide sulle persone che supportano le prestazioni aziendali e i risultati positivi dei dipendenti.
• Costruire rapporti di fiducia con dipendenti, manager e stakeholder in tutte le sedi aziendali di Bühler UK.
• Identificare le priorità delle persone e tradurre le esigenze aziendali in soluzioni HR pratiche in linea con gli obiettivi organizzativi.
• Sviluppare, implementare e rivedere le politiche, le procedure e le pratiche lavorative delle risorse umane per garantire la conformità legale, la protezione dei dati e l'allineamento con le migliori pratiche.
• Gestire le attività del ciclo di vita dei dipendenti, inclusi onboarding, spostamenti interni, distacchi, congedi familiari, offboarding, colloqui di uscita e reporting delle uscite.
• Supportare i manager attraverso ristrutturazioni, licenziamenti, pensionamenti e altri cambiamenti organizzativi, garantendo che vengano seguite le procedure legali appropriate.
• Supportare l'attività di reclutamento e assegnazione delle risorse, comprese strategie di assunzione, descrizioni di lavoro e annunci, coordinamento dei colloqui, onboarding e pipeline di talenti.
• Fornire iniziative HR nell'ambito della pianificazione della forza lavoro, della gestione dei talenti, delle relazioni con i dipendenti, del coinvolgimento, dello sviluppo organizzativo, della diversità e dell'inclusione e del lavoro ibrido.
• Condurre attività di apprendimento e sviluppo, tra cui l'analisi dei fabbisogni formativi, la progettazione e l'erogazione del programma, percorsi di carriera, valutazioni, programmi di leadership e workshop sulle risorse umane.
• Gestire programmi di apprendistato, tirocinio, laurea, distacco, ricompensa e riconoscimento, compresa la relativa amministrazione e il coordinamento end-to-end.

• Analizzare e segnalare i dati relativi alle risorse umane, conservare registri accurati delle risorse umane, supportare retribuzioni, premi, benefit e comunicazioni con i dipendenti e intraprendere progetti relativi alle risorse umane come richiesto.

Indicazioni:
• Esperienza dimostrabile di lavoro con aree aziendali a livello di consulente HR all'interno di un'organizzazione a matrice complessa.
• Buona conoscenza delle principali discipline HR, comprese le relazioni con i dipendenti, l'apprendimento e lo sviluppo e il reclutamento, con una comprensione degli argomenti relativi alla retribuzione e una forte conoscenza pratica del diritto del lavoro e dell'immigrazione del Regno Unito.
• Un approccio proattivo e incentrato sulle soluzioni, con la capacità di dare priorità alle richieste concorrenti, gestire più casi e progetti e rispettare scadenze ravvicinate.
• Forti competenze in materia di apprendimento e sviluppo, con la capacità di identificare le esigenze di formazione e progettare, creare e fornire programmi coinvolgenti.
• Un intraprendente adattabile e curioso che prospera in un ambiente di lavoro vario e si impegna nell'apprendimento continuo.
• Elevata intelligenza emotiva e una genuina passione per la gestione delle persone, il coinvolgimento dei dipendenti e il miglioramento dell'esperienza dei dipendenti.
• Un comunicatore articolato e diplomatico in grado di costruire relazioni di fiducia e gestire le aspettative di una vasta gamma di stakeholder.
• La capacità di collaborare efficacemente come parte di un team, lavorando allo stesso tempo con sicurezza e indipendenza.
• Una qualifica CIPD sarebbe vantaggiosa.

Due miliardi di persone mangiano ogni giorno cibo prodotto con apparecchiature Bühler. Un miliardo di persone guidano veicoli le cui parti sono state prodotte con le nostre macchine.
Bühler mira a bilanciare l’umanità, la natura e l’economia in ogni decisione mentre sviluppa soluzioni che sbloccano opportunità di business sostenibili nei settori globali di alimenti, mangimi e mobilità.
Ci impegniamo a creare innovazioni per un mondo migliore, con particolare attenzione a soluzioni sane, sicure e sostenibili. Pertanto, collaboriamo con clienti, start-up, multinazionali e mondo accademico per accelerare insieme l’impatto.
descriptionByLocale.en:
Aufgaben:
• Provide practical, clear and people-focused HR advice to managers and employees on employee relations, performance, attendance, workplace matters and dependant-related leave.
• Guide, coach and influence managers and leaders, helping them make sound people decisions that support business performance and positive employee outcomes.
• Build trusted relationships with employees, managers and stakeholders across Bühler UK's business locations.
• Identify people priorities and translate business needs into practical HR solutions aligned with organisational objectives.
• Develop, implement and review HR policies, procedures and working practices to ensure legal compliance, data protection and alignment with best practice.
• Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, internal moves, secondments, family leave, offboarding, exit interviews and leaver reporting.
• Support managers through restructures, redundancies, retirements and other organisational changes, ensuring appropriate legal processes are followed.
• Support recruitment and resourcing activity, including hiring strategies, job descriptions and adverts, interview coordination, onboarding and talent pipelines.
• Deliver HR initiatives across workforce planning, talent management, employee relations, engagement, organisational development, diversity and inclusion, and hybrid working.
• Lead learning and development activities, including training needs analysis, programme design and delivery, career pathways, appraisals, leadership programmes and HR workshops.
• Manage apprenticeship, internship, graduate, secondment, reward and recognition programmes, including relevant administration and end-to-end coordination.
• Analyse and report HR data, maintain accurate HR records, support pay, reward, benefits and employee communications, and undertake HR projects as required.

Anforderungen:
• Demonstrable experience working with business areas at HR Advisor level within a complex matrix organisation.
• Good knowledge across key HR disciplines, including employee relations, learning and development, and recruitment, with an understanding of pay topics and a strong working knowledge of UK employment and immigration law.
• A proactive, solutions-focused approach, with the ability to prioritise competing demands, manage multiple cases and projects, and meet tight deadlines.
• Strong learning and development expertise, with the ability to identify training needs and design, create and deliver engaging programmes.
• An adaptable and inquisitive self-starter who thrives in a varied working environment and is committed to continuous learning.
• High emotional intelligence and a genuine passion for people management, employee engagement and improving the employee experience.
• An articulate and diplomatic communicator who can build trusted relationships and manage the expectations of a diverse range of stakeholders.
• The ability to collaborate effectively as part of a team while also working confidently and independently.
• A CIPD qualification would be advantageous.

Two billion people eat food every day that was produced with Bühler equipment. One billion people drive vehicles whose parts were manufactured with our machines.
Bühler aims to balance humanity, nature, and the economy in every decision as it develops solutions that unlock sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed, and mobility industries.
We strive to create innovations for a better world, with a special focus on healthy, safe, and sustainable solutions. Therefore, we team up with customers, start-ups, multinationals, and academia to accelerate impact together.
descriptionByLocale.de:
Aufgaben:
• Bereitstellung praktischer, klarer und personenorientierter HR-Beratung für Manager und Mitarbeiter zu Mitarbeiterbeziehungen, Leistung, Anwesenheit, Arbeitsplatzangelegenheiten und pflegebedürftigem Urlaub.
• Leiten, coachen und beeinflussen Sie Manager und Führungskräfte und helfen Sie ihnen, fundierte Personalentscheidungen zu treffen, die die Geschäftsleistung und positive Mitarbeiterergebnisse unterstützen.
• Bauen Sie vertrauensvolle Beziehungen zu Mitarbeitern, Managern und Stakeholdern an den Geschäftsstandorten von Bühler UK auf.
• Identifizieren Sie die Prioritäten Ihrer Mitarbeiter und übersetzen Sie Geschäftsanforderungen in praktische HR-Lösungen, die auf die Unternehmensziele abgestimmt sind.
• Entwickeln, implementieren und überprüfen Sie HR-Richtlinien, -Verfahren und -Arbeitspraktiken, um die Einhaltung von Gesetzen, den Datenschutz und die Ausrichtung auf Best Practices sicherzustellen.
• Verwalten Sie die Aktivitäten des Mitarbeiterlebenszyklus, einschließlich Onboarding, interne Umzüge, Abordnungen, Urlaub aus familiären Gründen, Offboarding, Austrittsgespräche und Abgangsberichte.
• Unterstützen Sie Manager bei Umstrukturierungen, Entlassungen, Pensionierungen und anderen organisatorischen Veränderungen und stellen Sie sicher, dass die entsprechenden rechtlichen Prozesse eingehalten werden.
• Unterstützen Sie Rekrutierungs- und Ressourcenbeschaffungsaktivitäten, einschließlich Einstellungsstrategien, Stellenbeschreibungen und Anzeigen, Koordination von Vorstellungsgesprächen, Onboarding und Talentpipelines.
• Führen Sie HR-Initiativen in den Bereichen Personalplanung, Talentmanagement, Mitarbeiterbeziehungen, Engagement, Organisationsentwicklung, Vielfalt und Inklusion sowie hybrides Arbeiten durch.
• Leitung von Lern- und Entwicklungsaktivitäten, einschließlich Schulungsbedarfsanalyse, Programmgestaltung und -durchführung, Karrierewegen, Beurteilungen, Führungsprogrammen und HR-Workshops.
• Verwaltung von Ausbildungs-, Praktikums-, Graduierten-, Entsendungs-, Belohnungs- und Anerkennungsprogrammen, einschließlich relevanter Verwaltung und End-to-End-Koordination.

• Analysieren und melden Sie HR-Daten, führen Sie genaue HR-Aufzeichnungen, unterstützen Sie Gehälter, Vergütungen, Sozialleistungen und Mitarbeiterkommunikation und führen Sie HR-Projekte nach Bedarf durch.

Anforderungen:
• Nachweisbare Erfahrung in der Arbeit mit Geschäftsbereichen auf HR-Beraterebene innerhalb einer komplexen Matrixorganisation.
• Gute Kenntnisse in wichtigen HR-Disziplinen, einschließlich Mitarbeiterbeziehungen, Lernen und Entwicklung sowie Rekrutierung, mit einem Verständnis für Gehaltsthemen und fundierten Kenntnissen des britischen Arbeits- und Einwanderungsrechts.
• Ein proaktiver, lösungsorientierter Ansatz mit der Fähigkeit, konkurrierende Anforderungen zu priorisieren, mehrere Fälle und Projekte zu verwalten und enge Fristen einzuhalten.
• Starke Lern- und Entwicklungskompetenz mit der Fähigkeit, Schulungsbedarf zu erkennen und ansprechende Programme zu entwerfen, zu erstellen und durchzuführen.
• Ein anpassungsfähiger und neugieriger Selbststarter, der in einem abwechslungsreichen Arbeitsumfeld aufblüht und sich dem kontinuierlichen Lernen verpflichtet fühlt.
• Hohe emotionale Intelligenz und eine echte Leidenschaft für Personalmanagement, Mitarbeiterengagement und die Verbesserung der Mitarbeitererfahrung.
• Ein wortgewandter und diplomatischer Kommunikator, der vertrauensvolle Beziehungen aufbauen und die Erwartungen einer Vielzahl von Interessengruppen erfüllen kann.
• Die Fähigkeit, im Team effektiv zusammenzuarbeiten und gleichzeitig selbstbewusst und unabhängig zu arbeiten.
• Eine CIPD-Qualifikation wäre von Vorteil.

Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die mit Bühler-Geräten hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen fahren Fahrzeuge, deren Teile mit unseren Maschinen hergestellt wurden.
Bühler ist bestrebt, bei jeder Entscheidung Mensch, Natur und Wirtschaft in Einklang zu bringen, indem es Lösungen entwickelt, die nachhaltige Geschäftsmöglichkeiten in der globalen Lebensmittel-, Futtermittel- und Mobilitätsindustrie eröffnen.
Wir streben danach, Innovationen für eine bessere Welt zu schaffen, mit besonderem Fokus auf gesunde, sichere und nachhaltige Lösungen. Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Unternehmen und der Wissenschaft zusammen, um gemeinsam die Wirkung zu beschleunigen.
descriptionByLocale.fr:
Aufgaben:
• Fournir des conseils RH pratiques, clairs et axés sur les personnes aux managers et aux employés sur les relations avec les employés, les performances, l'assiduité, les questions liées au lieu de travail et les congés liés aux personnes à charge.
• Guider, coacher et influencer les gestionnaires et les dirigeants, en les aidant à prendre des décisions judicieuses en matière de ressources humaines qui soutiennent la performance de l'entreprise et les résultats positifs des employés.
• Établir des relations de confiance avec les employés, les managers et les parties prenantes sur l'ensemble des sites commerciaux de Bühler UK.
• Identifier les priorités des personnes et traduire les besoins de l'entreprise en solutions RH pratiques alignées sur les objectifs organisationnels.
• Développer, mettre en œuvre et réviser les politiques, procédures et pratiques de travail RH pour garantir la conformité légale, la protection des données et l'alignement avec les meilleures pratiques.
• Gérer les activités du cycle de vie des employés, y compris l'intégration, les mouvements internes, les détachements, les congés familiaux, les départs, les entretiens de départ et les rapports sur les départs.
• Soutenir les managers lors de restructurations, de licenciements, de départs à la retraite et d'autres changements organisationnels, en veillant à ce que les processus juridiques appropriés soient suivis.
• Soutenir les activités de recrutement et de ressourcement, y compris les stratégies d'embauche, les descriptions de poste et les annonces, la coordination des entretiens, l'intégration et les réserves de talents.
• Mener des initiatives RH dans les domaines de la planification des effectifs, de la gestion des talents, des relations avec les employés, de l'engagement, du développement organisationnel, de la diversité et de l'inclusion, ainsi que du travail hybride.
• Diriger les activités d'apprentissage et de développement, y compris l'analyse des besoins de formation, la conception et la prestation de programmes, les cheminements de carrière, les évaluations, les programmes de leadership et les ateliers RH.
• Gérer les programmes d'apprentissage, de stage, d'études supérieures, de détachement, de récompense et de reconnaissance, y compris l'administration pertinente et la coordination de bout en bout.

• Analyser et rapporter les données RH, maintenir des dossiers RH précis, prendre en charge la rémunération, les récompenses, les avantages sociaux et les communications avec les employés, et entreprendre des projets RH selon les besoins.

Réponses :
• Expérience démontrable de travail avec des domaines d'activité au niveau de conseiller en ressources humaines au sein d'une organisation matricielle complexe.
• Bonne connaissance des disciplines clés des ressources humaines, notamment les relations avec les employés, la formation et le développement ainsi que le recrutement, avec une compréhension des sujets liés à la rémunération et une solide connaissance pratique du droit britannique du travail et de l'immigration.
• Une approche proactive et axée sur les solutions, avec la capacité de prioriser les demandes concurrentes, de gérer plusieurs dossiers et projets et de respecter des délais serrés.
• Solide expertise en matière d'apprentissage et de développement, avec la capacité d'identifier les besoins de formation et de concevoir, créer et proposer des programmes attrayants.
• Une personne entreprenante, adaptable et curieuse qui s'épanouit dans un environnement de travail varié et s'engage à l'apprentissage continu.
• Intelligence émotionnelle élevée et véritable passion pour la gestion des personnes, l'engagement des employés et l'amélioration de l'expérience employé.
• Un communicateur éloquent et diplomate, capable d'établir des relations de confiance et de gérer les attentes d'un large éventail de parties prenantes.
• La capacité de collaborer efficacement au sein d'une équipe tout en travaillant en toute confiance et de manière indépendante.
• Une qualification CIPD serait avantageuse.

Deux milliards de personnes consomment chaque jour des aliments produits avec les équipements Bühler. Un milliard de personnes conduisent des véhicules dont les pièces ont été fabriquées avec nos machines.
Bühler vise à équilibrer l’humanité, la nature et l’économie dans chaque décision en développant des solutions qui ouvrent des opportunités commerciales durables dans les secteurs mondiaux de l’alimentation humaine et animale et de la mobilité.
Nous nous efforçons de créer des innovations pour un monde meilleur, en mettant un accent particulier sur des solutions saines, sûres et durables. C’est pourquoi nous faisons équipe avec des clients, des start-ups, des multinationales et des universitaires pour accélérer ensemble notre impact.

jobs.description:
Aufgaben:
• Lead supplier quality management system audit, and new supplier on boarding process from sampling to ramping up

• Have experience in manufacturing process and application of electronic and electric component

• Manage supplier non-conformity cases to minimize the disturbance to internal manufacturing workshops and external customers

• Drive supplier to conduct root cause analysis (like 8D principle) to take systematic improvement activities.

• Drive Supplier quality performance improvement with clear KPIs in place, and analyze supplier quality indicators to ensure the efficiency of improvement actions

• Plan and execute supplier development projects together with category managers, to build world class supplier base with requested supply capacity and quality performance

• Work with category manager on supplier relationship management, to promote supplier partnership with Buhler

• Be familiar with the process of PCB/PCBA, electric & electronic components, and supplier OEM etc.

• Have a good understanding of the properties of various materials, mechanical, electrical principles.

Anforderungen:
• Bachelor or above degree in Mechanical Engineering, or ‌Electrical Engineering‌.

• Minimum 5 years of work experience in multinational companies

• Minimum 3 years of supplier quality management experience

• At least 3 years working experience in mechanical field

• Good English in written while Spoken is preferred.

• Familiar with Microsoft Office and data analysis.

• Solid quality management knowledge, especially 8D improvement skills.

• Good skills in communication, coordination and cooperation

• Convincing and influencing

• Shaping and driving changes

• Ability to take decisions, sense of urgency

• Resilience and self-motivation

Mit Ihren ausgeprägten Kommunikationsfähigkeiten und Ihrem Engagement überzeugen Sie nicht nur uns, sondern auch unsere Kunden direkt vor Ort. Bewerben Sie sich jetzt und werden Sie Teil unseres Teams.

Lassen Sie uns bei Bühler gemeinsam etwas bewirken!
Zwei Milliarden Menschen essen täglich Lebensmittel, die auf Anlagen von Bühler hergestellt wurden. Eine Milliarde Menschen reisen in Fahrzeugen, deren Teile mit Technologien von Bühler produziert wurden.

Deshalb arbeiten wir mit Kunden, Start-ups, multinationalen Konzernen und Wissenschaftlern zusammen, um gemeinsam eine schnellere Wirkung zu erzielen. Interkulturelles Arbeitsumfeld Der Schlüssel zu unserem Erfolg ist unsere vielfältige Belegschaft aus mehr als 100 Nationen und unsere inklusive Kultur. Berufliche und persönliche Entwicklung Wir bieten ein breites Spektrum an Lernmöglichkeiten, wie Videos, Online-Schulungen, Präsenzschulungen und Webinare mit kurzen, relevanten, ansprechenden, personalisierten und mobilen Formaten. As a (junior) engineer for process development and commissioning - Ion Beam & Plasma Technologies (m/f/d), you can demonstrate your creativity in solving problems in an innovative environment. With your strong communication skills and commitment, you not only convince us, but also our customers directly on site. Apply now and become part of our team.

Let us at Bühler make a difference together!
Two billion people eat food produced on Bühler plants every day. One billion people travel in vehicles whose parts were produced using Bühler technologies.
With every decision, Bühler pursues the goal of reconciling the needs of the economy, people and nature. In this way, we develop solutions that open up sustainable business opportunities in the global food, feed and mobility industries.
We want to innovate for a better world, with a particular focus on healthy, safe and sustainable solutions. This is why we work with customers, start-ups, multinational corporations and scientists to achieve a faster impact together. Tasks: • You are responsible for the process engineering commissioning of our ion beam and plasma systems both at our locations and at customers in Germany and abroad. • You set up, optimize and document processes • They carry out process-related service work and carry out technical approvals at plants • They support the development and continuous development of ion beam and plasma technologies, including ion beam-based machining techniques • By cooperating with research & development, engineering, software, project management and customer service You continuously contribute to the improvement of our processes and products Requirements • You have successfully completed a technical degree, for example in physics, materials sciences, physical engineering, electrical engineering or a comparable discipline • Ideally, you will have initial experience in the development, operation and optimization of ion beam, plasma or comparable vacuum-based process systems. • Knowledge of optical measurement technology or comparable characterization methods are advantageous • You have a very good knowledge of English; Knowledge of German is an advantage • They are capable of teamwork, strong in communication and are characterized by a reliable way of working • Your willingness to travel worldwide rounds off your profile We offer: Modern workplace with the best technical equipment Work in a modern workplace equipped with the latest technical tools to boost your productivity and innovation.
